---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Rule Deck Environment Initialization**:
   - Ingest the compiled GDSII/OASIS stream of the 8F² folded bitline memory array.
   - Define and map primary physical layers in the DRC deck: Layer 1 (Active/DIFF) and Layer 2 (Gate Polysilicon/POLY).
2. **Access Transistor Dimension Evaluation**:
   - Perform boolean intersection (`DIFF AND POLY`) to define the transistor active channel region.
   - Measure gate channel length along the current path; flag any deviation from nominal $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Measure active channel width across the gate; verify conformance to $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
3. **Wordline Pitch & Poly Spacing Verification**:
   - Execute parallel edge-to-edge distance checks between adjacent polysilicon wordline tracks across the memory array.
   - Assert pitch compliance within the allowed lithography window ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
4. **Poly Endcap & Active Extension Check**:
   - Check poly gate extension beyond the active diffusion boundary (`POLY NOT DIFF` overhang) to prevent source-to-drain edge leakage.
   - Measure active extension past the gate edge (`DIFF NOT POLY`) to accommodate the shared bitline and storage capacitor tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads.
5. **Violation Flagging & Automated Signoff**:
   - Export marker error coordinates (RVE/XML format) for any spacing, overlap, or width anomalies.
   - Generate the clean DRC signoff summary once zero critical violations remain.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-LAY-004`  
**Title:** Shared Bitline Contact & Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Layout  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Unit Cell Layout & Shared Contact Placement  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
 ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
 │ 180nm 8F2 Cell Layout Execution │
 │                                 │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │   Define Active Area   │      │
 │ │    W=220nm & Access    │      │
 │ │      Gate L=180nm      │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │   Pattern Wordlines    │      │
 │ │    Pitch=360-400nm     │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │   Deposit ILD & Etch   │      │
 │ │   Central Shared BL    │      │
 │ │      Contact Via       │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │    Fill W-Plug for     │      │
 │ │  Shared BL Contact &   │      │
 │ │        Route BL        │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │  Deposit Inter-Metal   │      │
 │ │     Dielectric IMD     │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │  Pattern Storage Node  │      │
 │ │   SN Via Plugs Over    │      │
 │ │         Drain          │      │
 │ └────────────┬───────────┘      │
 │              ▼                  │
 │ ┌────────────────────────┐      │
 │ │  Erect Stacked Crown   │      │
 │ │  MIM Bottom Electrode  │      │
 │ └────────────────────────┘      │
 └─────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Active Area (OD) & Access Transistor Sizing
- Lay out the continuous diffusion active area (OD) with transistor active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- Pattern access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ over dry thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric physical thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ (grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).

### Step 2: Wordline (WL) Array Routing & Pitch Allocation
- Lay out polycide/metal wordline runners perpendicular to the active diffusion tracks.
- Enforce wordline and bitline pitch strictly within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ to conform to the $8F^2$ folded bitline cell grid.

### Step 3: Shared Bitline (BL) Contact Placement & Contact Plug
- Position a single shared bitline contact at the shared source diffusion between two adjacent memory cells.
- Fill the contact cavity with a tungsten plug (W-plug) connection landing onto the central active node.
- Route the bitline over the planarized interlayer dielectric (ILD) with target wire capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

### Step 4: Storage Node (SN) Via Landing & Interlayer Isolation
- Route and etch the storage node (SN) contact via opening landing over the access transistor drain diffusion region.
- Fill the landing contact via with a tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
- Ensure clearance to adjacent wordlines ($360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$ pitch grid) to prevent wordline-to-storage-node punch-through or parasitic shorts.

### Step 5: Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Bottom-Electrode Via Landing
- Implement Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) topology directly over the planarized IMD and bitline lines.
- Land the bottom electrode via directly onto the underlying storage node W-plug.
- Erect a 3D Crown-shaped polysilicon or Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) cylinder bottom electrode.
- Deposit an $\text{ONO}$ (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$) with dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                 Electrical & Retention Acceptance Limits 
                 ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
     Delta V (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Bitline C_BL (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Ret Time (ms)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
      C_cell (fF)┤█████                                  │
                 │█████                                  │
                 └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0      62.5     125.0     187.5  250.0 
```

1. **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$):**
   - **Target:** Minimum $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (minimum $28\text{ fF}$ nominal requirement for soft-error alpha-particle noise immunity).
2. **Capacitor Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):**
   - **Target:** $3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ with dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ ($\text{ONO}$ triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
3. **Cell Leakage & Retention Interval:**
   - **Target:** Sub-threshold and junction leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, yielding retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
4. **Sense Amplifier Differential Readout Signal ($\Delta V$):**
   - **Target:** $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$, defined by $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ under $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

---

## 4. Context References Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Transition to $8F^2$ folded bitline; transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact; W-plug; stacked crown polysilicon/MIM capacitor; $\text{ONO} / \text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ ($\kappa > 15$); capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** $8F^2$ 1T1C layout; $C_s = 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$; retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; crown/cylinder $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ dielectric with $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide physical thickness $\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:** Differential charge sharing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ based on nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline cell at the 180nm node (F=180nm, bitline pitch = 360nm, wordline pitch = 360nm), sharing the bitline contact between two adjacent access transistors halves the bitline parasitics per cell, but creates severe aspect ratio and overlay bottlenecks between the shared drain contact plug and the adjacent storage node (SN) capacitor bottom-electrode via landings. If the shared contact CD balloons beyond 180nm, parasitic coupling capacitance between the bitline plug and the storage node bottom electrode increases significantly, reducing the sensing margin below the 150mV differential threshold required by the cross-coupled sense amplifier.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) architecture requires the storage node via (SN contact) to land precisely on the source diffusion while avoiding shorting to the passing wordlines and the adjacent shared bitline contact plug (W-plug). Self-aligned contact (SAC) etching with silicon nitride (Si3N4) spacers is mandatory; un-landed or misaligned bottom-electrode vias will incur corner punch-through into the bitline plug or wordline polysilicon gate, leading to catastrophic single-bit leakage currents exceeding the 1.0 fA/cell refresh retention ceiling at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) and silane/hydrogen precursor gases for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of the high-aspect-ratio plug require strict vendor purity (>99.999% electronic grade) and dedicated dual-containment mass flow controllers. Furthermore, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries for tungsten plug recessed planarization must exhibit high selectivity to TEOS/BPSG interlayer dielectric (>50:1) to prevent dishing or erosion across the dense DRAM array boundary.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Layout tape-out for the shared contact and capacitor bottom-electrode via landing must strictly pass automated DRC/LVS decks using open-source KLayout DRC scripts. A critical scheduling risk is mask generation and RET/OPC rule qualification for sub-200nm contact hole printing under 248nm KrF lithography; optical proximity correction must be frozen before committing to multi-project wafer (MPW) reticle fabrication.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bridge leakage/short between the shared bitline W-plug and the storage node bottom-electrode via due to overlay drift (dx > 25nm) and spacer erosion during SAC etch.
1. Bottom-electrode via open or elevated contact resistance (Rc > 2.5 kOhm/plug) caused by incomplete native oxide etch (pre-clean skip) or polymeric fluorocarbon polymer residues at the bottom of the contact hole.
1. Excessive bitline-to-storage-node parasitic coupling capacitance (C_bl_sn > 0.15 fF/cell) violating the 28 fF cell storage budget and causing false readouts in folded bitline sensing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-01` | **Shared Bitline Contact to Storage Node Via Kelvin Resistance and Isolation Breakdown Test** | Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer with Cascade Microtech 12000B semi-automated probe station | 1. Force current I_force from 1 uA to 100 uA through Kelvin force terminals across the shared bitline contact plug array. 2. Measure differential voltage V_sense across sense terminals to compute contact resistance Rc = V_sense / I_force. 3. Apply voltage ramp from 0V to 3.3V between adjacent shared bitline contact chain and storage node bottom-electrode landing chain while monitoring leakage current I_leak. | `Specific contact resistance Rc must be <= 1.2 kOhm/plug (average across 100-link chain); isolation leakage current I_leak must remain < 10 pA at V_bias = 1.8V (dielectric breakdown field > 6 MV/cm).` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-02` | **Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Overlay Accuracy and Critical Dimension SEM Metrology** | Hitachi S-9380 CD-SEM and dual-beam FEI Helios NanoLab Focused Ion Beam (FIB-SEM) | 1. Measure contact critical dimension (CD) across 40 array sites (shared bitline contact and storage node via). 2. Measure edge-to-edge overlay spacing between bitline contact plug and bottom-electrode landing pad using optical/SEM overlay targets. 3. FIB cross-section 3 test cells along the bitline axis to verify via sidewall angle and barrier layer (Ti/TiN) coverage at the bottom corner. | `Bottom-electrode via CD = 180nm ± 10nm (3-sigma); edge-to-edge overlay error |dx| <= 20nm, |dy| <= 20nm; via sidewall taper angle >= 88.0°; barrier Ti/TiN bottom coverage >= 25% nominal thickness.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B cleanroom suit with conductive ESD booties, Triple-layer fluoropolymer/nitrile gloves (Silver Shield inner, Nitrile outer), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash face shield and safety goggles, Emergency self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) accessible at gas cabinet
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flush affected skin with copious water for 5 minutes, then apply and continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel until medical personnel arrive. For inhalation of WF6/TiCl4 breakdown products (HF, HCl): Remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous dedicated toxic gas exhaust ducting maintained at negative pressure (-0.5 in. w.g.) with real-time electrochemical point-of-use gas detection sensors (alarm trigger at 0.5 ppm HF equivalent); minimum 60 air changes per hour in chase alcove.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhausted process effluents routed through dry reactive resin thermal/catalytic burn box followed by a counter-current wet scrubber dosing sodium hydroxide (10% NaOH) to maintain effluent pH between 6.5 and 8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (5N5, 99.9995%) | `100.0%` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride** | `7550-45-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.99%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Dilute Pre-clean)** | `7664-39-3` | Ultra-Pure (UP-S) | `0.5% aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and ash-cleaned silicon diffusion contact holes with chemical oxide stripped by dilute HF (100:1 dHF) dip.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal atomic layer deposition (ALD) / CVD Ti/TiN adhesion and barrier liner deposited (5nm Ti / 10nm TiN) sealing the contact interface.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth (SiO2 thickness > 0.8nm) causing unrecoverable contact resistance spike (Rc > 5 kOhm) and catastrophic fluorine wormhole defect formation during subsequent WF6 CVD reduction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified physical layout, DRC/LVS signoff deck, and physical process integration specification for shared bitline contact (BLC) and capacitor bottom-electrode via landing (SNC) in 180nm 8F^2 DRAM cell satisfying < 1 fA leakage, > 28 fF cell capacitance, and overlay margins >= 25nm.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `klayout_drc_lvs_clean_report_blc_snc.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Shared bitline contact plug specific resistance to N+ active diffusion** | `950 Ohm` | +/- 150 Ohm | Four-terminal Kelvin bridge electrical probe array across 100 measured sites per wafer |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Physical edge-to-edge separation between shared bitline plug and capacitor bottom-electrode via** | `110 nm` | +/- 12 nm | Top-down automated CD-SEM and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node junction-to-substrate and contact-to-contact leakage current at 85°C** | `0.65 fA/cell` | +0.35 fA/cell maximum | Sub-femtoampere source measure unit (SMU) retention hold-time leakage measurement on 1Mb test vehicle array |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC/LVS violations on KLayout open-source verification suite, specific contact resistance <= 1.1 kOhm across all Kelvin sites, and edge-to-edge isolation breakdown voltage > 3.3V with leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F^2 folded bitline cell at the 180nm node (F=180nm, bitline pitch = 360nm, wordline pitch = 360nm), sharing the bitline contact between two adjacent access transistors halves the bitline parasitics per cell, but creates severe aspect ratio and overlay bottlenecks between the shared drain contact plug and the adjacent storage node (SN) capacitor bottom-electrode via landings. If the shared contact CD balloons beyond 180nm, parasitic coupling capacitance between the bitline plug and the storage node bottom electrode increases significantly, reducing the sensing margin below the 150mV differential threshold required by the cross-coupled sense amplifier.
critics.domain_expert: Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) architecture requires the storage node via (SN contact) to land precisely on the source diffusion while avoiding shorting to the passing wordlines and the adjacent shared bitline contact plug (W-plug). Self-aligned contact (SAC) etching with silicon nitride (Si3N4) spacers is mandatory; un-landed or misaligned bottom-electrode vias will incur corner punch-through into the bitline plug or wordline polysilicon gate, leading to catastrophic single-bit leakage currents exceeding the 1.0 fA/cell refresh retention ceiling at 85°C.
critics.supply_chain: Tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) and silane/hydrogen precursor gases for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of the high-aspect-ratio plug require strict vendor purity (>99.999% electronic grade) and dedicated dual-containment mass flow controllers. Furthermore, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries for tungsten plug recessed planarization must exhibit high selectivity to TEOS/BPSG interlayer dielectric (>50:1) to prevent dishing or erosion across the dense DRAM array boundary.
critics.laya_pm: Layout tape-out for the shared contact and capacitor bottom-electrode via landing must strictly pass automated DRC/LVS decks using open-source KLayout DRC scripts. A critical scheduling risk is mask generation and RET/OPC rule qualification for sub-200nm contact hole printing under 248nm KrF lithography; optical proximity correction must be frozen before committing to multi-project wafer (MPW) reticle fabrication.
critical_failure_modes: Bridge leakage/short between the shared bitline W-plug and the storage node bottom-electrode via due to overlay drift (dx > 25nm) and spacer erosion during SAC etch.

Bottom-electrode via open or elevated contact resistance (Rc > 2.5 kOhm/plug) caused by incomplete native oxide etch (pre-clean skip) or polymeric fluorocarbon polymer residues at the bottom of the contact hole.
Excessive bitline-to-storage-node parasitic coupling capacitance (C_bl_sn > 0.15 fF/cell) violating the 28 fF cell storage budget and causing false readouts in folded bitline sensing.

testcases.title: Shared Bitline Contact to Storage Node Via Kelvin Resistance and Isolation Breakdown Test
testcases.instrumentation: Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer with Cascade Microtech 12000B semi-automated probe station
testcases.pre_conditions: Dedicated 100-contact Kelvin daisy chain test structure fabricated on kerf/scribe line; ambient temperature controlled at 25°C ± 1°C; probe tips planarized and contact resistance verified < 0.5 Ohm.
testcases.procedure: 1. Force current I_force from 1 uA to 100 uA through Kelvin force terminals across the shared bitline contact plug array. 2. Measure differential voltage V_sense across sense terminals to compute contact resistance Rc = V_sense / I_force. 3. Apply voltage ramp from 0V to 3.3V between adjacent shared bitline contact chain and storage node bottom-electrode landing chain while monitoring leakage current I_leak.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Specific contact resistance Rc must be <= 1.2 kOhm/plug (average across 100-link chain); isolation leakage current I_leak must remain < 10 pA at V_bias = 1.8V (dielectric breakdown field > 6 MV/cm).

testcases.title: Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Overlay Accuracy and Critical Dimension SEM Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Hitachi S-9380 CD-SEM and dual-beam FEI Helios NanoLab Focused Ion Beam (FIB-SEM)
testcases.pre_conditions: Post-CMP dielectric planarization and via contact hole reactive ion etch (RIE) completed; wafer de-gassed and transferred into CD-SEM chamber under vacuum (< 1e-4 Pa).
testcases.procedure: 1. Measure contact critical dimension (CD) across 40 array sites (shared bitline contact and storage node via). 2. Measure edge-to-edge overlay spacing between bitline contact plug and bottom-electrode landing pad using optical/SEM overlay targets. 3. FIB cross-section 3 test cells along the bitline axis to verify via sidewall angle and barrier layer (Ti/TiN) coverage at the bottom corner.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Bottom-electrode via CD = 180nm ± 10nm (3-sigma); edge-to-edge overlay error |dx| <= 20nm, |dy| <= 20nm; via sidewall taper angle >= 88.0°; barrier Ti/TiN bottom coverage >= 25% nominal thickness.

ppe_required: Level B cleanroom suit with conductive ESD booties
Triple-layer fluoropolymer/nitrile gloves (Silver Shield inner, Nitrile outer)
ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash face shield and safety goggles
Emergency self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) accessible at gas cabinet
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For HF exposure: Immediately flush affected skin with copious water for 5 minutes, then apply and continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel until medical personnel arrive. For inhalation of WF6/TiCl4 breakdown products (HF, HCl): Remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, do not induce vomiting.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Continuous dedicated toxic gas exhaust ducting maintained at negative pressure (-0.5 in. w.g.) with real-time electrochemical point-of-use gas detection sensors (alarm trigger at 0.5 ppm HF equivalent); minimum 60 air changes per hour in chase alcove.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Exhausted process effluents routed through dry reactive resin thermal/catalytic burn box followed by a counter-current wet scrubber dosing sodium hydroxide (10% NaOH) to maintain effluent pH between 6.5 and 8.5 before drain discharge.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly etched and ash-cleaned silicon diffusion contact holes with chemical oxide stripped by dilute HF (100:1 dHF) dip.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Conformal atomic layer deposition (ALD) / CVD Ti/TiN adhesion and barrier liner deposited (5nm Ti / 10nm TiN) sealing the contact interface.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Native oxide regrowth (SiO2 thickness > 0.8nm) causing unrecoverable contact resistance spike (Rc > 5 kOhm) and catastrophic fluorine wormhole defect formation during subsequent WF6 CVD reduction.

expected_result.summary: Verified physical layout, DRC/LVS signoff deck, and physical process integration specification for shared bitline contact (BLC) and capacitor bottom-electrode via landing (SNC) in 180nm 8F^2 DRAM cell satisfying < 1 fA leakage, > 28 fF cell capacitance, and overlay margins >= 25nm.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Shared bitline contact plug specific resistance to N+ active diffusion
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Four-terminal Kelvin bridge electrical probe array across 100 measured sites per wafer

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Physical edge-to-edge separation between shared bitline plug and capacitor bottom-electrode via
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Top-down automated CD-SEM and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Storage node junction-to-substrate and contact-to-contact leakage current at 85°C
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Sub-femtoampere source measure unit (SMU) retention hold-time leakage measurement on 1Mb test vehicle array

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Zero DRC/LVS violations on KLayout open-source verification suite, specific contact resistance <= 1.1 kOhm across all Kelvin sites, and edge-to-edge isolation breakdown voltage > 3.3V with leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Landing Pad DRC Rule Deck Setup

**Document ID:** SOP-DRAM180-LAY-004  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification (DRC)  
**Parent Workstream:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 8F² Folded Bitline Unit Cell Layout & Shared Contact Placement > Shared Bitline Contact & Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Layout

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the synthesis, calibration, and execution of the physical Design Rule Check (DRC) rule deck targeting the shared bitline contact (BLC) and capacitor storage node landing pad (SNLP / bottom-electrode via contact) for an 8F² folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cell matrix on a 180 nm node.

---

### 2. Context & Design Topology

```
             Wordline (WL0)      Wordline (WL1)
                 [Gate]              [Gate]
                   │                   │
  [Storage Node]   │   [Shared BLC]    │   [Storage Node]
    Landing Pad ───┴───── Drain/BL ────┴─── Landing Pad
   (Access Tx 0)        (Tungsten Plug)     (Access Tx 1)
```

- **Cell Architecture:** 8F² folded-bitline unit cell with Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB).
- **Access Transistor:** Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Wiring Grid:** Bitline and wordline pitch = $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Vertical Interconnect:** Shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) placed between adjacent access transistors sharing a common active region; separate bottom-electrode storage node landing pads located over source diffusion nodes.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Definition of Physical Layer Map & Boolean Derivations
1. Configure technology layer definitions in the DRC engine (KLayout DRC / Magic / Calibre syntax):
   - Layer `DIFF` (Active Area / Diffusion): Layer 1
   - Layer `POLY` (Wordline Gates, Gate Oxide $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$): Layer 2
   - Layer `CONT_BL` (Shared Bitline Contact W-Plug): Layer 5
   - Layer `CONT_SN` (Storage Node Landing Plug): Layer 6
   - Layer `PAD_SN` (Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Landing Pad): Layer 7
   - Layer `BL_METAL` (Bitline Conductor): Layer 8
2. Define derived layers:
   - `GATE_CHAN = POLY AND DIFF` (Access transistor channel region: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - `SHARED_DRAIN = (DIFF NOT POLY) AND CONT_BL` (Common bitline injection node).
   - `STORAGE_DIFF = (DIFF NOT POLY) AND CONT_SN` (Storage node contact landing area).

#### Step 2: Dimensional & Geometric Rule Deck Encoding
1. **Access Gate Constraints:**
   - Enforce exact gate length constraint: `POLY_LENGTH = 0.18 um` ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Enforce transistor active width constraint: `DIFF_WIDTH = 0.22 um` ($220\text{ nm}$).
   - Enforce array wiring pitch: `PITCH(POLY) >= 0.36 um` and `PITCH(BL_METAL) >= 0.36 um` ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
2. **Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Rules:**
   - Define exact plug enclosure by diffusion: `DIFF ENCLOSURE CONT_BL >= 0.04 um`.
   - Define spacing from shared contact plug to wordline gate edges: `CONT_BL SPACE POLY >= 0.09 um` to prevent gate-drain dielectric punch-through.
   - Enforce contact sharing across twin active segments: Flag any standalone `CONT_BL` not bounded by dual symmetric gates within $0.36\text{ nm}$ to $0.40\text{ nm}$ pitch bounds.
3. **Storage Node Landing Pad (SNLP) & Bottom-Electrode Rules:**
   - Specify landing pad overlap over storage node plug: `PAD_SN ENCLOSURE CONT_SN >= 0.05 um`.
   - Specify minimum distance between adjacent Storage Node Landing Pads across wordline boundaries: `PAD_SN SPACE PAD_SN >= 0.14 um`.
   - Confirm vertical alignment clearance for the stacked capacitor (Crown / Cylinder bottom electrode) erected above the drain contact via the W-plug.

#### Step 3: Deck Compilation and Unit-Cell Matrix Verification
1. Load the compiled rule deck into the physical verification engine.
2. Execute hierarchical DRC against a minimum $8\times 8$ array matrix of folded-bitline cells.
3. Verify zero false-positive violations in dense array repetition zones while capturing deliberate edge-of-array misalignment test cases.
4. Output standard GDSII/OASIS error marker layers (`RVE`/`OASIS` visual overlay) for layout sign-off.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric # | Parameter / Feature | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-1** | Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$) | $180 \pm 0$ ($0.180$) | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$) | DRC Dimension Extraction (`GATE_CHAN` Length) |
| **AC-2** | Access Transistor Active Width ($W$) | $220 \pm 0$ ($0.220$) | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$) | DRC Dimension Extraction (`DIFF` Width at Gate) |
| **AC-3** | Array Wiring Pitch (Wordline & Bitline) | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Pitch Measurement (`POLY` & `BL_METAL` Center-to-Center) |
| **AC-4** | Gate Dielectric Physical Oxide Thickness | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Process Integration Techfile Parameter (`T_ox`) |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Basis for:* Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); 8F² folded bitline layout; shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells; stacked capacitor topology with tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Basis for:* Wordline and bitline pitch range ($360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$); thermal gate oxide physical thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$); stacked crown/cylinder capacitor integration guidelines.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *Basis for:* Folded bitline array architecture verification and complementary bitline pairing context.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Landing Pad DRC Rule Deck Setup: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM-180NM-LAY-004`
**Title:** Shared Bitline Contact & Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Polygon Layout  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 8F² Folded Bitline Unit Cell Layout & Shared Contact Placement > Shared Bitline Contact & Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Layout  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Contact Hierarchy

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Active Area      │
│     Diffusion OD      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ├────────────────────────────╮
            ▼                            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │    │                       │
│    Shared Bitline     │    │  Capacitor Plug Node  │
│    Contact BC Via     │    │        CP Via         │
│                       │    │                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘    └───────────┬───────────┘
            │                            │
            │                            │
            ▼                            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │    │                       │
│   Bitline Metal1 M1   │    │   Capacitor Bottom    │
│        Landing        │    │   Electrode SN Via    │
│                       │    │                       │
└───────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Active Diffusion (OD) Boundary Verification**:
   - Confirm active area dimensions for the 180nm access transistor pair: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the contiguous OD stripe spans the twin-cell structure with central drain shared between both access gates.

2. **Shared Bitline Contact (BC) Via Polygon Placement**:
   - Place a square tungsten-plug contact via polygon ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) symmetrically centered on the shared drain diffusion between the two adjacent wordlines ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Align the contact landing pads to satisfy bitline pitch constraints of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
   - Establish minimum poly-to-contact dielectric spacing rule checks (DRC) to prevent shorting against adjacent wordline gate edges.

3. **Capacitor Storage Node Contact (CP Plug) Via Layout**:
   - Draw the outer source contacts (node plugs) at the outer extremities of each twin-cell active diffusion region.
   - Maintain uniform contact plug diameter ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) positioned along the bitline pitch axis, ensuring symmetric source-to-drain overlay.

4. **Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Landing & Metal Routing**:
   - Route Bitline (Metal 1) across the shared center contact with proper enclosure margins ($\ge 40\text{ nm}$).
   - Construct the bottom-electrode via pad (Capacitor Contact / Bottom-Electrode Via) directly above the CP plug to support the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/cylinder architecture.
   - Verify layout spacing against adjacent unit cells to prevent capacitive coupling and soft-error susceptibility.

5. **DRC / LVS Extraction & Rule Sign-Off**:
   - Run Design Rule Checking (DRC) for minimum contact enclosure by diffusion, metal enclosure over contact, and contact-to-gate isolation.
   - Perform Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) extraction to verify 1T1C cross-coupling and shared net nodal mapping.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / DRC polygon rule |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 10\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / DRC polygon rule |
| **Bitline & Wordline Matrix Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Nominal band | Optical overlay / DRC spacing |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Min. $25\text{ fF}$, Typ. $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ | LVS / Calibre xACT Parasitic Extraction |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Max upper bound | SPICE model extraction / Wafer Sort Test |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Cell architecture: $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) configuration.
  - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell; target leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Tungsten plug (W-plug) connection from drain/source contact to bottom electrode.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded bitline sensing budget: Nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ against bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ producing signal differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline cell at 180nm (F=180nm, cell pitch ~360nm-400nm), layout polygons for the shared bitline contact (BLC) and capacitor bottom-electrode via (BC) must satisfy strict overlay budgets (<35nm 3-sigma) to avoid parasitic capacitive coupling spikes between the BLC tungsten stud and storage node capacitor pillar, which directly compromises bitline signal margin (delta-VBL) during read sensing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture requires the storage node contact plug (BC) to land symmetrically on active silicon without shorting to the passing wordline or adjacent shared bitline contact. Polygon design must enforce optical proximity correction (OPC) hammerheads and serifs on contact landing pads to prevent corner rounding from diminishing contact area below 0.032 µm^2, which would escalate plug series resistance above 150 Ohms.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) and silane/disilane precursor supply pipelines for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) W-plug fill, coupled with KrF (248nm) lithography reticle delivery from regional mask shops, dictate tight mask-layer design rules; polygon pitch violations risk requiring sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) that elevate mask inspection costs by >40%.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The polygon-level signoff on GDSII stream layer 22 (BLC) and layer 28 (BC Via) is on the critical path for the tapeout milestone; failure to resolve DRC/LVS spacing violations prior to freeze will slip reticle manufacturing by 3 weeks and jeopardize line clearance for the 200mm pilot run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. BC-to-Wordline dielectric breakdown (gate punch-through) caused by corner rounding and overlay drift of the capacitor bottom-electrode landing polygon during 248nm lithography.
1. Shared bitline contact bridging to adjacent active diffusion region due to asymmetric lithographic proximity effects and lack of mask bias compensation on 180nm contact polygons.
1. Severe contact open/choking resulting from uncompensated aspect-ratio dependent etching (ARDE) where bottom via polygon critical dimension shrinks below lithographic threshold.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-2-01` | **Critical Dimension & Edge Placement Verification for BLC and BC Polygons** | CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope) with automated automated edge-roughness profiling and GDS overlay matching software | 1. Load coupon wafer into CD-SEM and align coordinates to cell matrix alignment marks. 2. Measure bottom critical dimension (CD) of 50 randomly sampled shared BLC vias across wafer center, mid-radius, and edge. 3. Measure bottom CD of 50 capacitor bottom-electrode (BC) landing vias. 4. Extract edge placement error (EPE) and corner rounding radius using automated contour matching against target GDSII layout. 5. Record mean CD, standard deviation, and overlay displacement relative to active area (OD). | `Nominal CD = 180.0 nm; Pass if BLC and BC bottom CD are within 180.0 nm ± 12.0 nm (3-sigma <= 6.0 nm), and overlay misalignment to active diffusion <= 25.0 nm. Any CD < 165 nm or > 195 nm constitutes immediate fail.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-2-02` | **Kelvin Four-Wire Contact Resistance & Dielectric Isolation Breakdown Test** | Automated Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) coupled to a semi-automatic probe station equipped with micro-manipulated tungsten Kelvin probe tips | 1. Calibrate Kelvin probe tips on gold standard substrate. 2. Contact probe tips to 4-point Kelvin pads of the BLC-to-active contact structure; source current from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA and measure voltage drop to extract specific contact resistance (Rc). 3. Contact probe tips to BC-to-BLC adjacent comb isolation structure; sweep voltage from 0 V to 7.0 V DC (100 mV steps) and record leakage current (I_leak) to evaluate inter-contact dielectric breakdown. 4. Repeat breakdown measurement on cell matrix TEG at 85°C. | `Specific contact resistance per plug Rc <= 120.0 Ohms at 25°C. Inter-via leakage current I_leak <= 10.0 pA at 3.3 V DC bias; breakdown voltage V_bd >= 6.5 V across the inter-layer dielectric spacing at 85°C.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A fully encapsulating vapor protective chemical suit for CVD gas line maintenance, Supplied-air respirator (SCBA) or airline positive-pressure breathing apparatus, Double-layered butyl rubber over Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves, Safety face shield with ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles, Static-dissipative cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Evacuate immediately to safety shower, flush exposed area with copious water for 2 minutes, and apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel continuously while messaging medical emergency response. For WF6 inhalation/acid gas exposure: Remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen via positive pressure mask, do not induce vomiting, and summon emergency hazmat medical responders immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated point-of-use toxic gas abatement combustion/wet scrubber system operating under continuous negative pressure (-0.5 in. w.g.) with real-time continuous toxic gas monitoring (TGMS) calibrated for HF/WF6/SiH4 detection down to 0.1 ppm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fluoride-bearing effluent routed to dedicated acidic fluoride drain system; treat with calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry precipitation to convert soluble fluorides into insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake, neutralizing supernatant to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal industrial discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C3 Tier 3) | `99.999%` |
| **Silane** | `7803-62-5` | VLSI Grade | `99.999%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Pre-contact clean)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (Cleanroom Fab) | `0.5% - 1.0% (Dilute HF)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (SC-1 cleaning)** | `1336-21-6` | Semiconductor Grade | `28.0% - 30.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pristine silicon and silicide contact pads post-dilute HF (dHF 100:1) native oxide strip, exhibiting hydrophobic hydrogen-passivated surface with water contact angle > 75 degrees.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal Ti/TiN barrier metal liner (10nm/15nm) deposited via ionized PVD/CVD with complete sidewall coverage (>40% bottom step coverage) prior to WF6 reduction tungsten fill.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Regrowth of native silicon dioxide (SiO2 > 0.8 nm) under ambient cleanroom humidity, resulting in non-ohmic contact behavior, interface trap escalation, and a >300% surge in bitline contact series resistance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical verification signoff and silicon validation report for the shared bitline contact (BLC) and capacitor bottom-electrode (BC) via layout polygons in 180nm 8F^2 DRAM cell array, satisfying zero DRC/LVS violations, complete optical proximity correction (OPC) rule adherence, and compliant electrical contact resistance.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_blc_bc_polygon_drc_lvs_report.pdf`
- [ ] `blc_bc_kelvin_contact_resistance_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `cd_sem_via_profile_inspection_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **W-plug specific contact resistance for shared bitline contact to active diffusion pad** | `85.0` | ± 20.0 Ohms | Automated 4-wire Kelvin structure DC parametric measurement on Keysight B1500A |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Via critical dimension (bottom CD) after reactive ion etch for BC and BLC polygons** | `180.0` | +10.0 / -10.0 nm | Top-down CD-SEM metrology across 100 array sites per wafer |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Inter-via dielectric leakage current between shared BLC and adjacent capacitor bottom electrode at 3.3V bias** | `1.5` | < 10.0 pA | Sub-picoamp DC leakage sweep on comb-serpentine test array |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> GDSII layout demonstrates 0 DRC errors, 0 ERC errors, 0 LVS mismatches under open-source/commercial design rule decks, with all Kelvin contact resistance values within specification across a minimum of 3 test coupon wafers, confirmed by written multi-agent council consensus.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Document Identification - **Title**: Contact Resistance & Overlay Error Parasitic RC Extraction Verification - **Module Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout [Circuit Design] > 8F² Folded Bitline Unit Cell Layout & Shared Contact Placement [Circuit Design] > Shared Bitline Contact & Capacitor Bottom-Electrode Via Landing Layout [Circuit Design] > Contact Resistance & Overlay Error Parasitic RC Extraction Verification [Metrology] - **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / µm node) - **Action Type**: Make / Verification --- ## 1. Overview & Scope This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the metrology, parasitic extraction (PEX), and TCAD/EDA verification methodology for the shared bitline contact (W-plug) and bottom-electrode capacitor via landing in an 8F² folded bitline 1T1C DRAM unit cell matrix. The procedure validates contact resistance ($R_c$), overlay displacement errors ($\Delta x, \Delta y$), and associated line-to-line parasitic capacitances ($C_{BL}$, $C_s$) against signal sensing margins and retention specifications. ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Layout Design Inspection (GDSII/OASIS)
Pitch: 360 nm - 400 nm"] --> B["Overlay Error Injection & Boundary Corner Generation
(±15 nm Translation)"] B --> C["Full-Wave / 3D Field Solver Parasitic RC Extraction
(W-Plug & MIM Landing Pad)"] C --> D["Electrical Rule Check & Differential Sensing Signal Modeling
ΔV Verification"] D --> E{"Acceptance Criteria Met?"} E -- Yes --> F["Approve Contact & Via Landing GDS Mask Layer"] E -- No --> G["Flag DR/PEX Violation & Adjust Landing Enclosure"] ``` --- ## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure ### Step 1: Design Rule & Geometry Ingestion 1. Ingest GDSII/OASIS layout data for the 8F² memory cell array. 2. Verify nominal critical dimensions: - Access transistor channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$. - Access transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$. - Array bitline (BL) and wordline (WL) pitch: $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$. 3. Verify shared bitline drain contact placement between adjacent access transistor pairs and bottom-electrode storage node contact (via landing) pads above the respective source diffusions. ### Step 2: Overlay Margin & Misalignment Modeling 1. Run multi-corner lithographic overlay corner generation representing worst-case mask-to-mask misalignments between: - Active Area (OD) to Tungsten Contact Plug (W-plug / Contact 0). - Bitline (M1/BL) to shared W-plug. - Storage Node Contact via landing to Crown/Cylinder bottom-electrode base. 2. Extract the minimum physical landing enclosure and contact area under $\pm 15\text{ nm}$ 3-sigma overlay shifts across $X$ and $Y$ cartesian vectors. ### Step 3: 3D Field-Solver Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) 1. Run quasi-static 3D field-solver extraction on the cell matrix with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) configuration: - Dielectric model: High-$k$ capacitor dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, using ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$). - Contact resistivity model: Specific contact resistivity of W-plug to active diffusion and metal interface. 2. Extract total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$), coupling capacitance between adjacent bitlines, and the storage node capacitance ($C_s$). 3. Extract effective series contact resistance ($R_{cont}$) across the access transistor source/drain paths. ### Step 4: Sense Amplifier Margin & RC Timing Verification 1. Feed extracted parasitic RC netlists into the folded-bitline sense amplifier testbench. 2. Set precharge condition to $V_{pre} = V_{DD} / 2$ via the equalization transistor network. 3. Simulate wordline assertion, charge transfer $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$, and signal development: $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$ 4. Verify that signal development delay ($\tau = R_{cont} \cdot C_s$) does not clip the available sensing window prior to sense amplifier latching activation ($\text{SAN} / \text{SAP}$). --- ## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics | Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Minimum Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Minimum design floor: $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D PEX Field Solver / High-$k$ MIM Metrology | | **Total Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped Parasitic RC Extraction across BL Run | | **Differential Sensing Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded Bitline Sense Amp SPICE Simulation | | **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Subthreshold & Junction TCAD / Leakage PEX | | **Data Retention Interval ($T_{ref}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Circuit Charge Decay Dynamic Analysis | --- ## 4. Context References & Literature Citations - **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* - Verified values: Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); 8F² folded bitline with COB; High-$k$ dielectric stack with $\kappa > 15$; Capacitance target $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; Subthreshold/junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$. - **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* - Verified values: Storage capacitance range $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$; Retention time $> 64\text{ ms at } 85^\circ\text{C}$; $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$; Array bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$. - **Source 3**: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* - Verified values: Precharge voltage $= V_{DD} / 2$; Differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; Nominal bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$; Differential signal development margin $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$. --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting parasitic RC across the 8F2 folded bitline matrix must account for non-ideal contact resistance (Rc) and lithographic overlay offset between the bitline contact (BLC) / capacitor bottom-electrode via (SNEC) and the underlying active diffusion/wordline. An unmitigated overlay error Delta_x/Delta_y exceeding 25 nm shrinks the effective contact overlap area by >15%, inducing asymmetric bitline parasitic RC unbalance between true and complementary bitline pairs (BL/BL_bar), which directly degrades the sense amplifier differential sensing margin below the 60 mV threshold. - **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, specific contact resistivity (rho_c) between Ti/TiN liner/W-plug and N+/P+ diffusion must remain <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2, yielding per-contact resistance Rc < 10 Ohm. Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) structures (W=100 um, spacing d=5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um) must be coupled with Kelvin resistor structures and optical/SEM overlay targets. If in-situ Ar sputter etch or dilute HF oxide strip prior to Ti liner CVD/PVD is incomplete, native oxide regrowth (>1.2 nm) will spike rho_c above 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2, inflating the bitline RC propagation delay (tau = R_BL * C_BL) beyond the 4.5 ns access window. - **Supply Chain Critic**: Standardizing metrology on automated 4-point probe stations, parameter analyzers (Keysight B1500A/Keithley 4200-SCS), and CD-SEM/optical overlay tools requires standard probe cards and calibration reticles that avoid proprietary vendor lock-in. Sourcing Semiconductor Grade SEMI C12 dilute HF and Ultra-High Purity 99.999% forming gas (N2/H2 95%/5%) from regional distributors in Vietnam/ASEAN is essential to maintain domestic fab feasibility for the open-source DRAM Foundation VN initiative. - **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test structure scribe-line real estate and automated parametric test time on scribe-line TLM pads must be balanced against die yield. Parametric sweep routines across 5-pad TLM arrays must execute in <45 seconds per wafer field across 9 sites per 200mm wafer to prevent metrology bottlenecks from delaying the post-metallization sintering sign-off and subsequent back-end interconnect passivation tapeout. **Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**: 1. Interfacial native SiO2 regrowth or silicide voiding leading to rho_c > 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2 and per-contact Rc > 25 Ohm. 1. BLC-to-active area overlay shift > 35 nm causing sidewall shorting or severe contact area pinching with parasitic RC unbalance Delta_tau > 15% between BL and BL_bar. 1. Forming gas sinter temperature/ambient drift (<380°C or O2 contamination >10 ppm) preventing Ti-silicide contact annealing and leaving unpassivated dangling bond trap states. ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench) | Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-3-01` | **Automated Kelvin & TLM Specific Contact Resistivity (rho_c) Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with semi-automated probe station (Cascade Microtech Summit 12000) and low-noise probe card | 1. Load 200mm wafer onto chuck and align to optical scribe-line TLM macro (Pad W=100 um, L_pad=50 um, gaps d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um).\n2. Apply 4-wire Kelvin DC current force from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 uA steps across adjacent pad pairs for each gap d.\n3. Measure differential voltage drop V_meas and compute total resistance R_T = V_meas / I_force for each gap.\n4. Perform least-squares linear regression of R_T versus d: extract slope (R_s / W), Y-intercept (2 * R_c), and transfer length L_T = -X_intercept / 2.\n5. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Pass: Single-contact resistance R_c < 10.0 Ohm, linear regression R^2 >= 0.998, and specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2 across all 9 sample sites. Fail if rho_c > 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2.` | | `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-2-3-02` | **Contact-to-Active Overlay Error Offset & Parasitic Capacitance Unbalance Extraction** | KLA Archer Optical Overlay Metrology Tool and CD-SEM (Hitachi S-9380) coupled with high-frequency LCR meter (Keysight E4980A at 1 MHz) | 1. Load wafer into optical overlay tool and acquire overlay vector shifts (Delta_x, Delta_y) between Contact layer and Active Area (OD) layer across 13 field points.\n2. critics.systems_engineer: Extracting parasitic RC across the 8F2 folded bitline matrix must account for non-ideal contact resistance (Rc) and lithographic overlay offset between the bitline contact (BLC) / capacitor bottom-electrode via (SNEC) and the underlying active diffusion/wordline. An unmitigated overlay error Delta_x/Delta_y exceeding 25 nm shrinks the effective contact overlap area by >15%, inducing asymmetric bitline parasitic RC unbalance between true and complementary bitline pairs (BL/BL_bar), which directly degrades the sense amplifier differential sensing margin below the 60 mV threshold.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm node, specific contact resistivity (rho_c) between Ti/TiN liner/W-plug and N+/P+ diffusion must remain <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2, yielding per-contact resistance Rc < 10 Ohm. Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) structures (W=100 um, spacing d=5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um) must be coupled with Kelvin resistor structures and optical/SEM overlay targets. If in-situ Ar sputter etch or dilute HF oxide strip prior to Ti liner CVD/PVD is incomplete, native oxide regrowth (>1.2 nm) will spike rho_c above 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2, inflating the bitline RC propagation delay (tau = R_BL * C_BL) beyond the 4.5 ns access window.
critics.supply_chain: Standardizing metrology on automated 4-point probe stations, parameter analyzers (Keysight B1500A/Keithley 4200-SCS), and CD-SEM/optical overlay tools requires standard probe cards and calibration reticles that avoid proprietary vendor lock-in. Sourcing Semiconductor Grade SEMI C12 dilute HF and Ultra-High Purity 99.999% forming gas (N2/H2 95%/5%) from regional distributors in Vietnam/ASEAN is essential to maintain domestic fab feasibility for the open-source DRAM Foundation VN initiative.
critics.laya_pm: Test structure scribe-line real estate and automated parametric test time on scribe-line TLM pads must be balanced against die yield. Parametric sweep routines across 5-pad TLM arrays must execute in <45 seconds per wafer field across 9 sites per 200mm wafer to prevent metrology bottlenecks from delaying the post-metallization sintering sign-off and subsequent back-end interconnect passivation tapeout.
critical_failure_modes: Interfacial native SiO2 regrowth or silicide voiding leading to rho_c > 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2 and per-contact Rc > 25 Ohm.
BLC-to-active area overlay shift > 35 nm causing sidewall shorting or severe contact area pinching with parasitic RC unbalance Delta_tau > 15% between BL and BL_bar.
Forming gas sinter temperature/ambient drift (<380°C or O2 contamination >10 ppm) preventing Ti-silicide contact annealing and leaving unpassivated dangling bond trap states.

testcases.title: Automated Kelvin & TLM Specific Contact Resistivity (rho_c) Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with semi-automated probe station (Cascade Microtech Summit 12000) and low-noise probe card
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer processed through Contact Hole Etch, Ti/TiN barrier liner deposition, W-plug CMP, Metal 1 patterning, and 400°C forming gas anneal (N2/H2 95%/5%). Ambient temperature stabilized at 25°C ± 0.5°C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load 200mm wafer onto chuck and align to optical scribe-line TLM macro (Pad W=100 um, L_pad=50 um, gaps d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um).
2. Apply 4-wire Kelvin DC current force from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 uA steps across adjacent pad pairs for each gap d.
3. Measure differential voltage drop V_meas and compute total resistance R_T = V_meas / I_force for each gap.
4. Perform least-squares linear regression of R_T versus d: extract slope (R_s / W), Y-intercept (2 * R_c), and transfer length L_T = -X_intercept / 2.
5. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass: Single-contact resistance R_c < 10.0 Ohm, linear regression R^2 >= 0.998, and specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2 across all 9 sample sites. Fail if rho_c > 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm^2.

```text
  [GDSII / OASIS Array Layout]
               │
               ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │ 1. Boundary & Pin Setup │  ─── 8F² Folded Bitline Unit Cell (0.259 µm², L=180nm, W=220nm)
  └────────────┬────────────┘
               │
               ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │ 2. Rule-Deck LVS Check  │  ─── Shared bitline contact extraction & 1T1C netlist mapping
  └────────────┬────────────┘
               │
               ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │ 3. PEX (R+C+CC) Run     │  ─── Storage node Cs & bitline coupling parasitic extraction
  └────────────┬────────────┘
               │
               ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │ 4. Read Margin Analysis │  ─── Evaluate Cb/Cs ratio & signal development (ΔV >= 100 mV)
  └────────────┬────────────┘
               │
               ▼
  [Pass / Sign-off Verification]
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governs the rule-deck-based Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification, 3D/2.5D Parasitic Extraction (PEX), and capacitive noise immunity analysis for an open-source 180nm Gen 2 ($F = 180\text{ nm}$) $8F^2$ folded bitline 1T1C DRAM unit cell matrix.

---

### 2. Physical Parameters & Process Rules
- **Technology Node ($F$):** $180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ µm}$).
- **Unit Cell Layout Footprint:** $8F^2 = 8 \times (0.180\text{ µm})^2 = 0.259\text{ µm}^2$ (Folded Bitline architecture).
- **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Contact Architecture:** Shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) between adjacent dual cells.
- **Storage Capacitor ($C_s$):** Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM cell using ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
- **Array Bitline Parasitics:** 256 to 512 cells per bitline segment yielding total $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$.
- **Bitline Precharge Level:** $V_{\text{pre}} = V_{DD} / 2$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Geometry Definition & Boundary Snapping
1. Load the layout cell database containing the $2 \times 2$ mini-matrix ($8F^2$ folded bitline structure).
2. Validate bounding box coordinates to ensure strict boundary snapping at unit cell pitch:
   $$\text{Area} = 0.259\text{ µm}^2$$
3. Confirm access NMOS drawn channel dimensions are exactly $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
4. Verify shared bitline diffusion contact placement between two adjacent memory cells to enforce shared contact boundary conditions.

#### Step 2: LVS Connectivity & Device Recognition
1. Execute the calibrated 180nm DRAM LVS rule deck.
2. Verify pin and terminal mapping:
   - Wordline gate input ($\text{WL}$).
   - Bitline node ($\text{BL}$ and complementary $/BL$).
   - Storage node node ($\text{SN}$).
   - Capacitor plate top electrode bias node ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{DD}/2$).
3. Ensure the LVS engine successfully recognizes the stacked 1T1C topology without floating node errors or soft-tie substrate mismatches.

#### Step 3: Parasitic Extraction (PEX: $R + C + CC$)
1. Run field-solver parasitic extraction targeting distributed resistance ($R$), ground capacitance ($C$), and cross-coupling capacitance ($CC$).
2. Extract the physical storage node capacitance ($C_s$) formed by the stacked crown/MIM capacitor and storage node contact plug.
3. Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$ or $C_{BL}$) including:
   - Bitline-to-substrate capacitance.
   - Bitline-to-wordline crossover coupling.
   - Adjacent bitline-to-bitline coupling ($C_{BL-BL}$).
4. Calculate the bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio:
   $$R_C = \frac{C_b}{C_s}$$

#### Step 4: Capacitive Noise Immunity & Read Margin Verification
1. Export the extracted netlist into the transient simulation deck with bitline precharge initialized to $V_{DD}/2$.
2. Simulate dynamic wordline assertion and calculate differential read signal voltage ($\Delta V$):
   $$\Delta V = \left( \frac{C_s}{C_b + C_s} \right) \cdot \left| V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2} \right|$$
3. Verify that $\Delta V$ meets minimum sensing threshold margins prior to sense amplifier latch activation ($\text{SAN}/\text{SAP}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Minimum | Nominal / Target | Maximum | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Physical Footprint | — | `0.259` | `0.259` | $\text{µm}^2$ | Automated DRC/GDSII Bounding Box Check |
| **AC-02** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | `25.0` | `28.0` | `30.0` | $\text{fF}$ | 3D PEX Field Solver Extraction |
| **AC-03** | Total Bitline Parasitics ($C_b$) | `150.0` | — | `250.0` | $\text{fF}$ | 256/512-cell Block PEX Netlist Extraction |
| **AC-04** | Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | `5.0 : 1` | — | `9.0 : 1` | — | Post-PEX Automated Ratio Calculation |
| **AC-05** | Differential Read Signal Window ($\Delta V$) | `100.0` | — | `150.0` | $\text{mV}$ | Post-Layout Transient SPICE Simulation |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  - $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint $= 0.259\text{ µm}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  - $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline).
  - Capacitance ratio constraint: $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($>10:1$ causes severe read margin failure).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between adjacent dual cells.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM structure with high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Storage capacitance requirement $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ for noise immunity against coupling and soft errors.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Folded bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Charge sharing signal development equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Resulting differential signal window $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |
