# SOP: 180nm 8F² 1T1C Layout-vs-Schematic (LVS) Rule Deck Calibration & Device Recognition

## 1. Overview & Workflow Diagram
This standard operating procedure defines the calibration, device recognition equations, and netlist validation flow for verifying a 180nm $8F^2$ 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor (1T1C) folded bitline DRAM unit cell array against its schematic netlist.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Ingestion and   │
│    Layer Derivation    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Access Transistor    │
│      Recognition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Stacked Capacitor    │
│    COB Recognition     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LVS Deck Calibration  │
│     and Comparison     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Physical Layer Boolean Derivation & Connectivity Mapping
1. Import target GDSII cell stream containing active diffusion (`DIFF`), polysilicon wordline (`POLY`), bitline contact/metal (`M1`/`BL`), tungsten plug (`W-PLUG`), stacked capacitor bottom/top plates (`SN`/`PLATE`), and dielectric layers.
2. Formulate LVS layer derivation rules:
   - Channel region: `GATE = POLY AND DIFF`
   - Source/Drain diffusion: `SD = DIFF NOT POLY`
   - Shared bitline diffusion contact: `BL_DIFF_CONT = SD AND CONTACT AND BL` (connected between two adjacent memory cells)
   - Storage node drain node: `SN_DIFF_CONT = SD AND W_PLUG`

### Step 2: Access Transistor Device Recognition & Pinning
1. Define the 1T NMOS access transistor recognition statement:
   - Identify terminal connectivity: Source $\rightarrow$ `BL_DIFF_CONT`, Drain $\rightarrow$ `SN_DIFF_CONT`, Gate $\rightarrow$ `POLY` (Wordline), Bulk $\rightarrow$ Substrate/P-Well.
2. Calibrate parameter measurement deck calculations:
   - Channel Length ($L$): Measure edge length along active channel orthogonal to gate width. Target $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Channel Width ($W$): Measure active width across transistor channel. Target $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure tolerance matching window in LVS deck is calibrated to $\pm 0\% - \pm 1\%$ on extracted geometric ratios.

### Step 3: Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) Stacked Capacitor Recognition
1. Recognize the 1C storage element across stacked capacitor layers:
   - Terminal 1 (Storage Node): Connected to drain via tungsten plug (`W-PLUG`).
   - Terminal 2 (Cell Plate): Connected to common plate reference node `V_PLATE`.
   - Dielectric region: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack ($k > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
2. Formulate capacitance parameter extraction equation based on crown/cylinder 3D height, perimeter, and projected surface area.

### Step 4: LVS Deck Rule Calibration & Netlist Comparison Execution
1. Run hierarchical LVS extraction over a $1\text{k}\times 1\text{k}$ unit cell matrix array with folded bitline topology (alternating cells sharing bitline contact).
2. Execute pin-to-pin, port-to-port, and parameter cross-checking against the SPICE circuit netlist (verifying complementary `BL` / `/BL` architecture and wordline matrices).
3. Confirm zero false-positive opens/shorts generated from shared contact geometries.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Tool / Deck Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid discrepancy) | LVS Geometric Parameter Extractor |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid discrepancy) | LVS Geometric Parameter Extractor |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (Minimum $\ge 28\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25\text{ fF/cell}$ | Extracted Parasitic & 3D Capacitance Deck |
| **Bitline & Wordline Matrix Pitch** | $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ | In-range ($360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$) | LVS Pitch & DRC-in-LVS Rule Check |
| **Access Transistor Leakage Current at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ | Max $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Post-LVS SPICE Simulation Check |

---

## 4. Source Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout configuration: Shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-k dielectric: ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $k > 15$.
  - Minimum noise immunity capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage current budget: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Architecture: 1T1C $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout.
  - Storage capacitance retention range: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Array pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness $\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded-bitline cross-coupled sensing topology with nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ generating signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM matrix at the 180nm node (F=180nm, cell area 0.259 µm²), LVS recognition cannot treat the storage node trench/stacked capacitor as a generic two-terminal MIM or MOS capacitor. The deck must strictly distinguish the storage node plate node (SN) tied to the access transistor source/drain from the common plate node (V_PLATE = VDD/2). Failure to extract multi-layer parasitic coupling between adjacent bitlines (BL/BL_bar) and storage nodes yields false LVS matching while masking capacitive cross-talk and read-disturb vulnerabilities in post-layout simulation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical device recognition in open-source EDA (KLayout DRC/LVS, Magic, or Netgen) for 180nm 8F2 relies on strict Boolean layer operations (Active AND Poly NOT Contact) to form access NFETs and capacitor dielectric overlap recognition. Because the shared bitline contact spans two adjacent cell pass gates, standard generic CMOS LVS decks will misidentify the pass transistor as a standard 4-terminal logic NFET unless custom subcircuit pin definitions, deep N-well/substrate isolation, and 3D trench/stack contact markers are properly mapped. Furthermore, threshold voltage adjustments (Vth implant layers) must be parsed to avoid swapping core access FETs with peripheral CMOS.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard open-source PDKs (e.g., SkyWater 180nm / open-source 180nm foundry equivalents) lack native DRAM cell capacitor extraction rules. Calibration requires open-source LVS scripts (Python/Ruby KLayout db/rba decks) matched against standard GDSII test structures, requiring specialized metrology calibration test chips and automated CI/CD regression setups rather than proprietary commercial Calibre/PVS tool suites.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibrating custom 180nm LVS recognition rules for 8F2 1T1C matrices is often bottlenecked by ambiguous boundary conditions at the edge dummy cells and bitline twisting regions. The team must freeze the GDSII layer map specification, pin naming semantics, and unit cell hierarchy before running extraction regressions to prevent iterative redesign cycles between array layout designers and metrology engineers.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Shorting of the floating storage node (SN) to the global V_PLATE line in extracted netlist due to missing isolation Boolean operations in the capacitor top-plate recognition layer.
1. False 'LVS Clean' status masked by Netgen/KLayout net merging when shared bitline contact nodes are symmetrically swapped across wordline access gates.
1. Miscalculation of storage capacitance (target ~25-30 fF/cell) due to 2D planar perimeter/area extraction ignoring 3D capacitor aspect ratio and trench/cup sidewall area.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-3-1-01` | **8F2 1T1C Unit Cell and 2x2 Sub-Array Device Recognition & Connectivity Verification** | KLayout LVS Engine (v0.28+), Netgen Netlist Comparator (v1.5+), SPICE Golden Schematic Netlist Parser | 1. Compile the calibrated KLayout LVS rule deck defining Boolean layer extractions for access NFETs, storage capacitor (C_CELL), shared bitline contacts, and plate interconnects. 2. Execute flat and hierarchical LVS extraction on the 2x2 test cell GDSII. 3. Run Netgen graph isomorphism comparison between the extracted SPICE netlist and the schematic netlist. 4. Verify node naming, terminal connectivity, and zero topological discrepancies. | `Netgen comparison output reports: 'Circuits match uniquely.' Discrepancy count = 0 (unmatched nets = 0, unmatched devices = 0, swapped pins = 0).` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-1-3-1-02` | **Extracted Capacitance and Access Transistor W/L Parameter Extraction Accuracy** | Calibrated Optical Profilometer / AFM Metrology Calibration Dataset, KLayout DRC/LVS Geometric Extractor, ngspice (v39+) | 1. Execute the LVS rule deck with parasitic extraction mode enabled. 2. Query extracted device parameter values (W, L of pass gate; C_val of C_CELL) from the generated .spice file. 3. Compare extracted geometric W, L, and calculated capacitance against physical layout drawn dimensions and target dielectric model equations. 4. Run 100-cycle transient read/write Monte Carlo simulation in ngspice using the extracted netlist. | `Extracted access transistor gate dimensions: W = 180.0 nm (±3.6 nm), L = 180.0 nm (±3.6 nm); extracted cell capacitance: 28.0 fF (±5.0%); SPICE transient simulation verifies non-destructive read sense margin > 150 mV across bitline pair.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD wrist strap and grounding cord, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, 4 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Standard ESD-safe lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA: Flush with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water for 15 minutes at eyewash station and remove contact lenses if present. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology bench requires laminar flow hood (Class 100 / ISO 5) with certified HEPA filtration and localized dedicated exhaust ducting for solvent cleaning benches (minimum face velocity 100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent isopropanol in labeled, grounded flammables waste containers. Do not discharge into municipal drains. Liquid waste to be disposed of via licensed hazardous solvent waste management contractor.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, optical inspection/wafer cleaning solvent)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI Water, wafer rinse)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-metal/dielectric chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) surface cleaned, dried, and verified free of slurry particulates or surface native oxide regrowth.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned wafer coupon sealed in sealed anti-static nitrogen dry pack with relative humidity < 5% prior to electrical micro-probing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled ambient humidity exposure induces moisture condensation and surface ionic contamination, causing leakage paths (> 10 pA) across the unpassivated 180nm storage node contact pads and skewing LVS parametric test coupon electrical calibration.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated open-source LVS rule deck for the 180nm 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cell successfully identifies access NFETs, storage node capacitances, shared bitline contacts, and plate lines without topological ambiguities or parameter false alarms.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_8f2_unitcell_lvs.lyd`
- [ ] `lvs_extraction_report_2x2_matrix.pdf`
- [ ] `parametric_device_recognition_log.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Netgen and KLayout graph isomorphism mismatch count between 8F2 schematic and layout netlist** | `0` | 0 | Automated Netgen flat/hierarchical netlist comparison against golden SPICE cell definition |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Extracted storage node cell capacitance value for 180nm 8F2 cell footprint** | `28.0 fF` | ±1.4 fF | KLayout geometric parameter extractor output checked via automated CSV parsing against analytical 3D capacitive model |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Access transistor extracted channel width (W) and channel length (L)** | `180.0 nm` | ±2.0 nm | Automated regression script parsing extracted SPICE device statements across 1024 array cells |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires 100% clean LVS run on an 8x8 DRAM cell array test vehicle with zero unmatched ports, nets, or devices, accompanied by signed automated LVS log and parametric verification CSV confirming geometric tolerances within ±2nm.

# SOP: Full 3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (PEX) for Bitline Coupling & Cell Capacitance

**Module:** Circuit Design & Metrology / 180nm Open-Source DRAM (`8F²` Folded Bitline Unit Cell)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Workflow Architecture & Execution Lifecycle

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   8F2 Folded BL Unit   │
│      Cell Layout       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3D Process Profile &  │
│      Dielectrics       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Conformal Meshing    │
│   W-Plug & Crown MIM   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Full 3D Poisson     │
│      Field Solver      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Conductor     │
│   Matrix Extraction    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Verification: Cs,    │
│     C_BL, Delta V      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Perform rigorous electrostatic 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) for the 180nm $8F^2$ folded-bitline unit cell and adjacent memory array matrix. This procedure quantifies storage capacitor capacitance ($C_s$), bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$), and line-to-line bitline crosstalk coupling capacitance ($C_{BL-BL}$ / $C_{BL-\overline{BL}}$) to ensure read sensing margin and refresh retention stability.

---

### 2. Standard Operating Procedure (Step-by-Step)

#### Step 1: Geometry & Layout Ingestion
1. Import the verified post-LVS physical design GDSII/OASIS stream of the $8F^2$ folded bitline unit cell (including shared bitline contacts between adjacent access transistors with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
2. Instantiate a $3 \times 3$ or $5 \times 5$ memory cell array matrix with surrounding complementary bitlines ($BL$, $\overline{BL}$) and passing wordlines ($WL$) to capture periodic boundary fringing fields and adjacent wire crosstalk.

#### Step 2: 3D Process Stack & Material Deck Setup
1. Define the vertical stack profiles:
   - **Substrate & Gate Oxide:** Silicon substrate with thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, formed at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - **Contacts & Routing:** Interlayer dielectric (ILD), bitline shared contact, and tungsten plug (W-plug) connection erected above the drain contact.
   - **Storage Capacitor:** Crown/cylinder-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - **High-$\kappa$ Dielectric:** Assign material properties for ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ thin-film stack with dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 3: Adaptive Mesh Generation & Boundary Discretization
1. Configure conformal adaptive finite-element / boundary-element meshing (FEM/BEM) across the 3D domain.
2. Refine mesh density along high-gradient electrostatic regions: capacitor crown sidewalls, W-plug interfaces, and adjacent bitline sidewalls ($360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$ pitch).
3. Apply periodic boundary conditions on peripheral array boundaries and Dirichlet ground conditions on bulk substrate ($V_{sub} = V_{BB}$) and capacitor plate ($V_{plate} = V_{DD}/2$).

#### Step 4: 3D Field Solver Solution & Capacitance Matrix Formulation
1. Solve the 3D Poisson equation $\nabla \cdot (\varepsilon(r)\nabla V(r)) = 0$ for each conductor node by sequentially applying unit excitation potentials ($1.0\text{ V}$) while grounding all other conductors.
2. Extract the Maxwell multi-conductor capacitance matrix:
   - Self and mutual capacitances for cell node ($C_s$), true bitline ($BL$), complementary bitline ($\overline{BL}$), and wordline ($WL$).
   - Identify coupling capacitance components: $C_{BL-BL}$, $C_{BL-\overline{BL}}$, and $C_{cell-BL}$.

#### Step 5: Read Margin & Latch Sensing Verification
1. Calculate the differential sensing voltage signal developed on the bitline:
   $$\Delta V = \left( \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \right) \cdot \left( V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2} \right)$$
2. Back-annotate the extracted 3D lumped parasitics (SPEF/DSPF format) into the folded-bitline sense amplifier testbench (cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch) to simulate dynamic latching and confirm margin against coupling noise.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25\text{ to }28$ (Minimum $\ge 28$ for high soft-error immunity) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver extracted capacitance on storage node |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Integrated multi-cell column parasitic extraction |
| **Sense Amplifier Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Readout differential signal development across $BL\text{ / }\overline{BL}$ |
| **Cell Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$) | TCAD / SPICE junction leakage characterization |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Data verified:* Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); shared bitline contact in $8F^2$ folded bitline layout; crown polysilicon or MIM capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain via W-plug; high-$\kappa$ dielectric $\kappa > 15$; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; cell leakage $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *Data verified:* Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter sense amplifier; bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$; differential sensing signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ derived from $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Data verified:* 1T1C $8F^2$ cell architecture; cell capacitance target range of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$; retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; crown/cylinder stacked capacitor with $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 180nm architecture, 3D field solver extraction must rigorously capture fringe and intra-layer line-to-line capacitance (C_BL-BL) across adjacent bitlines over full mat columns. If the parasitic ratio C_BL / C_cell exceeds 10:1 (targeting C_cell >= 25 fF and C_BL <= 250 fF), the sense amplifier differential signal margin Delta V_sense = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_BL / C_cell) collapses below the 90 mV regenerative trigger threshold, jeopardizing destructive read charge restoration during active column select activation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline overdrive with V_PP ~ 2.5V-2.8V introduces severe gate-to-diffusion overlap fringe fields and storage node parasitic feedthrough. Standard 2.5D corner extraction tools drastically underestimate the 3D corner fringing between planar stacked MIM/PIP storage node bottom plates and adjacent passing bitline metal lines (M1/M2). A full electrostatic Poisson 3D field solver (e.g., FasterCap / Raphael / StarRC-3D) boundary element meshing is strictly required to capture the ~1.2 fF/um sidewall coupling and ensure V_PP non-overlap switching does not dynamically couple excess charge into adjacent unselected bitlines.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source EDA toolchains for 3D boundary element meshing (such as FasterCap/FastCap2) have compute-cluster hardware dependencies requiring high memory footprints (>= 128 GB RAM for 8x8 cell sub-arrays) and lack standardized, foundry-certified PDK technology process stack decks for open-source 180nm nodes, necessitating manual extraction deck calibration against TSMC/TowerJazz/SkyWater 130-180nm baseline silicon data to avoid multi-month tape-out respins.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PEX 3D mesh convergence runs present schedule bottlenecks in Gen 2 milestones; full cell-matrix extraction runtimes must be budgeted within 48-hour turnarounds per iterative LVS cycle. Hierarchical extraction boundaries must freeze bitline pitch at 2F (0.36 um) and capacitor contact plugs at M1 interfaces without stalling parallel sense amplifier layout signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic capacitive crosstalk coupling (Delta V_cross > 35 mV) from switching adjacent bitlines during precharge release, causing single-bit flip errors during differential amplification.
1. Underestimation of storage node-to-substrate parasitic depletion capacitance, leading to premature retention failure (< 64 ms at 85 deg C) under nominal V_PP boost write cycles.
1. Over-meshed boundary element matrix singularities at 3D sharp-corner capacitor plug edges, leading to non-physical negative mutual capacitance or divergence in FastCap/FasterCap matrix inversion.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP Title: Post-Layout Bitline Crosstalk Noise Immunity & Differential Sensing Margin Verification
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM180-MET-007`  
**Classification:** Metrology & Verification / 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow & Verification Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Post-Layout       │
│  Parasitic Extraction  │
│          PEX           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Bitline Capacitive   │
│   Matrix Extraction    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Worst-Case Crosstalk  │
│    Noise Injection     │
│       Simulation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Differential Signal   │
│     Margin Delta V     │
│       Evaluation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sense Amplifier     │
│  Latch Timing Margin   │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) of 8F² Folded Bitline Array:**
   - Execute 3D field-solver parasitic extraction on the layout database containing the 180nm access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contacts, and stacked capacitor structures over bitline (COB).
   - Generate an extracted distributed $RC$ netlist modeling intra-bitline capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$), inter-bitline coupling capacitances ($C_{\text{BL-BL}}$), wordline-to-bitline overlap capacitance ($C_{\text{WL-BL}}$), and cell node parasitic capacitance.

2. **Bitline Precharge & Equalization Initialization:**
   - Configure transient testbench with complementary folded bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) biased through the equalization network to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$.
   - Confirm common-mode voltage stabilization across complementary pairs prior to wordline activation.

3. **Worst-Case Crosstalk Pattern Setup:**
   - Setup adjacent aggressor bitline pairs switching synchronously (e.g., adjacent columns discharging to evaluate capacitive coupling into quiet victim complementary pair $BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Apply worst-case temperature corner at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to capture sub-threshold leakage effects ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).

4. **Charge Sharing & Signal Development Simulation:**
   - Assert wordline to turn on the access transistor, transferring stored charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ into the victim bitline.
   - Measure developed differential voltage $\Delta V$ across $BL$ and $/BL$ before sense amplifier firing using the relationship:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right|$$

5. **Sense Amplifier Latching & Noise Margin Verification:**
   - Fire sense amplifier strobe signals (`SAN` pulling low and `SAP` pulling high).
   - Verify that sense latch resolves without bit-flip or metastability under worst-case crosstalk injected noise across all corners ($SS$, $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Constraint |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `25.0 to 30.0` (minimum `28.0` baseline) | $\text{fF}$ | $\ge 25.0\text{ fF/cell}$ (Retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Total Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | `250.0` | $\text{fF}$ | Nominal extraction limit per sensing segment |
| **Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | `100.0 to 150.0` | $\text{mV}$ | Minimum $\ge 100.0\text{ mV}$ prior to latch activation |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Current at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum upper bound at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited

1. **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**  
   - *Differential Sensing Equation & Signal Level:* $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.  
   - *Nominal Parasitics:* Typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal margin $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$. Precharge equalized to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$.

2. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
   - *Device Dimensions:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.  
   - *Noise Immunity & Leakage Budget:* Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against coupling capacitance; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**  
   - *Capacitance & Retention Target:* Storage capacitance of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ in an 8F² folded bitline layout with $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Bitline parasitic capacitance (C_b) in this 180nm 8F2 folded bitline array must be constrained below 225 fF across 512 cells/bitline to preserve the C_b/C_s ratio below 8:1 with C_s = 28 fF. The differential read voltage signal ΔV = (C_s / (C_b + C_s)) * (V_DD / 2) yields only 100.7 mV at V_DD = 1.8V nominal. Post-layout interconnect coupling between adjacent active bitline pairs and orthogonal wordlines induces dynamic cross-talk (V_xtalk) that threatens to swallow the cross-coupled sense amplifier offset margin (V_os <= 25 mV) if inter-metal dielectric (IMD) fringing fields exceed 15% of total bitline capacitance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Folded bitline architecture intrinsically provides common-mode rejection of wordline-to-bitline pass-through capacitance (C_wl-bl), but adjacent bitline-to-bitline coupling (C_bl-bl) in dense Metal 1 routing (pitch ~360 nm) creates severe worst-case read degradation during solid-state data pattern transitions (e.g., victim cell reading data '0' while adjacent aggressor bitlines transition to '1'). At 180nm node design rules, twisted bitline architecture is omitted due to area penalties; therefore, post-layout RC parasitic extraction (PEX) must include rigorous 3D field-solver corner models (C_max/R_min and C_min/R_max) to guarantee differential sensing margin ΔV_diff >= 65 mV post-crosstalk.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology verification depends on open-source PDK extraction toolchains (Magic/KLayout/Netgen/OpenRCX) calibrated against 180nm multi-project wafer (MPW) foundry PCM (Process Control Monitor) split-lots. Any variance in inter-layer dielectric thickness (SiO2/FSG) or metal line edge roughness (LER) from regional foundry back-end-of-line (BEOL) runs alters C_bl-bl by up to ±18%, directly threatening yield without pre-calibrated PDK extraction rule decks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off for this work package gates physical tapeout freeze for the DRAM sub-array sense amplifier tile. We must enforce automated regression runs across all 4 process corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) and temperature extremes (-40°C to +105°C) to prevent delay in wafer fabrication slot reservation. Post-layout extraction signoff must be delivered within the 2-week milestone window with full differential sensing margin compliance.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Bitline Crosstalk Induced Sensing Inversion: Adjacent switching bitlines couple >35 mV into the victim bitline, collapsing ΔV below sense amplifier input offset (V_os = 25 mV), causing read data corruption.
1. Capacitance Ratio Blowout (C_b/C_s > 9.5:1): Incomplete planarization or tighter-than-expected Metal 1 spacing increases parasitic C_b beyond 265 fF, suppressing developed signal ΔV below 85 mV and causing sensing latch timeouts.
1. Differential Offset Latch Imbalance: Asymmetric parasitic extraction on true bitline (BL) versus complementary bitline (/BL) exceeding 3% capacitance mismatch, creating systematic read bias and retention degradation.

Inhalation: Relocate person to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip) | **Action Type**: Make  
**Document Link**: [`docs/sop_cob_stacked_capacitor_tungsten_bitline.md`](docs/sop_cob_stacked_capacitor_tungsten_bitline.md)

---

### 1. Structural Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Access Transistor    │
│     Active & Gate:     │
│    L=180nm, W=220nm    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Bitline Contact     │
│   Shared Formation:    │
│       W-Plug Via       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Bitline Routing:    │
│   Pitch 360nm-400nm,   │
│     C_b 150-250fF      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   ILD & Storage Node   │
│     W-Plug Contact     │
       Formation        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Crown MIM/Poly     │
│   Stacked Capacitor:   │
│  Ta2O5/ONO, EOT 3-4nm  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Plate Line Node     │
│     Integration &      │
│     C_b/C_s Ratio      │
│      Verification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Access Transistor Channel Sizing & Cell Matrix Layout**:
   - Fabricate 1T1C access NMOS with gate physical length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Grow gate dielectric thermally using dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Layout cell array following folded bitline footprint: $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (or $6F^2 = 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$ for open bitline).

2. **Bitline Contact (BLC) Tungsten Via Formation**:
   - Open contact via shared between two adjacent memory cells landing directly on the common drain junction.
   - Deposit and chemical-mechanical planarize (CMP) a tungsten plug (W-plug) to establish low-resistance ohmic contact.

3. **Bitline (BL) Metallization & Routing (Below Capacitor)**:
   - Pattern bitline routing runs below the storage capacitor tier (Capacitor-Over-Bitline / COB layout).
   - Maintain bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$ (matching wordline pitch at $360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$).
   - Keep total parasitic bitline capacitance ($C_b$) within $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline subarray segment.

4. **Storage Node Contact (SNC) W-Plug Via Integration**:
   - Deposit Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) isolating the bitline stack.
   - Etch vertical vias through ILD landing on the access transistor source nodes, avoiding bitlines.
   - Deposit tungsten contact plug (W-plug) extending up to the base of the storage capacitor.

5. **Crown Stacked Capacitor Fabrication & Plate Integration**:
   - Form crown-shaped polysilicon or Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) bottom electrode storage nodes over the bitlines.
   - Deposit high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer consisting of $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack ($\kappa > 15$) or triple ONO ($\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4/\text{SiO}_2$) with Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Deposit common top plate electrode enclosing the crown arrays.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

C_s Retention┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│

| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28\text{ fF}$ nominal ($\ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$) | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Automated C-V probe on test macro |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1$ to $9:1$ (Strict Max: $< 10:1$) | Dimensionless ratio | In-line parametric read-margin extraction |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Temperature-controlled probe station |
| **Cell Retention Time** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Refresh interval pass/fail test vector |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Shared bitline contact via W-plug; crown polysilicon / MIM structure over bitline (COB).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, ONO); minimum $28\text{ fF}$ capacitance; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ cell architecture; $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell target; data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - EOT $= 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide dry oxidation thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) and open bitline $6F^2$ area ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
  - Nominal $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$; $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells); $C_b / C_s$ ratio constraint between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The COB (Capacitor-Over-Bitline) integration scheme introduces extreme 3D topography over the access transistor and bitline nodes. Placing the storage node plug (W2 contact) directly adjacent to the embedded tungsten bitline (W-BL) requires an aspect ratio exceeding 6:1 for contact etching through TEOS/BPSG inter-layer dielectrics (ILD). System parasitics must be rigorously budgeted: bitline parasitic capacitance (C_BL) must not exceed 18% of storage capacitance (C_s >= 28 fF) to preserve a minimum sensing margin (delta V_BL >= 150 mV) at the sense amplifier array input.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tungsten chemical vapor deposition (CVD) for the shared bitline contact (W1) and capacitor storage node contact (W2) exhibits high susceptibility to volcano defects and wormhole etching if the Ti/TiN adhesion/barrier liner is compromised. The reaction of WF6 with exposed silicon diffusion at 400°C creates volumetric Si consumption and junction leakage surpassing the 1 fA/cell at 85°C ceiling. Furthermore, the high thermal budget of subsequent ONO or high-k (Ta2O5/Al2O3) capacitor crystallization annealing (650°C-750°C) risks TiSi2 phase agglomeration and fluorine out-diffusion from the W-plug.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor logistics for high-purity tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) and silane/dichlorosilane reduction chemistries are constrained in open-source pilot lines. Standardizing on 5N5 electronic-grade WF6 cylinders and ultra-pure atomic layer deposition (ALD) precursors for TiN (such as TDMAT or TiCl4/NH3) requires specialized gas-delivery cabinet infrastructure and certified scrubbers that pose lead-time and regulatory bottlenecks in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The multi-step lithography-etch-clean sequence for self-aligned contact (SAC) definition and chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) of high-aspect-ratio tungsten plugs spans three high-risk tool handoffs. Failure to maintain strict post-CMP scrub and queue times will trigger yield fallout across the 180nm 1T1C matrix layout, jeopardizing the Gen 2 milestone tapeout timeline.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Fluorine encroachment and 'volcano' bursting at the W-plug/TiN/Si contact interface due to localized TiN barrier thinning on high-aspect-ratio contact sidewalls during WF6 reduction.
1. Capacitor-to-bitline inter-level bridging caused by tungsten CMP micro-scratching, slurry recess corrosion, or incomplete dielectric planarization of the BPSG/TEOS stack.
1. Access transistor drain junction degradation induced by post-W metallization thermal stress during capacitor dielectric crystallization anneal, causing retention time collapse below 64 ms.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-01` | **Tungsten Bitline Contact (W1) Specific Contact Resistivity & Resistance Verification** | Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with Kelvin 4-wire probing tips | 1. Land 4-point probe Kelvin tips on the W1-to-N+ diffusion contact test module. 2. Force current I_force from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 uA steps while measuring differential voltage V_sense across the contact interface. 3. Extract contact resistance R_c from dV/dI at V=0V. 4. Step probe array across TLM structures (spacings 5 to 80 um) and record total resistance R_T vs. gap spacing d. 5. Perform linear regression of R_T vs. d to compute slope (R_s/W), transfer length L_T, and specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_s * L_T^2. | `Pass if single-contact resistance R_c <= 45 Ohm per plug (diameter = 220 nm) and specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 2.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2. Fail if R_c > 50 Ohm or if I-V curve exhibits non-ohmic rectifying behavior.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-02` | **COB Storage Node Crown Capacitance & Dielectric Leakage Profiling** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency C-V Measurement Module, shielded Faraday cage | 1. Connect high-force/high-sense terminals to the capacitor top plate and low-force/low-sense to the common storage node access terminal. 2. Apply 100 kHz AC test signal (amplitude 25 mV RMS) while sweeping DC bias voltage from -1.5 V to +1.5 V to record C-V characteristic. 3. Extract unit-cell capacitance C_s = C_measured / 10,000 at operating bias V_cell = 0.9 V. 4. Switch instrument to I-V mode and apply constant stress voltage V_stress = 1.2 V for 60 seconds at 85°C. 5. Measure steady-state leakage current I_leak and normalize per individual 1T1C storage cell. | `Pass if unit-cell capacitance C_s >= 28.0 fF/cell and leakage current I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell at V_cell = 0.9 V, 85°C. Fail if C_s < 26.5 fF/cell or I_leak > 1.5 fA/cell.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B chemical-resistant Neoprene/Butyl dual-layer gloves, Cleanroom acid/fluorine face shield conforming to ANSI Z87.1, Flame-retardant anti-static cleanroom coverall with positive-pressure PAPR respirator adapter during cylinder changeover, Closed-toe ESD safety boots with chemical over-boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF / WF6 dermal exposure: Immediately flush affected tissue with eyewash/drench shower for 5 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until pain subsides; seek immediate medical attention. For WF6 or TiCl4 inhalation: Evacuate worker to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen via positive-demand resuscitator, treat for hydrofluoric acid lung edematous symptoms, and monitor continuously for pulmonary edema for 48 hours.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous toxic gas monitoring (TGMS) with electrochemical sensors calibrated for WF6/HF at 0.5 ppm threshold; dedicated point-of-use thermal-wet burn box scrubbers with exhaust duct velocity >= 1,200 FPM and negative pressure interlocks tied to emergency gas shutoff valves (EGS).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhausted scrubber effluent and CMP wastewater containing tungsten ions and fluoride must be routed to automated fluoride precipitation treatment: lime (Ca(OH)2) dosing to precipitate solid CaF2, followed by coagulant/flocculant sedimentation, neutralizer adjustment to pH 6.5-8.5, and automated heavy-metal Chelex resin capture prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride** | `7783-82-6` | VLSI / 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100% Compressed Liquefied Gas` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Pre-metal native oxide clean)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C12) | `0.5% Aqueous Solution` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiN ALD Precursor)** | `7550-45-0` | Optoelectronic Grade (99.999%) | `100% Liquid` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-cleaned, dilute-HF-etched silicon contact surfaces with native oxide thickness < 0.3 nm, verified via spectral ellipsometry, and moisture-free contact vias.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Chemical mechanical polished tungsten plug surface planarized to within 15 nm step height across array, free of residual slurry particles (< 20 defects/wafer at 0.18 um bin), sealed under N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure beyond 30 minutes causes native oxide regrowth (> 0.8 nm) inside high-aspect-ratio contact vias, spiking contact resistance by > 300% and triggering severe WF6 barrier peeling and interface voiding.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified fabrication and integration of the 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture, incorporating low-resistance tungsten bitline plugs (W1) and crown-shaped stacked storage capacitors (W2) meeting strict cell capacitance and low junction-leakage thresholds.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_BL_Contact_TLM_Resistance_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `COB_Crown_Capacitor_CV_Leakage_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `CrossSection_WPlug_Capacitor_TEM_Micrograph.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Tungsten bitline contact resistance per shared unit-cell plug** | `45.0` | +/- 5.0 Ohm | Four-wire Kelvin structure resistance extraction across 50 test sites per wafer |
| `ASSERT-02` | **COB stacked storage cell capacitance** | `28.5` | +/- 1.5 fF/cell | Multifrequency C-V extraction on 10k-cell test array at 100 kHz, 0.9 V DC bias |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node junction leakage at elevated operating temperature** | `0.85` | <= 1.0 fA/cell | Keysight B1500A sub-pA I-V measurement at 85°C chuck temperature under 1.2 V bias |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires all 50 scribe-line Kelvin test sites passing R_c <= 50 Ohm, mean crown cell capacitance exceeding 28.0 fF with zero array bridges, storage node junction leakage verified < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C, and TEM analysis confirming complete absence of WF6-induced Si-substrate consumption.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shared Bitline Contact Patterning & Tungsten Plug CVD Routing (180nm 1T1C Node)

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Shared BL Contact    │
│    Photolithography    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   High-Aspect-Ratio    │
│      Contact RIE       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ti/TiN Liner CVD/ALD  │
│       Deposition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  WF6/H2 Tungsten Plug  │
│        CVD Fill        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       W Chemical       │
│  Mechanical Polishing  │
│          CMP           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) Deposition & Planarization**:
   - Deposit Pre-Metal Dielectric (PMD/ILD-0) stack covering access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Planarize via oxide CMP to ensure consistent depth to active shared drain/source regions.
2. **Shared Bitline Contact Patterning (Photolithography)**:
   - Apply deep UV (DUV) photoresist with bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC).
   - Expose shared bitline contact hole centered between adjacent access gates at the array design pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
3. **High-Aspect-Ratio Contact (HARC) Reactive Ion Etching (RIE)**:
   - Perform anisotropic oxide dry etch selective to underlying active silicon/salicide and gate spacer nitride.
   - Clean etch polymers with solvent clean and post-etch in-situ plasma strip.
4. **Adhesion & Barrier Liner Deposition**:
   - Deposit thin conformable $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$ barrier layer ($< 10\text{ nm}$) using CVD/ALD to prevent $\text{WF}_6$ encroachment ("wormholes") into silicon active junctions and provide ohmic contact.
5. **Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) CVD Fill**:
   - Initiate silane ($\text{SiH}_4$) or germane nucleation seed step.
   - Perform bulk tungsten plug deposition via hydrogen reduction of tungsten hexafluoride ($\text{WF}_6 + 3\text{H}_2 \rightarrow \text{W} + 6\text{HF}$) until full contact fill and seam-free closure are achieved.
6. **W Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP)**:
   - Polish overburden bulk tungsten and $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$ liner stopping selectivity on the ILD oxide.
   - Post-CMP cleaning to prevent residual tungsten nanoparticle contamination prior to bitline/stacked capacitor routing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │█████████████████████████████████████│
    Pitch (BL/WL)┤█████████████████████████████████████│
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░               │
     Transistor W┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░               │
     Transistor L┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
Max Leakage (85C)┤▓                                    │
                 │▓                                    │
  Min Storage Cap┤████                                 │
                 │████                                 │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       95       190      285     380 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360 to 400` | $\text{nm}$ | Inline Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) |
| **Transistor Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-Sectional TEM / CD-SEM |
| **Minimum Cell Capacitance Budget** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30$ (min $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Prober $C$-$V$ Metrology |
| **Max Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parametric Analyzer / Automated Refresh Interval Test |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Validates unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Confirms shared bitline contact architecture between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Specifies tungsten plug (W-plug) connection routing to crown/MIM capacitor stack.
  - Establishes minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget and junction/sub-threshold leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Validates $8\text{F}^2$ and $6\text{F}^2$ 1T1C layout footprint.
  - Confirms bitline and wordline array pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms baseline storage capacitor requirement of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm 1T1C COB folded bitline matrix, sharing a single bitline contact between two adjacent access transistors reduces cell area toward 8F^2 (~0.26 um^2), but couples parasitic capacitance and series resistance directly into the sensing margin. Tungsten plug resistance R_plug must stay under 25 Ohm per contact to prevent sense-amplifier read degradation and timing skew between paired bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Patterning contact vias at 180nm critical dimension with high aspect ratio (~3:1 to 4:1) requires a robust Ti/TiN adhesion/diffusion barrier before WF6 reduction. Inadequate TiN step coverage at the contact bottom leads to WF6 gas attack on underlying active silicon ('volcano effect'), causing junction spiking, unrecoverable drain-substrate leakage (>1 fA/cell), and retention time collapse.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4 precursor gases demand dedicated hazardous gas containment, scrubbers, and specialized Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) with strict moisture tolerances. Fab tooling requires a cluster tool integrating degas, RF pre-clean, ionized PVD Ti/CVD TiN, and cold/hot-wall CVD W to prevent open-air re-oxidation bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: W-plug CVD and subsequent chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) represent a primary defectivity yield limiter. Process integration must enforce strict queue times between pre-clean and Ti/TiN/W deposition to keep wafer rework and yield scrap within the MPW budget.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Volcano defect formation from WF6 reacting with silicon substrate due to discontinuous CVD TiN barrier layer at contact bottom.
1. Keyhole/seam voiding inside the high-aspect-ratio 180nm contact plug during W bulk fill, causing elevated contact resistance and bitline read opens.
1. Native oxide regrowth at the silicon-to-barrier interface exceeding 1.2 nm due to Q-time breach, elevating specific contact resistivity above 5e-7 Ohm*cm^2.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-1-01` | **Shared Bitline Contact Specific Contact Resistivity via On-Wafer TLM Matrix** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with semi-automated probe station (Cascade Microtech Summit 12000) | 1. Force 4-wire Kelvin current sweep (-5.0 mA to +5.0 mA in 0.5 mA steps) across adjacent TLM pads across all gap spacings. 2. Record voltage drop V_meas and extract dynamic resistance R_T = dV/dI for each gap d. 3. Perform linear regression of R_T versus d: extract slope (R_s/W), Y-intercept (2*R_c), and transfer length L_T. 4. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 3.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2 and individual shared contact resistance R_c <= 20.0 Ohm across 9 sites per wafer.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-1-02` | **W-Plug Seam Voiding and Step Coverage Cross-Section Metrology** | FEI Helios NanoLab DualBeam FIB-SEM with STEM detector (capable of <1 nm resolution at 30 kV) | 1. Deposit in-situ Pt protective strap (1.5 um thickness) over target contact array via FIB. 2. Mill lamella using 30 kV Ga+ ion beam, thinning to <80 nm thickness with low-energy 2 kV polish. 3. Acquire STEM bright-field images of 10 consecutive shared bitline contact cross-sections per site. 4. Measure TiN bottom barrier thickness, tungsten fill void seam diameter, and plug taper angle. | `Zero keyhole voids with major axis > 10 nm; minimum TiN bottom step coverage >= 8.0 nm; tungsten plug aspect ratio fill completeness = 100% across all sampled plugs.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B chemical-resistant splash suit (Tychem 6000), Supplied-air respirator (SAR) or full-face APR with HF/acid gas/particulate combination cartridges, Double-layer butyl/Viton chemical gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Safety goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For WF6 or HF skin exposure: Immediately flush affected area with copiously flowing water for 5 minutes, apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously, massaging into skin until emergency medical services arrive. In case of inhalation: Remove patient immediately to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, followed by nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate inhalation under physician supervision.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated point-of-use wet/thermal scrubber (burn-wet abatement) directly connected to tool turbopump exhaust with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) at gas cabinet interface; continuous optical toxic gas monitoring (TGMS) interlocked with automated emergency gas shutoff valves.

critics.systems_engineer: In a 180nm 1T1C COB folded bitline matrix, sharing a single bitline contact between two adjacent access transistors reduces cell area toward 8F^2 (~0.26 um^2), but couples parasitic capacitance and series resistance directly into the sensing margin. Tungsten plug resistance R_plug must stay under 25 Ohm per contact to prevent sense-amplifier read degradation and timing skew between paired bitlines.
critics.domain_expert: Patterning contact vias at 180nm critical dimension with high aspect ratio (~3:1 to 4:1) requires a robust Ti/TiN adhesion/diffusion barrier before WF6 reduction. Inadequate TiN step coverage at the contact bottom leads to WF6 gas attack on underlying active silicon ('volcano effect'), causing junction spiking, unrecoverable drain-substrate leakage (>1 fA/cell), and retention time collapse.
critics.supply_chain: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4 precursor gases demand dedicated hazardous gas containment, scrubbers, and specialized Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) with strict moisture tolerances. Fab tooling requires a cluster tool integrating degas, RF pre-clean, ionized PVD Ti/CVD TiN, and cold/hot-wall CVD W to prevent open-air re-oxidation bottlenecks.
critics.laya_pm: W-plug CVD and subsequent chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) represent a primary defectivity yield limiter. Process integration must enforce strict queue times between pre-clean and Ti/TiN/W deposition to keep wafer rework and yield scrap within the MPW budget.
critical_failure_modes: Volcano defect formation from WF6 reacting with silicon substrate due to discontinuous CVD TiN barrier layer at contact bottom.
Keyhole/seam voiding inside the high-aspect-ratio 180nm contact plug during W bulk fill, causing elevated contact resistance and bitline read opens.
Native oxide regrowth at the silicon-to-barrier interface exceeding 1.2 nm due to Q-time breach, elevating specific contact resistivity above 5e-7 Ohm*cm^2.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shared Bitline Contact Photolithography and Anisotropic Oxide Plasma Etch
**Module:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration  
**Hierarchy:** Gen 2 (µm) | Circuit Design / Photolithography & Etch  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    HMDS Vapor Prime    │
│       at 120°C         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Photoresist Coat &   │
│        Softbake        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  DUV Reticle Exposure  │
│ (Shared Bitline Node)  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Post-Exposure Bake &  │
│   Aqueous Developer    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Anisotropic Oxide Etch │
│ (BOE / Fluorine Plasma)│
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Ash / Strip Resist &  │
│ CD-SEM / In-line Metro │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Vapor Prime**:
   - Transfer wafer into the adhesion promoter chamber.
   - Perform Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) vapor prime at **120°C** to dehydrate the oxide surface and promote photoresist adhesion prior to coating.
   - *Safety Precaution:* Ensure calcium gluconate gel is accessible in the wet chemical safety station adjacent to etching and cleaning stations.

2. **Photoresist Coating & Softbake**:
   - Dispense high-resolution positive photoresist across the wafer on the automated track coater.
   - Spin-coat at programmed RPM to achieve uniform thickness covering the inter-layer dielectric (ILD).
   - Execute standard hotplate softbake to drive off casting solvents.

3. **Photolithographic Exposure (Shared Bitline Contact Hole)**:
   - Load wafer into the lithography exposure tool (stepper/scanner).
   - Align reticle to active area alignment marks for the 180nm cell matrix targeting the shared bitline node between two adjacent access transistors (nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Expose contact hole array defining the bitline landing pads.

4. **Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) & Development**:
   - Perform PEB on hotplate track to activate photo-acid generators and eliminate standing waves.
   - Puddle-develop with standard aqueous developer, rinse with deionized (DI) water, and spin dry.
   - Inspect critical dimension (CD) of the contact openings via optical/CD-SEM inspection.

5. **Anisotropic Oxide Etch & Wet Contact Clear**:
   - Transfer wafer to the dry plasma etch chamber (anisotropic fluorocarbon RIE) to etch vertical contact vias down toward the active shared node with high anisotropy.
   - For chemical oxide cleanup/etching or wet etch calibration, utilize **BOE (6:1)** (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$) with **0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad** wetting agent added to prevent micro-bubble entrapment in micro-trenches/contact holes. Maintain bath at **25°C**.

6. **Photoresist Strip & Post-Clean**:
   - Strip patterned resist via downstream $\text{O}_2$ plasma ashing followed by wet solvent clean.
   - DI water rinse until resistivity $> 18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ and spin-rinse dry under heated $\text{N}_2$.
   - Route wafer to Tungsten (W) plug chemical vapor deposition (CVD) pre-clean.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Target Metric | Specification Target | Verification Method / Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vapor Prime Adhesion Temperature** | **$120^\circ\text{C}$** | Integrated thermal sensor / Hotplate RTD |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate (BOE at 25°C)** | **$100\text{ nm/min}$** ($\pm 10\%$) | In-line Spectroscopic Ellipsometer |
| **BOE Solution Bath Temperature** | **$25^\circ\text{C}$** | Automated wet bench bath RTD |
| **Wetting Agent Concentration in BOE** | **$0.1\%$** Triton X-100 or Fluorad | Chemical delivery mass-flow dosing / titration |
| **Cell Transistor Dimensions (Design Ref)** | **$L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$** | CD-SEM metrology |

---

### 3. Context Source Citations

- **HMDS Adhesion & Temperature**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — specifies HMDS vapor prime at **120°C** prior to resist coating to ensure resist adhesion.
- **BOE Chemistry & Thermal Oxide Etch Rate**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — defines **BOE 6:1** (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$), etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at **25°C** as approximately **$100\text{ nm/min}$** ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
- **Surfactant / Wetting Agent Specification**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — dictates addition of **0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad** wetting agent to prevent bubble entrapment in micro-trenches.
- **Safety Protocol**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — dictates calcium gluconate gel presence for hydrofluoric acid safety.
- **Shared Bitline Node Geometry**: Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — establishes 180nm unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and shared bitline contact arrangement between two adjacent memory cells.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Patterning a shared bitline contact in a 1T1C DRAM matrix at Gen 2 (micron-scale) prior to scaling to 180nm requires stringent verticality to avoid parasitic cross-talk and landing short-circuits. Relying on wet BOE creates isotropic undercut profiles that violate pitch spacing between adjacent memory cells; an anisotropic reactive ion etch (RIE/ICP) using fluorocarbon plasma (CF4/CHF3/O2 or C4F8/Ar) is mandatory to establish vertical sidewalls (>85°) through the inter-layer dielectric (ILD SiO2) down to the shared source/drain junction.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At Gen 2 resolution using Shipley 1813 (~1.3 µm thickness) with i-line (365 nm) lithography, contact hole closure or scumming due to diffraction effects and standing waves presents a primary yield bottleneck. An HMDS vapor prime dehydration bake at 120°C is required to prevent resist delamination during plasma exposure, and the post-exposure bake (PEB) must be tightly controlled at 110°C to minimize standing waves before MF-319 development.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Microposit MF-319 (TMAH-based) and Shipley 1813 have constrained domestic shelf-life in Vietnam and require temperature-controlled shipping (4-10°C). Electronic-grade fluorocarbon etchant gases (CHF3, CF4 5N purity) and high-purity argon for RIE carrier gas require pre-certified pressure regulators and scrubbers compliant with local environmental import controls.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing lithography and anisotropic plasma etch as a coupled unit process requires tight inline lot tracking. If post-lithography inspection indicates CD distortion exceeding ±0.25 µm, wafers must be reworked via resist strip and piranhaclean immediately before committing to dry etch, preventing irreversible substrate trenching into active silicon areas.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-masking and contact pitch bridging caused by residual photoresist scum or particulate contamination inside the un-cleared contact vias prior to RIE etch.
1. Silicon active-area punch-through and substrate pitting at the shared diffusion node caused by lack of optical emission spectroscopy (OES) endpoint detection or excessive RF plasma over-etching.
1. Severe resist reticulation and sidewall bowing from resist fluorination and thermal degradation during high-density ICP plasma bombardment without helium backside cooling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-1-1-01` | **Post-Development Inspection of Shared Bitline Contact Hole Critical Dimension (CD) and Profile** | Top-down CD-SEM (or high-resolution Calibrated Optical Metrology Microscope at 1000x) and Cross-Sectional Cleaved Field Emission SEM (FE-SEM) | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM vacuum chamber. 2. Navigate to 9-point die coordinate matrix across the 100mm wafer. 3. Measure top-down contact diameter across 20 shared bitline contact test structures. 4. Cleave sacrificial test coupon and image resist profile sidewall angle using FE-SEM. | `Contact diameter must measure 1.80 µm ± 0.15 µm across all 9 sample sites with zero visible resist footing or residual scum; photoresist sidewall profile angle must be >= 82°.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-1-1-02` | **Post-Etch Anisotropic Contact Hole Depth, Verticality, and Active Area Loss Metrology** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, Cross-Sectional FE-SEM, and 4-Point Probe / Kelvin Contact Resistance Metrology System | 1. Measure residual oxide thickness on unpatterned field areas via spectroscopic ellipsometry. 2. Cleave wafer across the array centerline and prepare specimen for FE-SEM cross-section. 3. Measure etched via depth, via bottom diameter, sidewall taper angle, and substrate over-etch depth into the shared silicon drain junction. 4. Verify complete ILD clearing across all 9 array quadrants. | `Contact via etch depth must equal 800 nm + 50 nm over-etch (total depth 850 nm ± 25 nm); sidewall taper angle must be between 87° and 90°; silicon substrate junction recess must not exceed 15 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B Chemically Resistant Butyl/Viton Heavy Gloves over Nitrile Inner Gloves, Full Face Shield with ANSI Z87.1 Impact and Chemical Splash Rating, PTFE Coated Acid-Resistant Cleanroom Apron and Sleeves, Self-Contained Eyewash and Drench Shower Proximity Kit, Mini-Environment Chemical Vapor Filtering Respirator with Organic Vapor/Acid Gas Cartridges
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH exposure: Flush contaminated skin/eyes immediately with copious cold running water for at least 15 minutes while calling emergency services; TMAH induces systemic neurotoxicity and respiratory arrest. Fluorocarbon/HF byproduct contamination: Flush affected zone with emergency water shower for 2 minutes, then massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into skin until emergency medical team arrives. In case of inhalation of toxic fluorinated etchant effluents, move patient to fresh air and administer oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Lithography wet bench requires dedicated laminar exhaust velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with toxic organic vapor exhaust ducted to cleanroom carbon beds. RIE dry etching system requires dry turbo pump exhaust connected directly to an automated point-of-use thermal-wet burn scrubber to crack fluorinated greenhouse gases and neutralize acidic acid gas byproducts (HF, COF2).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous developer waste containing TMAH must be segregated into dedicated phenolic/alkaline waste drums and neutralized with diluted hydrochloric/citric acid to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to hazardous waste disposal. Spent resist solvents collected in flammable carboys for solvent recycling. Scrubber effluent monitored online for fluoride ion concentration (< 10 ppm) before city discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (MF-319 Developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C7) | `2.2% aqueous` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (Shipley 1813 PGMEA solvent)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI Grade | `>= 80%` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS Primer)** | `999-97-3` | Electronic Grade 99.9% | `100%` |
| **Trifluoromethane (Fluoroform, RIE Etch Gas)** | `75-46-7` | 5N (99.999%) | `100% pressurized gas` |
| **Tetrafluoromethane (Carbon tetrafluoride)** | `75-73-0` | 5N (99.999%) | `100% pressurized gas` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Densified, planarized 800nm TEOS SiO2 ILD layer, clean and free of organic residues, post-SC1/SC2 RCA clean with contact water contact angle < 10°.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry-etched contact vias with stripped photoresist, zero fluorocarbon polymer residue on sidewalls, freshly cleared silicon contact interface with native oxide thickness < 1.0 nm awaiting Ti/TiN barrier liner CVD.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air promotes rapid uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (>1.5 nm) and airborne organic siloxane/hydrocarbon chemisorption on the open silicon drain node, causing ohmic bitline contact open-circuits and uncorrectable Kelvin resistance spikes (>500 Ohms/via).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful fabrication of shared bitline contact vias across the DRAM cell array with vertical anisotropic profiles, cleared silicon contact interfaces, and critical dimensions meeting Gen 2 target rules without active-area punch-through.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RUN_REPORT_LITHO_ETCH_GEN2_SHARED_BLC.pdf`
- [ ] `CD_SEM_9POINT_METROLOGY_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `CROSS_SECTION_FESEM_VIA_PROFILE_ASPECT.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Shared bitline contact via opening diameter at ILD base** | `1.80 µm` | ±0.15 µm | Top-down automated CD-SEM inspection across 9 dice |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Via sidewall anisotropic inclination angle** | `88.5°` | ±1.5° | Cross-sectional cleaved high-resolution FE-SEM profile imaging |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Over-etch substrate silicon recess at shared diffusion node** | `10.0 nm` | ≤ 15.0 nm | FE-SEM cross-section calibrated depth measurement |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 array test die locations confirm open, residue-free contact holes with CD within 1.80 ± 0.15 µm, contact angle >= 87°, substrate loss <= 15 nm, and queue time between O2/solvent strip and Ti/TiN metallization logged strictly under 45 minutes.
