# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## COB Parallel Array High-Frequency C-V Storage Capacitance Extraction

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow
This SOP defines the metrology procedure for extracting the single-cell storage capacitance ($C_s$) of 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stacked capacitor structures using parallel test arrays (e.g., $N = 10{,}000$ or $100{,}000$ cells connected in parallel) via High-Frequency Capacitance-Voltage (HF C-V) metrology.

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Parallel COB Array  │
│      Selection       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Open-Short Cable   │
│     De-embedding     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   HF C-V Profiling   │
│    100kHz to 1MHz    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Voltage Bias Sweep  │
│     across Vcell     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Pad Parasitic     │
│     Subtraction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Single-Cell      │
│    Capacitance Cs    │
│    Normalization     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Test Array & Probe Station Alignment**:
   - Load the wafer onto the shielded, dark probe station chuck thermally stabilized at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient screening) or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (temperature-dependent validation).
   - Align low-leakage Kelvin probes onto the dedicated COB parallel macro array pad set (connected to the common top plate node and parallel bottom storage nodes via tied wordline access/tungsten plug test structures) and adjacent open/dummy reference pads.

2. **Instrumentation Calibration & Fixture De-embedding**:
   - Initialize an LCR meter / precision impedance analyzer in $C_p - G_p$ (parallel capacitance and conductance) mode.
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit calibration at the probe tip tips to de-embed coaxial cable parasitic capacitance ($C_{\text{cable}}$) and series lead resistance ($R_s$).
   - Measure the adjacent unpopulated dummy open-pad structure across the frequency spectrum to establish the baseline fixture stray capacitance $C_{\text{pad}}$.

3. **High-Frequency C-V Profiling & DC Bias Sweep**:
   - Set AC oscillation excitation amplitude to $30\,\text{mV}_\text{RMS}$ at measurement frequencies of $100\,\text{kHz}$ and $1\,\text{MHz}$ to prevent series resistance dispersion and carrier generation roll-off.
   - Apply a DC bias voltage sweep from $-1.5\,\text{V}$ to $+1.5\,\text{V}$ (centered around operating cell levels, spanning $0\,\text{V}$ to $V_{DD}$ with step size $\le 25\,\text{mV}$).
   - Record total parallel capacitance $C_{\text{total}}(V)$ and parallel conductance $G_p(V)$. Ensure dissipation factor $D = G_p / (\omega C_p) < 0.05$ to guarantee low dielectric loss.

4. **Parasitic Subtraction & Single-Cell Normalization**:
   - Subtract the measured open dummy fixture capacitance:
     $$C_{\text{array}}(V) = C_{\text{total}}(V) - C_{\text{pad}}(V)$$
   - Calculate extracted single-cell storage capacitance $C_s$:
     $$C_s = \frac{C_{\text{array}}(V_{\text{operating}})}{N}$$
     *(where $N$ is the total number of parallel cells in the test macro array)*.
   - Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) based on physical crown/cylinder surface area and effective dielectric stack constant ($\kappa$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Single-Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (minimum $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | At operating bias ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$), $1\,\text{MHz}$ test frequency |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from accumulation capacitance across dielectric stack |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15.0$ | Dimensionless | $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$ high-k stack |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Cell Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ retention test condition |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Validates minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ capacitance budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity, stacked crown/MIM topology with W-plug contact, effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, and cell leakage $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - Validates the required storage capacitance target range of $25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF/cell}$ for $>64\,\text{ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$, and high-k dielectric stack Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) specification of $3\text{ to }4\,\text{nm}$.
- **Source 3**: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
  - Validates nominal cell capacitance value $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ yielding $100\text{ to }150\,\text{mV}$ differential signal $\Delta V$ over bitline loading $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring single-cell storage capacitance Cs (~25-30 fF) directly is physically impossible without array parallelization due to cable and probe pad parasitic capacitances (typically 0.5-2 pF). Designing a 10,000 to 100,000-cell parallel test array scales aggregate capacitance to 250-3000 pF, well within LCR meter sensitivity. However, parasitic line resistance across long wordlines/bitlines introduces distributed RC low-pass filtering, which will attenuate the HF AC stimulus (100 kHz - 1 MHz) and cause apparent capacitance dropoff. A 4-terminal Kelvin sensing pad topology combined with open/short de-embedding test structures is mandatory to ensure measured aggregate values translate to true per-cell storage node capacitance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture, the dielectric stack (typically high-k Al2O3, Ta2O5, or Si3N4/SiO2 ON/ONO equivalent tox ~4-5 nm) must exhibit negligible frequency dispersion and dielectric loss (tan delta < 0.005) under high-frequency C-V extraction. The test structure must bias all access transistors into deep accumulation/inversion or tie all storage node bottom electrodes directly to a shared bus to isolate dielectric capacitance from channel conductance effects. Interface traps (Dit) and fixed charges in the cylindrical/crown container sidewalls will induce frequency-dependent stretch-out and flatband voltage shifts that corrupt the extracted Cs value if single-frequency 1 MHz C-V is relied upon without dual-frequency correction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COB array parametric characterization requires sub-femtofarad precision automated wafer probe cards equipped with beryllium-copper or tungsten probe needles and low-noise triaxial cabling. Sourcing cryogenic or temperature-controlled probers capable of low-dielectric absorption RF shielding under current global export restrictions presents a 14-week lead-time risk. Spare parametric LCR meters (Keysight B1500A/E4980A or Keithley 4200A-SCS) must be locked in fab capacity reservations before tape-out verification begins.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput for this work package threatens the Gen 2 post-metallization parametric timeline. Performing full sweeps across multiple dice per wafer at fine DC bias steps (10 mV increments) will consume over 45 minutes per wafer. We must standardize on a split-protocol: a rapid 5-point spot C-V extraction across 25 sites for inline wafer acceptance, followed by full 100 kHz - 1 MHz swept C-V and Dit de-embedding on only 5 golden reference sites per lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Distributed RC delay roll-off: Interconnect resistance along long parallel storage node buses attenuates the AC excitation signal above 500 kHz, causing an artificial underestimation of per-cell storage capacitance (Cs) by >20%.
1. Dielectric leakage shunting: Pinholes or high trap-assisted tunneling leakage (>10 nA/cm^2) in thin container dielectric stacks creates an excessive parallel conductance Gp, corrupting the parallel-mode (Cp-Gp) extraction algorithm into erroneous negative or runaway capacitance readings.
1. Parasitic pad-to-substrate capacitive coupling: Failure to subtract open-pad parasitics from probe pads (bondpad SiO2 to Si substrate) swamps the aggregate array delta capacitance, yielding false positive pass readings on under-etched storage containers.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-3-2-01` | **High-Frequency (1 MHz) Parallel Storage Array C-V Extraction & Per-Cell Cs Quantification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multi-Frequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Triaxial Kelvin Prober Platen, Shielded Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station | 1. Land triaxial probe tips on the 10,000-cell COB parallel array test pad set (High-Force, High-Sense, Low-Force, Low-Sense) and adjacent open-pad dummy structure. 2. Measure open-pad residual capacitance (C_pad) across the DC sweep range (-1.5 V to +1.5 V) with AC amplitude = 25 mV RMS at f = 1.0 MHz. 3. Apply AC excitation of 25 mV RMS at 1.0 MHz with DC bias swept from -1.5 V to +1.5 V in 20 mV increments across the active 10,000-cell array. 4. Acquire parallel capacitance (Cp) and parallel conductance (Gp) at each bias point. 5. Subtract open-pad capacitance: C_array_net(V) = Cp(V) - C_pad(V). 6. Compute per-cell storage capacitance: C_s = C_array_net(V_bias = 0.9 V) / 10,000. | `Net extracted single-cell capacitance Cs at operating point (V_cell_plate = 0.9 V, V_storage = 0.0 V, Delta V = 0.9 V) must satisfy 26.0 fF <= C_s <= 32.0 fF (nominal target 28.0 fF). Dissipation factor D = Gp / (2 * pi * f * Cp) must remain <= 0.010 across the entire bias range [-1.5 V, +1.5 V].` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-3-2-02` | **Multi-Frequency Dispersion & Interface Trap Density (Dit) Extraction on COB Dielectric Stack** | Keithley 4200A-SCS with 4210-CVU (Capacitance-Voltage Unit) and 4225-RPM Remote Preamplifier/Switch Module, Dark Box Enclosure, Anti-Vibration Air Table | 1. Contact parallel array macro terminal pads using low-noise triaxial probe needles. 2. Perform swept C-V curves across DC bias from -1.8 V to +1.8 V with 30 mV AC test signal at four discrete frequencies: 10 kHz, 100 kHz, 500 kHz, and 1.0 MHz. 3. Record Cp(V) and Gp(V) matrices for all frequencies. 4. Extract flatband voltage V_fb at each frequency. 5. Calculate frequency dispersion: Delta_C_disp = (C_10kHz - C_1MHz) / C_1MHz * 100% evaluated at maximum accumulation (V = +1.5 V). 6. Extract interface trap density (Dit) across midgap using the High-Low Frequency C-V Method: Dit = (C_ox / q) * [(C_LF / (C_ox - C_LF)) - (C_HF / (C_ox - C_HF))]. | `Frequency dispersion Delta_C_disp between 10 kHz and 1.0 MHz must be <= 3.5% at accumulation. Interface trap density Dit at midgap must be <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1. Dielectric loss tangent tan(delta) at 100 kHz must be < 0.005.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety spectacles with side shields, Full electrostatic discharge (ESD) grounded cleanroom smock and conductive ESD footwear, Conductive wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor attached to verified earth ground
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure to IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered clean water at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmological medical evaluation. Inhalation of IPA vapor or N2 displacement: Evacuate exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; alert emergency medical services. Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and wash skin with mild soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Cascade prober dark box chamber must have dedicated mini-environment exhaust port with static pressure >= -0.20 in. w.g. (minimum 25 CFM capture airflow) to prevent solvent vapor buildup during probe tip cleaning. Cleanroom ballroom laminar air downflow velocity must be maintained at 0.45 +/- 0.05 m/s with continuous ceiling HEPA filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free swab wipes and cleaning residue must be collected in labeled, grounded, self-closing stainless steel flammable solvent disposal cans. Solvents must be routed to the cleanroom non-halogenated solvent carboy collection system for thermal oxidation or external licensed hazardous reclamation. No drains or municipal water disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, semiconductor wafer rinse / probe tip clean)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 (Electronic Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Gaseous Nitrogen (N2, prober purging & wafer blow-off)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly completed top-electrode cell plate metallization and back-end contact pad anneal (forming gas anneal 400 °C N2/H2); pad surfaces free of native oxide scum, organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC), and post-etch fluoropolymer residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine probe-tested bond pads with scrub mark depth < 0.2 um, zero pad metal peel-off or punch-through; dielectric container stack free of electrical breakdown rupture; wafer ready for subsequent passivation deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption and airborne hydrocarbon condensation on exposed pad and container interfaces introduce moisture-assisted surface leakage channels, artificially raising loss tangent (tan delta > 0.02) and inducing false Dit extraction shifts (> 3.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1) due to room-temperature pad oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable parametric acceptance sign-off confirming that the 180nm COB parallel capacitor array provides a single-cell storage node capacitance Cs >= 28.0 fF with bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio Cb/Cs <= 8.5:1, exhibiting negligible frequency dispersion (< 3.5%) and midgap Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1 at 1 MHz under 25 °C operating conditions.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `COB_CV_1MHz_Parallel_Extraction_RunData.csv`
- [ ] `COB_Storage_Capacitance_Dispersion_Dit_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Wafer_Die_Map_Cs_Uniformity_Contour.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Single-cell storage node capacitance Cs extracted from 10,000-cell COB parallel array at 1.0 MHz (V_cell_plate = 0.9 V, V_storage = 0.0 V)** | `28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF (26.0 fF to 30.0 fF) | High-frequency de-embedded parallel capacitance extraction (Cp - C_pad) / 10,000 using Keysight B1500A MFCMU at 1 MHz, 25 mV RMS |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Storage capacitor dielectric loss tangent tan(delta) at 100 kHz across operating DC bias span (-0.9 V to +0.9 V)** | `0.003` | <= 0.005 max | Impedance analyzer dissipation factor D = Gp / (2 * pi * f * Cp) measured via 4200A-CVU in shielded dark box |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Container dielectric interface trap density Dit at silicon/dielectric midgap** | `7.5 x 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1 max | High-Low Frequency C-V Method extraction comparing 10 kHz quasi-static and 1 MHz high-frequency curves |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> At least 22 of 25 measured test dice across the 200mm wafer exhibit per-cell Cs within 26.0 fF to 30.0 fF, loss tangent < 0.005, and Dit <= 1.0 x 10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1, with automated wafer-map CSV/PDF signed off by the Lead Metrology Researcher and Circuit Integration Lead.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Container dielectric interface trap density Dit at silicon/dielectric midgap
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-Low Frequency C-V Method extraction comparing 10 kHz quasi-static and 1 MHz high-frequency curves

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Thermal Chuck Triaxial Probing for Sub-fA 1T1C Node Leakage at 85°C

**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture & Integration

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Chuck Pre-Heat to    │
│          85°C          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Triaxial Guarded Pin  │
│        Landing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Electrometer      │
│    Settling & Noise    │
│        Zeroing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   1T1C Node Leakage    │
│        Sampling        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│    Validation <1 fA    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Thermal Stabilization & Vacuum Chuck Setpoint:**
   - Secure the 180nm silicon wafer/die onto the gold-plated thermal chuck via vacuum hold-down.
   - Ramp the thermal chuck controller to **85.0°C** and allow a 15-minute thermal equilibrium soak time to eliminate mechanical drift and wafer bow expansion.

2. **Triaxial Guarding & Environmental Isolation:**
   - Close the dark Faraday shielding enclosure over the probe station to block ambient light-induced photocurrents and electromagnetic interference (EMI).
   - Ensure driven guard shields on triaxial lines are active (V_guard = V_force) to nullify parasitic cable and fixture leakage down to the sub-femtoampere equipment noise floor (< 0.1 fA).

3. **Guarded Micro-Probe Landing:**
   - Using precision micromanipulators with tungsten probe needles (tip radius ≤ 0.5 µm), align to the dedicated 1T1C cell test pad array (W-plug storage node / bitline contact nodes).
   - Touch down with controlled Z-axis overdrive (3 µm to 5 µm) to achieve low contact resistance without puncturing the tungsten plug or capacitor top electrode.

4. **Bias Configuration & Settling:**
   - Ground the substrate/well and access transistor gate (Wordline = 0 V to maintain cut-off; $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Apply cell high-voltage bias $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$ (or precharge midpoint offset) across the stacked capacitor node.
   - Wait 5 seconds settling time for dielectric polarization relaxation (Ta₂O₅ / Al₂O₃ / ONO dielectric stack) and cable dielectric absorption currents to decay.

5. **Sub-fA Current Integration & Sampling:**
   - Configure the parametric analyzer / electrometer in high-resolution, long-integration mode (NPLC ≥ 10, averaging over 50 samples).
   - Measure steady-state leakage current $I_{\text{leak}}$ originating from access transistor sub-threshold leakage and junction leakage at the storage node.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature** | `85.0` | `±0.5` | `°C` |
| **Storage Node Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | `< 1.0` | `0.0 to 1.0` | `fA/cell` |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Target** | `28.0` | `25.0 to 30.0` | `fF/cell` |
| **Retention Window Minimum** | `> 64` | `≥ 64` | `ms` |

#### Leakage Benchmark Profile at 85°C:
```text
                1T1C Node Leakage Benchmark at 85C (fA) 
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░                                   │
    Equip Floor┤░░░░                                   │
Measured at 85C┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
   Target Bound┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
              0.00      0.25     0.50      0.75    1.00 
```

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Context Traceability

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Access Transistor Geometry:* $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$ with tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
  - *Dielectric Stack:* ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - *Capacitance Budget & Leakage Floor:* Minimum **$28\text{ fF/cell}$**; sub-threshold and junction leakage target **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C**.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Retention Specification:* Storage capacitance of **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell** guarantees retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C**.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - *Charge Dynamics & Sensing Thresholds:* Validates signal margin $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ based on baseline $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal chuck heating induces significant thermo-mechanical drift across triaxial probe arms, causing micro-stepping and contact resistance fluctuations on sub-micron pads. The closed-loop thermal controller and triaxial guard shielding must achieve ground-loop isolation >100 TΩ and settle thermal gradients within +/-0.1°C to prevent thermocouple EMF and parasitic leakage spikes from masking sub-fA signals.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 85°C, junction leakage across the 180nm access transistor storage node is dominated by Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) generation-recombination and trap-assisted tunneling. Guarded triaxial Kelvin configurations down to the probe tip are mandatory; unshielded coaxial paths or moisture condensation on the cold-wall interface will induce parasitic surface currents orders of magnitude greater than the target sub-fA 1T1C storage node leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialized tungsten-rhenium (WRe) or beryllium-copper sub-micron triaxial probe needles rated for low-noise high-temperature (up to 150°C) probing suffer long procurement lead times (12-16 weeks) from vendors like FormFactor or MPI. Low-noise triaxial feedthroughs and high-purity dry nitrogen purge lines must be locked into second-source agreements to mitigate line downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal settling time at 85°C adds up to 25 minutes per wafer test reticle, risking throughput bottlenecks on the shared semiautomatic probe station. Metrology milestones require multiplexed cell array test-key routing or fast-settling dry-air thermal enclosure protocols to maintain the Gen 2 characterization timeline without compromising thermal stability.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal expansion-induced probe tip scrub deforming the 180nm aluminum/tungsten landing pad and fracturing thin capacitor dielectric interfaces.
1. Triaxial cable dielectric absorption and piezoelectric triboelectric noise exceeding 5 fA during thermal ramp-up and stabilization.
1. Ambient moisture ingress into the thermal chuck chamber causing surface condensation, moisture paths, and catastrophic parasitic surface conduction across probe tips.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-3-3-01` | **Guarded Triaxial Background Noise Floor and System Leakage Verification at 85°C** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1517A High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) connected via triaxial guarded cables to a FormFactor Summit 12000 thermal probe station with a Temptronic ThermoChuck. | 1. Set B1517A HRSMU to Force 0.0V with Triaxial Guard active and integration time set to Long (16 PLC). 2. Record current leakage over 120 seconds at 1-second intervals with probe tips floating. 3. Step voltage from -1.5V to +1.5V in 50 mV steps, recording open-circuit leakage current at 85°C. | `System open-circuit background leakage current must remain <= 0.20 fA RMS and peak current <= 0.50 fA across the entire -1.5V to +1.5V bias range at 85°C.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-2-3-3-02` | **180nm 1T1C Storage Node Off-State Leakage Characterization at 85°C** | Keysight B1500A HRSMU, triaxial guarded probes (Kelvin configuration), femtoamp remote preamplifier, Temptronic thermal chuck controller. | 1. Apply 1.8V (VDD) to the Bitline (BL) contact. 2. Sweep Storage Node Node-Contact (SN) from 0.0V to 1.8V while sampling current using HRSMU with 32 PLC averaging. 3. Monitor retention leakage over 10 seconds at SN = 1.8V to extract steady-state off-state node leakage. | `Total steady-state storage node off-state leakage current I_leak at 85°C must be <= 0.85 fA/cell at V_cell = 1.8V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal-insulating heat-resistant cleanroom gloves (rated to 150°C), High-density cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ESD-safe), UV/Laser optical safety goggles with side shields, ESD static-dissipative lab coat and grounded wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For thermal burns from 85°C hot chuck: immediately flush area with cold sterile water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply salves; cover with sterile non-adherent dressing and report to cleanroom medical response. For IPA skin or eye contact: flush eyes/skin with emergency eyewash for 15 minutes. In case of N2 asphyxiation risk: evacuate personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous chamber dry N2 shroud exhaust ducted to cleanroom general scrubbed extract at >= 30 CFM. Ensure ambient oxygen deficiency monitoring sensors (< 19.5% O2 alarm) are active within 1 meter of the probe station.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes for chuck and needle cleaning must be disposed of in dedicated grounded, self-closing hazardous flammable solvent disposal cans and routed to solvent waste reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched contact pads with unpassivated aluminum/tungsten metallization free of organic residue and surface fluoride staining post-strip.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Scrub-inspected, unoxidized probe contact pads with clean needle impact impressions under N2 cover, transferred to dry box storage.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide formation (Al2O3 / WOx) and atmospheric moisture adsorption on test pads exceeding contact resistance limits, inducing severe contact barrier non-linearity and false-high leakage currents.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified sub-fA triaxial probing metrology at 85°C for the 180nm 1T1C DRAM array storage node, validating open-circuit noise floor <= 0.2 fA RMS and demonstrating 1T1C cell retention leakage <= 0.85 fA/cell at 85°C under high-temperature accelerated retention stress.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `1T1C_Thermal_Leakage_85C_Characterization_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Raw_Triaxial_IV_Leakage_Data_Reticle_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Probe_Pad_Scrub_Marks_Optical_Inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Triaxial probe station open-circuit background noise floor at 85°C** | `0.20 fA` | +/- 0.05 fA | Keysight B1517A HRSMU 120-second current integration at 0V floating condition inside dark box at 85°C |
| `ASSERT-02` | **180nm 1T1C storage node cell off-state leakage current at 85°C and V_cell = 1.8V** | `0.85 fA` | +0.15 fA / -0.30 fA | Keysight B1500A guarded quasi-steady-state IV measurement at 85.0°C +/- 0.1°C |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful 10-site wafer-level leakage validation confirming open-circuit background noise < 0.25 fA and mean 1T1C cell leakage <= 0.85 fA at 85°C across 3 test reticles, with zero dielectric breakdown and pad scrub mark area < 10% of total pad geometry, signed off by Lead Metrology Engineer and Device Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction for Bitline/Wordline Matrix

- **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)
- **Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction
- **Topology**: Folded Bitline ($8F^2$ footprint: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Layout GDS/OAS Stream-In (BL/WL Matrix)"] --> B["Design Rule Check (DRC) Clean Run"]
    B --> C["Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction"]
    C --> D["Parasitic Extraction (PEX: R + C Network)"]
    D --> E["Capacitance Ratio & Read Margin Check (Cb/Cs <= 9:1, Delta V >= 100 mV)"]
    E --> F{"Acceptance Criteria Met?"}
    F -- "Yes" --> G["Sign-off & Matrix Netlist Release"]
    F -- "No" --> H["Layout Optimization: Metal Pitch / Dielectric Tuning"]
    H --> B
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Design Rule Verification (DRC Clean Sign-off)**
   - Run full-chip/matrix DRC decks on the $8F^2$ folded bitline cell array ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell, $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Validate high-voltage spacing and enclosure rules for Wordline pass gates rated for $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}\text{--}2.8\ \text{V}$ overdrive (preventing dielectric breakdown on access NMOS gate oxide).
   - Ensure zero design rule violations across active diffusion, poly wordlines, metal contacts, and bitline metal tracks.

2. **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Verification**
   - Extract device connectivity across all 1T1C cells (256 or 512 cells per bitline column).
   - Verify topological mapping of complementary bitline pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$) against schematic netlists.
   - Confirm pin consistency, storage capacitor terminals ($C_s$), access NMOS source/drain terminals, and equalization networks with zero shorts, opens, or property mismatch errors.

3. **Parasitic Resistance & Capacitance Extraction (PEX)**
   - Perform full field solver parasitic extraction (coupled $RC$ mode) on wordlines and folded bitlines.
   - Extract storage node capacitance $C_s$ per cell (target: nominal $28\ \text{fF}$, bound: $\ge 25\ \text{fF}\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$).
   - Extract total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ (including line-to-line coupling, junction capacitance of access transistors, and crossing capacitance over orthogonal wordlines for 256/512 cells).

4. **Capacitance Ratio and Read Margin Validation**
   - Calculate capacitance ratio:
     $$\text{Ratio} = \frac{C_b}{C_s}$$
     Ensure ratio is strictly within $5:1$ to $9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$).
   - Compute nominal differential read sense margin $\Delta V$:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     Verify that $\Delta V \ge 100\ \text{mV}\text{--}150\ \text{mV}$ before approving matrix sign-off.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                       ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                       │░                            │
      V_PP WL Overdrive┤░                            │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
    Delta V Read Margin┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
C_b (Bitline Parasitic)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     C_s (Storage Node)┤█████                        │
                       │█████                        │
                       └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0     50     100    150   200 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Min / Max Bound | Units | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | PEX / 3D Field Solver Extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $200.0$ | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ (for 256–512 cells) | $\text{fF}$ | PEX Coupled $RC$ Matrix Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $7.1 : 1$ | $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ ($< 10:1$ strictly) | Ratio | Post-PEX Automated Calculation |
| **Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $125.0$ | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Extracted Static/Transient Calculation |
| **Wordline Driver Supply ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.65$ | $2.5 \le V_{PP} \le 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | DRC/LVS Overvoltage Rule & Transient Sim |

---

### Sources & Local Context Citations
1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: 
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$.
   - $C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$ for array blocks of 256 or 512 cells.
   - $C_b / C_s$ constrained to $5:1\text{--}9:1$ (degradation threshold $> 10:1$).
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Differential read voltage signal $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\ \text{mV}\text{--}150\ \text{mV}$ for $C_s = 25\ \text{fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\ \text{fF}$.
3. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - Wordline boosted overdrive requirement: $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}\text{--}2.8\ \text{V}$ to prevent access NMOS $V_{th}$ charge loss ($1.8\ \text{V} - 0.6\ \text{V} = 1.2\ \text{V}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an open-source 180nm CMOS PDK (such as SkyWater 130/180nm or open-foundry 180nm rules), parasitic extraction (PEX) for dense 8F^2 (0.259 um^2) folded bitline matrices frequently miscalculates line-to-line lateral fringe capacitance between tightly pitched Metal 1 bitlines. If C_BL exceeds 250 fF per 512-cell column, the C_BL/C_s ratio exceeds the safe ceiling of 9:1 for a 28 fF planar/trench capacitor, causing differential sense signal Delta V to collapse below 90 mV and triggering sensing false-latch failures across PVT corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Standard DRC/LVS rule decks often fail to identify 2D optical proximity effects and end-of-line enclosure margins at poly wordline (WL) over active diffusion contacts within the cell core. Extraction must accurately capture non-quasi-static distributed RC line delays across the 512-bit wordline; poly sheet resistance (~10-30 ohms/sq without silicide, or 5-8 ohms/sq with Ti/Co salicide) induces unacceptable wordline turn-on slew (>2.5 ns skew between proximal and distal access gates) unless stitched with Metal 2 straps.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology and physical verification decks must align strictly with commercially viable MPW shuttle DRC/LVS toolchains (e.g., KLayout DRC/LVS, Magic, or Calibre/Pegasus equivalents). Over-constraining layout density rules to non-standard design rules risks tapeout rejection by foundry mask shops, while proprietary foundry deck dependencies prevent open-source community reproducibility.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule slippage in WP 'DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction' directly blocks post-layout full-matrix SPICE transient simulation and corner timing sign-off for Gen 2 (180nm). We need automated rule-deck regression runs in the CI/CD pipeline with strict runtime bounds under 45 minutes on 64-core compute nodes to maintain tapeout milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inter-bitline crosstalk and parasitic capacitive coupling (C_cross / C_BL > 0.22) causing adjacent-column data corruption during concurrent sense amplifier latching.
1. Wordline distributed RC delay mismatch causing access transistor gate underdrive and destructive partial-charge transfer during short WL pulse read cycles.
1. LVS text-label mismatch or bulk substrate/well tap tie-off violations in dense array repetition resulting in undetected floating p-wells and retention degradation via sub-threshold leakage.

Run LVS extraction comparing layout netlist against hierarchical 512x512 1T1C SPICE schematic netlist with strict pin/port binding. 3. Query report logs for geometry violations, short/open circuits, floating substrate nodes, and soft-connect warnings. | `Total DRC errors = 0; Total Antenna rule violations = 0; LVS comparison status: 'NETLISTS MATCH - 0 ERRORS, 0 WARNINGS' with 100% pin/device instance matching.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-3-02` | **Full 3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (PEX) and Capacitance Ratio Verification** | FasterCap / OpenRCX / StarRC 3D field parasitic extraction tool and NGSPICE/Spectre matrix solver | 1. Run multi-corner (Typ, C-worst, RC-worst) 3D field parasitic extraction on the 512-cell folded-bitline matrix slice. 2. Extract lumped and distributed lumped-element SPEF/DSPF netlists including ground (C_gnd), plate (C_plate), and lateral coupling (C_cross) capacitances. 3. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD protective smock, Grounded conductive wrist strap with 1 Mohm series resistor, ANSI Z87.1 certified clear safety spectacles (server/lab maintenance)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent, flush thoroughly with clean water for at least 15 minutes. For digital/electronic laboratory work package, ensure primary first-aid readiness for electrical shock and repetitive strain.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard clean workstation environment / server room mechanical HVAC ventilation delivering >= 10 air changes per hour (ACH) with positive pressure filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-contaminated cleanroom wipes into sealed, vapor-tight, flammables-rated waste bins in compliance with hazardous waste regulations.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`

- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Layout drift or unversioned netlist modifications during asynchronous simulation runs leading to mask data tapeout with unextracted lateral capacitance spikes.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete DRC/LVS clean verification and comprehensive multi-corner parasitic extraction (SPEF/DSPF) for the 180nm 1T1C folded bitline and wordline core matrix, demonstrating full compliance with design rule constraints and proving a safe C_BL/C_s capacitance ratio (< 9:1) for robust signal development.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Deck Customization & Geometric Design Rule Clean-up (180nm 1T1C DRAM Matrix)

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Custom DRC Rule Deck  │
│      Formulation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Array Density &     │
│     Dummy Geometry     │
│       Insertion        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Geometric Clean-up:   │
│    BL/WL Spacing &     │
│   Contact Enclosure    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Multi-corner      │
│     Verification &     │
│        Sign-off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the custom design rule check (DRC) deck configuration, optical proximity correction (OPC) boundary setup, and geometric clean-up procedures for the **180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip** ($8F^2$ Folded Bitline matrix layout). It governs the layout verification of the access transistor, bitline (BL) contacts, tungsten plugs (W-plugs), and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) stacked storage node modules.

---

### 2. Physical Layout Parameters & Design Constraints
All geometric parameters adhere strictly to the verified literature specifications:
* **Feature Size ($F$):** $180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
* **Cell Layout Footprint:** $8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (Folded bitline architecture).
* **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
* **Shared Contact Geometry:** Tungsten plug (W-plug) contact shared symmetrically between two adjacent 1T1C cells along the bitline.
* **Storage Node Module:** Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via drain W-plug.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Rule Deck Customization for Dense Memory Array
1. In the DRC rule deck (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Calibre syntax), split standard logic design rules into separate **Array Core** and **Periphery** rule groups using layer derivation and boundary markers (`ARRAY_BOX`).
2. Implement custom geometric rules for:
   * **Active Area (OD):** Minimum width = $220\text{ nm}$, length pitch matching $8F^2$ cell pitch.
   * **Poly Gate / Wordline (PO/WL):** Critical dimension (CD) gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   * **Bitline Contact (CT/W-Plug):** Shared contact enclosure rules (minimum OD extension past contact edge $\ge 45\text{ nm}$).
   * **Capacitor Storage Node Contact (SNC):** Crown bottom-electrode landing pad enclosure on drain plug $\ge 30\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 2: Dense Array Dummy Border & Pattern Density Balancing
1. Apply dummy wordlines and dummy bitline cells around the memory array edge (minimum 2 dummy rings) to mitigate lithography corner rounding and nested-to-isolated line bias.
2. Verify active diffusion and metal pattern density rules across a moving window ($20\ \mu\text{m} \times 20\ \mu\text{m}$):
   * Active OD density: $35\% \le \text{Density}_{\text{OD}} \le 55\%$.
   * Poly/Wordline density: $30\% \le \text{Density}_{\text{PO}} \le 50\%$.

#### Step 3: Geometric Violation Clean-up & Snapping
1. Execute initial DRC run over the full $256 \times 512$ or sub-block matrix.
2. Resolve bitline-to-wordline corner-to-corner spacing violations ($S_{\text{min}} \ge 180\text{ nm}$).
3. Eliminate grid-snapping off-grid vertices by snapping all layout vertices to the primary manufacturing grid ($1\text{ nm}$ or $5\text{ nm}$).
4. Fix acute angle geometries ($< 90^\circ$) and non-manhattan notched polygons at W-plug landing pads.

#### Step 4: Final Sign-off DRC Execution
1. Run hierarchical DRC check on the top-level cell hierarchy.
2. Confirm zero DRC violations across all array core, dummy ring, and periphery-interface layers.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Verification Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Access Transistor Gate Length ($L_{\text{gate}}$) | **$180$** (Tolerance: $\pm 0$) | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Rule Check (`WIDTH PO == 0.180um`) |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Active Width ($W_{\text{active}}$) | **$220$** (Tolerance: $\pm 0$) | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Rule Check (`WIDTH OD == 0.220um`) |
| **AC-03** | 1T1C Unit Cell Layout Area ($A_{\text{cell}}$) | **$\le 0.259$** ($8F^2$) | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Area Calculation over repeating unit cell |
| **AC-04** | Total Clean-up DRC Violations | **$0$** | Count (Errors) | Full-chip Automated Hierarchical DRC Run |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Literature References
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Unit cell geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * Shared bitline contact topology via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  * Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown-shaped polysilicon/MIM structure.
* **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  * Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint with unit cell area of $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  * Noise rejection and bitline matrix integration parameters.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In transitioning from baseline foundry CMOS to open-source DRAM 1T1C COB (Capacitor-Over-Bitline) matrix layout, generic DRC decks fail to capture dense, sub-micron array boundary rules, end-of-line (EOL) pull-back tolerances on polysilicon wordlines, and minimum enclosure margins for high-aspect-ratio capacitor contacts. Standard design rule checks must be customized to balance lithography overlay budgets (±5 µm in Gen 2 planar lab equipment) against tight 180nm pitch requirements without causing catastrophic shorts or open circuit bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Custom DRC decks must explicitly govern nested geometric rules: minimum active area (OD) to gate spacing (220 nm), polysilicon wordline gate extension past active edge (>=180 nm), capacitor contact (SNCT) landing overlap on access transistor source/drain diffusion, and metal-1 bitline pitch. Failure to tighten corner rounding and diagonal proximity rules on the 8F^2 unit cell grid will result in capacitive coupling skew, sub-threshold leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C, or bridging during wet develop and liftoff/etch.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Customizing open-source DRC rule files (e.g., KLayout DRC / Magic tech files) requires alignment with locally sourced raw materials: Shipley 1813 i-line photoresist, MF-319 developer, and specific UV mask aligner tooling. Over-constraining geometric rules without validated consumable specs risks sourcing bottlenecks for sub-micron reticles or optical filters incompatible with low-cost domestic fab capabilities.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: DRC deck clean-up represents a critical gated sign-off before physical photomask generation. Scope creep in micro-optimizing peripheral logic rules must not derail sign-off for core 1T1C storage matrix rules. The timeline strictly requires an automated, regression-tested DRC script deliverable within sprint milestones to unblock downstream mask patterning.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-wordline contact bridging due to insufficient contact-to-gate enclosure rule in custom DRC deck
1. Crown capacitor node contact open-circuit caused by false clean-pass on misaligned high-aspect-ratio contact landing pads
1. Sub-threshold leakage degradation (>1 fA/cell) resulting from unflagged narrow-width effect on access transistor diffusion margins

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-3-1-01` | **Automated DRC Deck Matrix Boundary & Enclosure Rule Verification** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) / Custom Ruby/Python DRC Verification Harness executing on 64-bit Linux workstation | 1. Ingest synthetic test matrix layout containing deliberately injected violations (under-sized poly spacing of 150 nm, undersized contact enclosure of 20 nm, skewed cell boundary pitch). 2. Execute automated DRC check: 'klayout -b -r dram_180nm_cell.drc -rd input=matrix_test.gds -rd report=drc_report.xml'. 3. Parse XML report output to verify detection efficiency across all injected geometry violations. 4. Run DRC deck on full 1T1C bitline/wordline clean matrix array. | `100% of injected synthetic DRC errors must be identified (zero false negatives); full clean cell matrix must report exactly 0 DRC violations across all memory array boundary and enclosure rules.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-3-1-02` | **Critical Dimension (CD) & Overlay Tolerance Metrology Verification** | Field-Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM) with calibrated digital metrology cursor and optical line-width measurement standard | 1. Load developed calibration wafer into SEM chamber under vacuum (<1e-4 Pa). 2. Locate 10 representative 1T1C access transistor gates and bitline contact landing pads across center and edge fields. 3. Measure physical gate length (L_g), active diffusion width (W_act), and contact pad overlay margins. 4. Cross-compare measured physical dimensions against DRC deck target limits. | `Physical gate length L_g within 180 nm ± 15 nm; bitline contact enclosure overlay tolerance maintained within ±5 µm across 100% of inspected sample sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 8 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full face shield, Flame-retardant anti-static cleanroom lab coat / polypropylene gown, Cleanroom chemical apron for wet bench developer bath transfers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH exposure: Flush skin/eyes immediately with copious DI water for at least 15 minutes; seek emergency medical care immediately (risk of respiratory paralysis and cardiac arrest). For HF exposure: Immediately rinse area with water for 1 minute, then liberally apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel and massage continuously into affected skin until emergency responders arrive.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench with laminar downflow and dedicated acid/corrosive fume scrubber exhaust operating at minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with continuous magnehelic pressure differential monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate TMAH developer waste into designated alkaline waste carboys; neutralize cautiously with dilute citric or hydrochloric acid to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to hazardous waste disposal. Collect all HF/BOE waste in fluoropolymer carboys; neutralize using calcium hydroxide slurry to precipitate insoluble CaF2.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Microposit MF-319 Developer (Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide aqueous solution)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `2.2% TMAH in aqueous solution` |
| **Shipley Microposit S1813 Photoresist (consisting of Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate)** | `108-65-6` | Semiconductor Grade | `>80% PGMEA solvent matrix` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Buffer Oxide Etch BOE 6:1 for oxide surface prep)** | `7664-39-3` | CMOS / Electronic Grade | `6.6% HF, 34.6% NH4F` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and DI-water rinsed silicon substrate with native oxide stripped, hydrophobic hydride-terminated surface (water contact angle > 75 degrees).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: HMDS vapor-primed, spin-coated with Shipley 1813 resist (1.3 µm thickness) and soft-baked at 115°C, moisture-sealed and light-shielded.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes rapid uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (>1.2 nm) and airborne organic contamination, leading to poor resist adhesion, pattern lifting during development, and severe CD drift across dense wordline structures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Rule Deck Extension for Stacked Capacitor (COB) & Dense Contact Geometries

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-DRC-COB-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Process Category:** Metrology & Physical Verification (DRC / Deck Customization)  
**Target Topology:** Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) 1T1C Folded Bitline DRAM Matrix Layout

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Layer Definition & Boolean Setup: SN, PLUG, BL, WL, CB │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Dense Pitch & Width Checks (WL/BL 360-400 nm Pitch)   │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ COB Storage Node & Tungsten Contact Plug Enclosure     │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Area / Aspect Ratio Extraction (Min 25-28 fF Budget)   │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Golden GDS-II Regression & Metrology Violation Sign-off│
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Definition of Derived Mask Layers and Booleans
1. Open the base 180nm DRC runset (KLayout `drc` or Mentor Calibre `svrf`).
2. Define base topological layers for the Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stack:
   - Wordline / Access Gate Poly: `POLY` (GDS layer 10)
   - Active Diffusion: `DIFF` (GDS layer 1)
   - Shared Bitline Contact Plug: `CB_BL` (GDS layer 15)
   - Embedded Bitline: `BITLINE` (GDS layer 20)
   - Cell Storage Node Contact (Tungsten Plug / W-plug): `SN_PLUG` (GDS layer 25)
   - Crown/MIM Capacitor Storage Node Bottom Plate: `CAP_SN` (GDS layer 30)
   - Capacitor Top Plate / Cell Plate: `CAP_PLATE` (GDS layer 35)
3. Derive the access transistor channel active region:
   ```text
   GATE_AREA = POLY AND DIFF
   STORAGE_DRAIN = DIFF NOT POLY (Storage contact diffusion side)
   ```

#### Step 2: Implementation of Wordline & Bitline Pitch/Width Rule Checks
1. Implement minimum gate length and active width design rules for the access transistor:
   - Minimum gate length: `L = 180 nm` (`L_min = 0.18 um`).
   - Minimum transistor active width: `W = 220 nm` (`W_min = 0.22 um`).
2. Enforce dense memory array wordline and bitline periodic pitch checks:
   - Rule `WL_PITCH`: `POLY` spacing + width must verify pitch between `360 nm` and `400 nm`.
   - Rule `BL_PITCH`: `BITLINE` spacing + width must verify pitch between `360 nm` and `400 nm`.
3. Check bitline contact sharing geometry across two adjacent memory cells.

#### Step 3: Enclosure & Clearance Rules for Dense Contacts & Tungsten Plugs (W-Plug)
1. Add geometric clearance rule `CB_to_WL`: Minimum spacing between shared bitline contact plug (`CB_BL`) and adjacent wordline gate edge.
2. Formulate tungsten contact plug (`SN_PLUG`) to storage drain node enclosure:
   - Enforce exact symmetric enclosure of `SN_PLUG` by `STORAGE_DRAIN` to suppress junction leakage below target limit.
3. Formulate capacitor bottom electrode (`CAP_SN`) landing and enclosure rules over `SN_PLUG`:
   - Minimum overlap/enclosure of `SN_PLUG` by `CAP_SN` crown pedestal.
   - Minimum clearance between adjacent crown nodes `CAP_SN` across diagonal cell pairs.

#### Step 4: Storage Capacitor Geometry & Physical Area DRC Constraints
1. Create area and perimeter extraction checks on `CAP_SN`:
   - Compute physical 3D effective electrode area considering crown/cylinder sidewall height.
   - Enforce minimum effective area matching the cell dielectric configuration (EOT = 3 to 4 nm with $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO stack with $\kappa > 15$) to prevent design-phase layout instantiation yielding $< 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.
2. Enforce top-plate (`CAP_PLATE`) enclosure boundary over active array perimeter.

#### Step 5: Test Execution, Regression Run, and DRC Clean-up
1. Execute custom rule deck against the 180nm $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ 1T1C matrix test benchmark:
   ```powershell
   klayout -b -r drc_cob_180nm.lydrc -rd input=matrix_180nm_test.gds -rd report=drc_cob_report.lyrdb
   ```
2. Verify zero false violations along array boundaries and wordline/bitline strap cells.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | Exact DRC Nominal Constraint | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | Exact DRC Nominal Constraint | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Bitline & Wordline Grid Pitch** | `360 to 400` | $[360,\, 400]$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Storage Capacitance Metric ($C_s$)** | `25 to 28` | $\ge 25$ (Design rule limit) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Context References & Sourcing
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms tungsten plug (W-plug) stacked capacitor topology over drain contact with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Sets minimum target capacitance budget at $28\text{ fF/cell}$ and junction/sub-threshold leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Confirms $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ 1T1C architecture, bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Specifies storage capacitor retention requirement of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) and equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Grounds differential sensing margins ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$) based on $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ against bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Standard planar foundry 180nm DRC decks lack design rules for multi-tier vertical interconnects and high-aspect-ratio cylinder capacitor nodes. Integrating Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) mandates multi-pitch spacing rules, stringent contact-to-capacitor landing tolerances (<35 nm overlay budget), and 3D exclusion zones around the bitline tungsten plugs (W-plug) to avoid parasitic capacitive coupling exceeding the 15% bitline noise budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, cell layouts with 6F^2 or 8F^2 topology enforce wordline/bitline pitches of 360-400 nm. Extending the DRC rule deck requires explicit formulation of non-orthogonal crown/cylinder capacitor enclosure rules, high-density contact enclosure (SN contact to active area >= 40 nm), and dielectric breakdown minimum spacing (>= 75 nm inter-crown clearance) to guarantee 28 fF/cell storage capacitance under ONO/Ta2O5 high-k stack without leakage punch-through.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Customizing the DRC deck requires compatibility with open-source EDA tools (Magic, KLayout, OpenLane) while preserving parity with standard silicon foundry verification decks (e.g., TSMC 0.18um or SkyWater 130nm-derived flows). Sourcing and validation delays of third-party golden deck licensing could stall mask tape-out unless an automated rule translation and regression harness is deployed.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule deck customization must lock down freeze dates before bitline matrix freeze. If deck verification scripts introduce excessive false positives on dense 1T1C arrays, signoff cycle times will slip by >3 weeks; rule assertions must feature dedicated hierarchical cell filtering flags to distinguish dense array macros from periphery logic.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node contact (SNC) to bitline (BL) unmodeled bridge or short-circuit due to inadequate DRC 3D enclosure and clearance rules across CMP planarization steps.
1. Capacitor-to-capacitor sidewall dielectric breakdown and micro-bridging caused by under-constraining minimum crown edge-to-edge space (<70 nm) during lithographic optical proximity correction (OPC) rule deck checks.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-3-1-1-01` | **Dense Storage Node Contact (SNC) Enclosure and Space Rule Regression Verification** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) / Calibre DRC Batch Runner with GDSII/OASIS parsing harness | 1. Compile customized COB DRC rule deck extension with dense contact macros enabled. 2. Execute hierarchical DRC run on test vehicle containing 1,000 intentional geometric fault markers and 100,000 compliant cell instances. 3. Generate XML/ASCII error database and compute true positive, false positive, and false negative detection rates. | `100% detection of all 1,000 intentional clearance/enclosure violations; exactly 0 false positives reported in clean matrix zones; execution wall-clock time < 120 seconds.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-1-3-1-1-02` | **High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor Pitch & Exclusion Boundary Verification** | Automated GDSII Geometric Parser and Open-Source KLayout Deep DRC Engine | 1. Run rule assertion for minimum SN_CROWN outer diameter (>= 220 nm), inter-crown space (>= 75 nm), and minimum enclosure of SNC plug (>= 30 nm). 2. Verify boolean operations for crown top-contact plate overlap rules across boundary array edge cells. | `Zero unresolved design rule violations flagged across all compliant 1T1C memory array instances; minimum crown-to-crown spacing constraint strictly enforced at >= 75.0 nm (+/- 0.0 nm numerical threshold).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 4 Cleanroom Bunny Suit with ESD grounding, Full face shield over ANSI Z87.1 splash goggles, Heavyweight Nitrile/Neoprene chemical resistant gloves over cleanroom inner gloves, Chemical-resistant apron
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with HF, immediately flush with copious cold water for 5 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected skin until medical personnel arrive. If eye exposure occurs, irrigate with isotonic saline or sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye wash for 15 minutes. For acid inhalation, immediately move victim to fresh air and administer 100% oxygen with nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate solution.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet-bench exhaust hood maintaining minimum continuous face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s), monitored via magnehelic differential pressure sensors and ducted into an automated packed-bed caustic fume scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid waste drain line routed directly to automated neutralization system utilizing Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry precipitation of insoluble CaF2, with continuous digital pH neutralization between 6.5 and 8.5 before discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Wet Bench Oxide Strip)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `49 wt% in aqueous solution` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Clean)** | `7664-93-9` | Semiconductor Grade | `96 wt%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha Mixture)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP planarized oxide/W-plug surface cleaned with post-CMP megasonic rinse, native oxide thickness < 0.8 nm, zero slurry particle residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned high-aspect-ratio cylinder polysilicon or TiN bottom electrode ready for high-k (Ta2O5/ONO) atomic layer deposition without airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth exceeding 1.2 nm on bottom electrode interface creates an uncontrolled parasitic low-k dielectric barrier, reducing total cell capacitance below the mandatory 28 fF threshold and inducing high interface trap densities leading to severe refresh degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery and regression signoff of an open-source compatible DRC rule deck extension for 180nm COB DRAM architectures, validating dense contact enclosures, crown capacitor spacing, and 3D exclusion matrices without false positive artifacts.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `drc_dense_geometry_regression_report.pdf`
- [ ] `synthetic_fault_validation_matrix.csv`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum Storage Node Crown-to-Crown Spacing Rule Check Threshold** | `75 nm` | ± 0.0 nm | Automated DRC boundary check against synthetic layout raster step matrix |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Storage Node Contact (SNC) to Active Area Minimum Overlap/Enclosure Rule** | `40 nm` | ± 0.5 nm | Geometric boolean extraction and enclosure measurement via KLayout DRC regression |
| `ASSERT-03` | **DRC Regression Execution False Alarm Rate on Clean 1Mb Bitline Array** | `0 violations` | +0 violations | Full-chip automated DRC execution on clean baseline 1T1C DRAM layout |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero unresolved DRC violations on standard 1Mb 1T1C reference array macro, 100% detection rate on the synthetic 1,000-fault injection calibration vehicle, and signed peer review approval from Metrology Lead and Circuit Design Architect.
