nodes.sop_content:
### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Pre-Oxidation Particle Defect Density and Surface Roughness Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB180-WET-MET-004`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM, 1T1C COB Cell)  
**Process Stage:** RCA-1 Wet Clean / Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning $\rightarrow$ Gate Thermal Oxidation  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Operation & Metrology Quality Gate  

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-RCA1 Wafer     │
│         Infeed         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Automated Laser     │
│   Surface Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     AFM Topography     │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Particle & Roughness  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gate Oxidation Tube   │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Lot Infeed & FOUP Robotic Transfer**:
   - Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the RCA-1 dump-rinse/marangoni dry station into the metrology load-port under an ISO Class 1 mini-environment.
   - Start the maximum queue-time counter: wafers must enter the dry oxidation quartz tube furnace within $\le 120\text{ min}$ to avoid airborne organic recontamination or uncontrolled native oxide growth.

2. **Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanning**:
   - Load wafer onto the laser particle scanner chuck (e.g., Surfscan/KLA dark-field optical scatterometer).
   - Configure optical calibration recipes for bare/hydrogen-terminated single-crystal Si with an edge exclusion of $3.0\text{ mm}$.
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan detecting localized light scattering (LLS) down to the critical defect threshold corresponding to the access transistor gate length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Generate defect density maps and record defect coordinates binned at particle size $\ge 180\text{ nm}$.

3. **Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) Surface Roughness Profiling**:
   - Route sample monitor wafers automatically to the in-line AFM station.
   - Deploy non-contact/tapping mode tips to scan a $1.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ area across 5 designated test sites (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Extract the root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$) and mean roughness ($R_a$) to ensure pristine pre-oxidation interface kinetics.

4. **Disposition & Furnace Gate Clearance**:
   - Cross-check measured particle counts and $R_q$ values against statistical process control (SPC) acceptance limits.
   - If acceptance criteria pass, clear the lot tag to proceed immediately into the dry oxidation quartz tube furnace at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to grow the physical $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate $\text{SiO}_2$.
   - If particle count or roughness violates control limits, flag the lot for rework through megasonic RCA cleaning.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Queue Time to Furnace┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
     AFM Roughness Rq┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
 Defect Bin (≥180 nm)┤████                             │
                     │████                             │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      30      60      90     120 
```

| Metrology Parameter | Target Specification Limit | Tool / Detection Method | Unit | Rationale / Failure Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Defect Particle Density** | $\le 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ (Particle diameter $d \ge 180\text{ nm}$) | Dark-field Laser Surface Scanner | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Particles $> L$ ($180\text{ nm}$) bridge access transistor gates or disrupt 3.5 nm oxide continuity. |
| **Root-Mean-Square Surface Roughness ($R_q$)** | $\le 0.18\text{ nm}$ ($1\,\mu\text{m} \times 1\,\mu\text{m}$ field) | Tapping Mode In-Line AFM | $\text{nm}$ | Prevents localized high electric fields and degradation of gate oxide breakdown ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$). |
| **Queue-Time to Furnace Load** | $\le 120\text{ minutes}$ | Automated MES Timestamp Tracking | $\text{minutes}$ | Prevents uncontrolled interface trap density increase ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$). |
| **Gate Oxide Baseline Physical Thickness** *(Post-Ox Test)* | $3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ | In-Line Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | $\text{nm}$ | Complies with the 180 nm node 1T1C gate dielectric budget. |

---

#### 4. Context References & Verifications

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; particle detection bin calibrated to the minimum gate length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) to protect channel integrity and sub-threshold leakage requirements ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Governs the gate dielectric physical target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation for the 1T1C 8F$^2$/6F$^2$ access transistor.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Directs interface preparation ensuring the linear-reaction regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) achieves breakdown fields $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ with pure dry $\text{O}_2$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Metrology inline delay directly erodes the strict pre-oxidation Q-time envelope; automated darkfield laser surface inspection or optical scatterometry must complete full 150mm wafer mapping within 4 minutes to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) uptake prior to gate oxidation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a target gate oxide of 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm, sub-0.2 um particulate contamination acts as micro-masks causing pinhole shorts, while an RMS surface microroughness (Rq) exceeding 0.2 nm degrades electron inversion layer mobility and catastrophic dielectric breakdown voltage (TDDB).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring production-grade automated wafer surface particle scanners (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan) is cost-prohibitive for open-source pilot fabs; metrology must be adapted to accessible laser darkfield scattering stages, high-NA optical microscopes, or modular tapping-mode AFM units with locally sourceable calibration standards.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Clear operational boundaries and rapid pass/fail gates are mandatory between RCA-1 cleanout and thermal oxidation; technicians must not hold cleaned wafers in ambient cleanroom air while awaiting metrology results without an active N2 purged microenvironment.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature gate dielectric breakdown (TDDB) and catastrophic gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) caused by undetected sub-micron organic/silica particulates embedded in the channel interface.
1. Threshold voltage (Vth) dispersion and channel mobility degradation caused by excessive silicon surface microroughness (Rq > 0.25 nm) induced by aggressive RCA-1 chemical etching.
1. Uncontrolled native oxide formation and hydrocarbon chemisorption during extended inspection dwell exceeding ambient Q-time limits (>30 min).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-1-3-01` | **Full-Wafer Laser Surface Darkfield Particle Defect Density Metrology** | Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (405nm diode laser, darkfield PMT/photodiode collector array) calibrated with 100nm PSL (Polystyrene Latex) spheres | 1. Load 150mm wafer onto electrostatic chuck with vacuum holddown. 2. Initialize spiral scan trajectory across wafer surface excluding a 3mm edge exclusion zone. 3. Acquire raw scattered light intensity mapping and convert scattering cross-sections to equivalent sphere particle diameter. 4. Bin detected defects into size bins: 0.1-0.2 um, 0.2-0.5 um, and >0.5 um. 5. Calculate cumulative defect density (defects/cm2). | `Total particle density for defect sizes >= 0.18 um must be <= 0.08 defects/cm2 (maximum 14 total particles on 150mm wafer with 3mm edge exclusion); zero clusters of >= 3 contiguous particles.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-1-3-02` | **Sub-Angstrom Pre-Oxidation Surface Microroughness Metrology via AFM** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) operating in tapping/non-contact mode using silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 10 nm, spring constant ~40 N/m) | 1. Position wafer at 5 predetermined sites: Center, North (r=50mm), South (r=50mm), East (r=50mm), West (r=50mm). 2. Acquire a 1 um x 1 um topographical scan at each site with 512 x 512 pixel resolution at 1.0 Hz scan rate. 3. Apply first-order line leveling and second-order plane tilt correction to raw height profiles. 4. Compute Root Mean Square roughness (Rq / RMS) and arithmetic mean roughness (Ra) across each 1 um2 field. | `Site-averaged RMS roughness Rq must be <= 0.20 nm across all 5 test sites, with maximum single-site peak roughness Rq <= 0.25 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), Cleanroom anti-static ESD coat/jumpsuit, Laser safety eye protection goggles rated for 405nm (OD 5+)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Physical metrology inspection poses low chemical hazard. In case of cryogenic N2 leak or asphyxiation risk from N2 purging enclosures, move affected personnel immediately to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For accidental direct laser beam exposure, seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation within certified laminar flow hood (ISO Class 4/5) with HEPA/ULPA filtration maintaining 0.45 m/s laminar airflow; local exhaust on stage enclosures to vent laser housing cooling and automated purge lines.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: No hazardous liquid effluent generated during optical/AFM inspection. Expired PSL calibration vials should be segregated into non-hazardous particulate aqueous collection containers and disposed of per standard municipal water guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Ultra-High Purity 99.9999%)** | `7727-37-9` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / Grade 6.0) | `100%` |
| **Polystyrene Latex (PSL) Calibration Sphere Suspension** | `9003-53-6` | Analytical Calibration Standard (NIST Traceable) | `0.01% w/v in aqueous DI suspension` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, hydrogen-peroxide-passivated chemically clean silicon surface post-RCA-1 rinse/dry, free of gross organic films.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-verified ultra-clean silicon substrate ready for immediate RCA-2 ionic clean or pre-gate oxide thermal ramp.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time allows uncontrolled ambient native oxide (SiOx) nucleation (0.3-0.8 nm), moisture condensation, and airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption, resulting in unrecoverable threshold voltage shifts and high interface trap state density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Researcher has validated that the incoming wafer lot meets defect density thresholds (<= 0.08 defects/cm2 at >= 0.18 um) and RMS surface microroughness (Rq <= 0.20 nm), ensuring an atomic-grade pre-oxidation silicon interface within the 30-minute queue-time window.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `wafer_defect_darkfield_map_lot2_w04.csv`
- [ ] `surface_roughness_afm_topology_5pt.tiff`
- [ ] `pre_ox_metrology_qa_signoff_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-1-3-01` | **Cumulative wafer surface particle defect density (size >= 180 nm)** | `0.05 defects/cm2` | +0.03 defects/cm2 max | Automated 405nm laser darkfield surface scattering scan over 150mm substrate with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-1-3-02` | **Mean surface microroughness (Rq) across 5-point wafer inspection sites** | `0.18 nm` | +0.02 nm max | Tapping-mode AFM 1 um x 1 um topographical scan, 512x512 pixels with second-order plane tilt correction |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All scanned wafers display total particle defect count <= 14 (> 180nm) with zero defect clusters, 5-point AFM mean Rq <= 0.20 nm, and total elapsed inspection time <= 12 minutes from RCA-1 unload, verified and countersigned in the pilot line MES traveler.

critical_failure_modes: Premature gate dielectric breakdown (TDDB) and catastrophic gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) caused by undetected sub-micron organic/silica particulates embedded in the channel interface.
Threshold voltage (Vth) dispersion and channel mobility degradation caused by excessive silicon surface microroughness (Rq > 0.25 nm) induced by aggressive RCA-1 chemical etching.
Uncontrolled native oxide formation and hydrocarbon chemisorption during extended inspection dwell exceeding ambient Q-time limits (>30 min).

testcases.title: Full-Wafer Laser Surface Darkfield Particle Defect Density Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (405nm diode laser, darkfield PMT/photodiode collector array) calibrated with 100nm PSL (Polystyrene Latex) spheres
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer has completed RCA-1 cleaning, 18.2 MOhm-cm DI water cascade rinse, and Marangoni/spin-dry cycle; transported in an airtight N2-purged FOUP/cassette box; cleanroom ambient ISO Class 5 or better.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load 150mm wafer onto electrostatic chuck with vacuum holddown. 2. Initialize spiral scan trajectory across wafer surface excluding a 3mm edge exclusion zone. 3. Acquire raw scattered light intensity mapping and convert scattering cross-sections to equivalent sphere particle diameter. 4. Bin detected defects into size bins: 0.1-0.2 um, 0.2-0.5 um, and >0.5 um. 5. Calculate cumulative defect density (defects/cm2).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total particle density for defect sizes >= 0.18 um must be <= 0.08 defects/cm2 (maximum 14 total particles on 150mm wafer with 3mm edge exclusion); zero clusters of >= 3 contiguous particles.

testcases.title: Sub-Angstrom Pre-Oxidation Surface Microroughness Metrology via AFM
testcases.instrumentation: Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) operating in tapping/non-contact mode using silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 10 nm, spring constant ~40 N/m)
testcases.pre_conditions: Stage acoustic isolation and active vibration cancellation enabled; thermal stabilization dwell > 15 minutes; cantilever resonant frequency tuned.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position wafer at 5 predetermined sites: Center, North (r=50mm), South (r=50mm), East (r=50mm), West (r=50mm). 2. Acquire a 1 um x 1 um topographical scan at each site with 512 x 512 pixel resolution at 1.0 Hz scan rate. 3. Apply first-order line leveling and second-order plane tilt correction to raw height profiles. 4. Compute Root Mean Square roughness (Rq / RMS) and arithmetic mean roughness (Ra) across each 1 um2 field.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Site-averaged RMS roughness Rq must be <= 0.20 nm across all 5 test sites, with maximum single-site peak roughness Rq <= 0.25 nm.

ppe_required: Class 100/ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved)
Cleanroom anti-static ESD coat/jumpsuit
Laser safety eye protection goggles rated for 405nm (OD 5+)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Physical metrology inspection poses low chemical hazard. In case of cryogenic N2 leak or asphyxiation risk from N2 purging enclosures, move affected personnel immediately to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For accidental direct laser beam exposure, seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Operation within certified laminar flow hood (ISO Class 4/5) with HEPA/ULPA filtration maintaining 0.45 m/s laminar airflow; local exhaust on stage enclosures to vent laser housing cooling and automated purge lines.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: No hazardous liquid effluent generated during optical/AFM inspection. Expired PSL calibration vials should be segregated into non-hazardous particulate aqueous collection containers and disposed of per standard municipal water guidelines.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic, hydrogen-peroxide-passivated chemically clean silicon surface post-RCA-1 rinse/dry, free of gross organic films.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Metrology-verified ultra-clean silicon substrate ready for immediate RCA-2 ionic clean or pre-gate oxide thermal ramp.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding queue time allows uncontrolled ambient native oxide (SiOx) nucleation (0.3-0.8 nm), moisture condensation, and airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption, resulting in unrecoverable threshold voltage shifts and high interface trap state density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2).

expected_result.summary: Researcher has validated that the incoming wafer lot meets defect density thresholds (<= 0.08 defects/cm2 at >= 0.18 um) and RMS surface microroughness (Rq <= 0.20 nm), ensuring an atomic-grade pre-oxidation silicon interface within the 30-minute queue-time window.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Cumulative wafer surface particle defect density (size >= 180 nm)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated 405nm laser darkfield surface scattering scan over 150mm substrate with 3mm edge exclusion

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean surface microroughness (Rq) across 5-point wafer inspection sites
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Tapping-mode AFM 1 um x 1 um topographical scan, 512x512 pixels with second-order plane tilt correction

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All scanned wafers display total particle defect count <= 14 (> 180nm) with zero defect clusters, 5-point AFM mean Rq <= 0.20 nm, and total elapsed inspection time <= 12 minutes from RCA-1 unload, verified and countersigned in the pilot line MES traveler.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-WET-180-002`
**Title:** Dilute HF Oxide Strip and RCA-2 Metallic Ionic Cleansing  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This procedure executes chemical oxide stripping via dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF) followed by Standard Clean 2 (RCA-2 / SC-2) acid-peroxide treatment. The objective is to remove chemical/native oxide films created during SC-1, strip trapped contaminant layers, and solubilize trace alkali metals ($Na^+$, $K^+$) and heavy transition metal ions ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$) prior to gate dielectric and thin-film thermal oxidation.

---

### 2. Required Chemistries & Equipment

- **DHF Strip Bath:** 1:50 or 1:100 Hydrofluoric Acid ($49\%\ \text{HF}$) : Ultra-Pure Water ($\text{UPW}$) (Concentration: $0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%\ \text{HF}$ by volume). Bath vessel: PVDF / PTFE.
- **RCA-2 (SC-2) Bath:** $6:1:1$ volume ratio of $\text{UPW} : 37\%\ \text{HCl} : 30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$. Bath vessel: Quartz or PTFE with recirculating chemical heater.
- **Rinse Infrastructure:** Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) and Cascade Overflow Rinse tanks supplied with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water / UPW.
- **Drying System:** Surface-tension gradient dryer (Marangoni) or filtered high-purity dry $N_2$ blow-dryer / spin-rinse dryer.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
[Post-SC-1 Hydrophilic Wafer]
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 1: Dilute HF (DHF) Oxide Strip          │
│ • Chemistry: 1:50 to 1:100 HF:UPW (0.5%–1.0%)│
│ • Temperature: 22°C                          │
│ • Duration: 15–30 seconds                    │
│ • Endpoint: Hydrophobic dewetting transition │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 2: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse     │
│ • DI Water Resistivity: 18.2 MΩ·cm           │
│ • Cycles: 5 dump cycles / 3 minutes          │
│ • Target: Complete acid clearance            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Cleansing      │
│ • Chemistry: 6 UPW : 1 HCl (37%) : 1 H2O2 (30%)│
│ • Temperature: 70°C–80°C                     │
│ • Immersion Time: 10 minutes                 │
│ • Target: Alkali (Na+, K+) & heavy metal strip│
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 4: Final Cascade Rinse & Resistivity Cut│
│ • DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW                   │
│ • Resistivity Endpoint: > 16 MΩ·cm           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 5: High-Purity N2 Blow-Dry              │
│ • Medium: High-purity filtered N2 gas        │
│ • Target: Zero residual water spotting       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### Step 1: Dilute Hydrofluoric (DHF) Native Oxide Strip
1. Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the post-SC-1 intermediate rinse tank into the ambient DHF immersion bath.
2. Maintain bath chemistry at **1:50 to 1:100 $\text{HF}:\text{UPW}$** ($0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%\ \text{HF}$) at an operating temperature of **$22^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Immerse wafers for **$15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$**.
4. Monitor endpoint via surface transition: the wafer surface changes from hydrophilic to completely hydrophobic (liquid sheets off cleanly with zero wetting).

#### Step 2: Intermediate Deionized Water Dump Rinse
1. Immediately transfer cassette from DHF bath to Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) within $< 5\text{ seconds}$ to prevent air exposure staining.
2. Execute dump rinse using **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** deionized water for **$3\text{ minutes}$** (or $5$ dump cycles) to quench fluoride residue.

#### Step 3: RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Ionic Cleansing
1. Submerge cassette into the heated RCA-2 chemical bath containing **$6\text{ parts UPW} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\ \text{HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$**.
2. Maintain bath temperature steadily at **$70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Process wafers for an immersion period of **$10\text{ minutes}$** to complex and dissolve alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).

#### Step 4: Final Cascade Overflow Rinse
1. Transfer cassette to final cascade overflow rinse tank supplied with continuous $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW.
2. Continue flushing until the downstream bath effluent reaches an electrical resistivity of **$> 16\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.

#### Step 5: Wafer Drying
1. Transfer wafers immediately to the drying module.
2. Perform spin-rinse drying or blow-drying utilizing high-purity filtered **$\text{N}_2$ gas** until wafer surfaces are completely dry and free of water spots.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Inspection Method | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DHF Strip Endpoint Wettability** | Optical Contact Angle / In-line Vision | Surface hydrophobic transition (dewetting) | Non-wetting ($\theta > 70^\circ$) |
| **RCA-2 Bath Process Temperature** | In-situ RTD / Thermocouple probe | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **RCA-2 Immersion Duration** | Automated Wet Bench Robot Timer | $10.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{minutes}$ |
| **Final Rinse Effluent Resistivity** | In-line Resistivity Sensor | $> 16.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

### 5. Literature References
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - HF dip ratio (1:50 HF:$\text{H}_2\text{O}$), exposure window ($15\text{--}30\text{ s}$), and hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic surface transition.
  - RCA-2 composition ($6\ \text{UPW} : 1\ \text{HCl}\ (37\%) : 1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$), process temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$), immersion duration ($10\text{ minutes}$), and $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**
  - DHF concentration parameters ($1:50\text{ to }1:100\ \text{HF}:\text{UPW}$ / $0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%$), temperature ($22^\circ\text{C}$), and dewetting endpoint verification.
  - Cascade rinse specification with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW and effluent cut-off threshold ($> 16\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Contextual gate and pre-dielectric purity constraint for 180nm access transistors ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Cascade dump rinsing must maintain online resistivity monitoring (>16 MOhm-cm) between the dilute HF (DHF) strip and RCA-2 bath to prevent catastrophic acid drag-in, bath contamination, and uncontrolled surface micro-roughening prior to thin gate dielectric growth.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct immersion into RCA-2 immediately re-oxidizes the hydrogen-terminated silicon surface following the DHF oxide strip; bath stoichiometry (6:1:1 UPW:HCl:H2O2) and temperature (70°C-80°C) must be tightly stabilized to suppress noble metal catalytic pitting while ensuring total desorption of transition metal ions (Fe, Cu, Ni).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires continuous qualification and supply assurance for semiconductor/electronic-grade (SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 1) 49% HF, 37% HCl, and 30% unstabilized H2O2, with incoming certificate of analysis tracking trace metal impurities below 10 ppt.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Strict throughput bottleneck controls must enforce cleanroom queue-time enforcement between RCA-2 final rinse/spin-rinse-dry and the gate oxidation furnace load station to prevent unplanned scrap cycles and unrecoverable yield fall-out.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Fluoride carryover and cross-contamination into the RCA-2 bath causing severe silicon micro-pitting and surface haze degradation (RMS roughness > 0.2 nm).
1. Noble metal back-plating (specifically copper deposition) onto exposed bare silicon during the dilute HF etch prior to complete oxidative passivation.
1. Excessive queue-time (Q-time) excursion prior to furnace load resulting in uncontrolled ambient native oxide regrowth (>0.3 nm) and airborne molecular contamination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-01` | **Post-DHF Native Oxide Strip Completeness and Surface Hydrophobicity Test** | Automated Optical Spectroscopic Ellipsometer and Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer | 1. Immerse wafer in 1:50 DHF:UPW bath for 25 seconds. 2. Quick dump rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW for 90 seconds. 3. Transfer immediately to goniometer stage and measure static water contact angle across 9 test sites. 4. Transfer to ellipsometer and measure residual oxide thickness across 49 points. | `Static water contact angle >= 75.0 degrees across all points; residual silicon dioxide thickness <= 0.10 nm.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-02` | **Post-RCA-2 Surface Metallic Ionic Contamination and Roughness Verification** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer and Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Mount wafer into cleanroom ISO Class 1 mini-environment TXRF loading chamber. 2. Execute angle-resolved surface elemental scan across 5 target locations to quantify trace transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn). 3. Transfer wafer to AFM tool and scan three 1x1 µm field areas for surface roughness. | `Surface concentrations of Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn each < 1.0E+10 atoms/cm²; surface RMS roughness (Rq) <= 0.18 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full chemical-splash face shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Heavy-duty double-layered butyl/neoprene wet bench gauntlets (minimum 15 mil thickness), Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeve guards, Steel-toe chemical safety boots with integral splash gaiters
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Immediately flush skin exposure with continuous cold water for exactly 2 minutes; apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel generously with gloved hands, continuously massaging into affected tissue until medical emergency personnel arrive. For ocular contact, flush with sterile isotonic eyewash for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open and immediately summon emergency services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench dedicated acid scrubbed laminar exhaust operating with static hood face velocity maintained at 100 FPM (±10 FPM) and continuous differential pressure sensor interlocks connected to automated chemical dispensing shut-off valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated dual-plumbing drain lines: HF effluent routed strictly to dedicated fluoride precipitation and calcium fluoride (CaF2) recovery waste tanks; RCA-2 acid/peroxide effluent routed to automated acidic waste neutralization (AWN) station utilizing 20% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) dosing to achieve pH 6.5-8.5.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 1 (Trace Metal < 10 ppt) | `0.5% - 1.0% (diluted from 49%)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Grade 1 (Electronic Grade) | `37% stock (1:6 bath dilution)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 1 (Stabilizer-free) | `30% stock (1:6 bath dilution)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic silicon surface passivated with chemical oxide and depleted of gross organic residue following RCA-1 clean.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean, atomically smooth, hydrophilic native passivated chemical oxide (~0.5-0.8 nm thick) free of metallic ionic contaminants and halogen residues.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces non-uniform airborne molecular organic contamination adsorption and uncontrolled native oxide growth, leading to dielectric breakdown and unrecoverable threshold voltage dispersion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful strip of native oxide and removal of metallic contamination below trace limits with passivated chemical oxide interface readiness for 180nm gate oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DHF_RCA2_surface_ellipsometry_thickness_map.csv`
- [ ] `TXRF_trace_metal_contamination_report.pdf`
- [ ] `AFM_surface_microroughness_scan.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total surface metallic contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni) after RCA-2 clean and rinse** | `1.0E+10` | <= 1.0E+10 atoms/cm² per individual element | Angle-resolved Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface root-mean-square (RMS) microroughness Rq** | `0.15` | +0.03 nm (maximum allowable Rq = 0.18 nm) | 1x1 µm non-contact mode Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Final chemical oxide thickness preceding gate dielectric growth** | `0.65` | ± 0.15 nm | 49-point automated spectroscopic ellipsometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> TXRF metallic ion counts below 1.0E+10 atoms/cm², AFM RMS roughness below 0.18 nm, zero particulate adders >= 0.2 µm, and transfer to gate oxidation furnace initiated within 30 minutes of spin-rinse-dry completion.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Preparation and Formulation of 50:1 DHF and SC-2 Chemical Baths

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-RCA-002`  
**Process Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line (180nm Open-Source DRAM)  
**Classification:** Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   1. Dispense 18.2   │
│   MOhm-cm DI Water   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  2. Formulate 50:1   │
│       DHF Bath       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  3. Formulate SC-2   │
│  6:1:1 DIW:HCl:H2O2  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   4. Heat SC-2 to    │
│       70C-80C        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    5. QA Check &     │
│  Acceptance Signoff  │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Pre-Check**
   - Verify acid wet bench exhaust velocity and secondary containment status. Ensure PVDF/PTFE tanks are clean and free of particulate residue.
   - Verify supply of electronic-grade reagents: 18.2 MΩ·cm Deionized Water (DIW), 49% Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$), 37% Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$), and 30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).

2. **50:1 Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid (DHF) Bath Formulation**
   - In a PVDF/PTFE tank, dispense **50 parts** deionized water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Meter and blend **1 part** Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$, 49% electronic grade) into the DIW. *Always add acid to water.*
   - Maintain ambient chemical bath temperature ($20^\circ\text{C} - 25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Ensure the bath is primed for stripping native oxide (15–30 seconds immersion) until surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.

3. **SC-2 (RCA-2) Chemical Bath Formulation**
   - In a quartz immersion tank equipped with an inline fluoropolymer circulation heater, dispense **6 parts** deionized water (18.2 MΩ·cm).
   - Carefully introduce **1 part** Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, 37% electronic grade) into the DI water while recirculating.
   - Introduce **1 part** Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30% semiconductor grade) to establish the volumetric ratio of **$6:1:1$ ($\text{DIW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.

4. **SC-2 Bath Heating & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Energize the immersion tank heater with continuous recirculation.
   - Ramp and stabilize bath operating temperature within the range of **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Maintain temperature stability for metallic ionic desorption ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+, \text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) across a 10-minute cycle target.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\ge 18.2$ | Inline resistivity sensor at supply manifold | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **DHF Volumetric Mixing Ratio** | `50:1` | $50:1 \pm 0.5$ ($\text{DIW}:\text{HF}$) | Automated wet bench liquid mass/volumetric dosing flowmeters | Volume Ratio (parts) |
| **SC-2 Volumetric Mixing Ratio** | `6:1:1` | $6:1:1 \pm 0.1$ ($\text{DIW}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Automated wet bench chemical delivery metering pumps | Volume Ratio (parts) |
| **SC-2 Bath Operating Temperature** | `75.0` | $70.0 - 80.0$ | Dual-sheathed PFA thermocouple immersed in bath | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Verified Context Literature Citations

- **`Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure`**:
  - *DHF Formulation & Native Oxide Strip*: 1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15–30 seconds; transitions silicon surface from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2) Formulation*: 6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - *SC-2 Bath Thermal Envelope*: Temperature heated to $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes to eliminate alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
  - *Rinse Specification*: Dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes before nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated chemical delivery and bath dosing must guarantee precise dilution tracking (50:1 UPW:HF and 6:1:1 UPW:HCl:H2O2) with continuous online conductivity, optical concentration monitoring, and bath temperature feedback. Exothermic self-heating during acid hydration must be stabilized before wafers enter the immersion zone to prevent etch non-uniformity across the 180nm wafer batch.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: 50:1 DHF oxide etching requires a stable etch rate of thermal and chemical SiO2 (~0.8 to 1.0 nm/min) without inducing surface microroughness (delta Ra < 0.05 nm). In SC-2, excessive temperature (>78°C) accelerates H2O2 self-decomposition, degrading redox potential and failing to strip metallic contaminants such as Fe, Cu, and Ni below the 1e10 atoms/cm2 threshold prior to gate oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Requires SEMI Grade 5 (or Grade 4 minimum) electronic-grade chemicals (49% HF, 37% HCl, 30% H2O2) certified with sub-ppb trace metal specs. H2O2 drums require vented caps, temperature-controlled transit (<20°C), and localized inventory buffers to mitigate high-peroxide degradation and regional supply disruptions in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Formulation recipe qualification, bath lifetime verification (DHF bath life 24h, SC-2 bath life 8h), and drain/neutralization readiness must be signed off within a 2-day integration window to prevent downstream gate dielectric oxidation furnace idle-time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Peroxide decomposition in SC-2 leading to metal ion precipitation (specifically Cu and Fe plating onto bare Si surfaces) instead of complexation and removal.
1. Inaccurate DHF formulation or localized evaporation creating high HF concentrations (>2 wt%) causing uncontrollable SiO2 undercut and pitting of the silicon substrate.
1. Exhaust failure or inadequate chemical bath draft resulting in toxic HF/HCl vapor crossover into adjacent cleanroom photolithography bays causing environmental amine/acid poisoning.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-1-01` | **50:1 DHF Etch Rate and Dilution Uniformity Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (film thickness), 4-point probe, and Online Conductivity Sensor | 1. Measure baseline SiO2 thickness at 49 points across the wafer using spectroscopic ellipsometry. 2. Immerse the wafer into the 50:1 DHF bath for precisely 120.0 seconds. 3. Transfer immediately to quick-dump rinser (QDR) and rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW until effluent resistivity reaches 18.0 MOhm-cm. 4. Spin rinse dry under filtered N2. 5. Remeasure 49-point thickness and calculate average etch rate and within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma). | `SiO2 etch rate must be 0.90 nm/min +/- 0.10 nm/min; within-wafer etch rate non-uniformity (1-sigma) must be <= 1.8%.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-1-02` | **SC-2 Bath Chemical Ratio and Metallic Decontamination Efficacy Test** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer, Automated Chemical Titrator, and Immersion Bath Pt100 Thermocouple | 1. Perform automated titration to quantify HCl and H2O2 normality/weight percentages in bath. 2. Immerse contaminated test wafer in SC-2 bath for 10 minutes at 75°C. 3. Overflow rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW until bath dump resistivity > 18.0 MOhm-cm. 4. Isopropanol (IPA) vapor dry. 5. Perform TXRF scan across 9 points to measure residual Fe, Cu, and Ni surface areal density. | `Titration shows HCl at 4.5% - 5.5% w/w and H2O2 at 3.5% - 4.5% w/w; residual Fe and Cu surface concentrations must each be < 5.0e9 atoms/cm2 by TXRF.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty chemical splash apron (Neoprene or Butyl), Full-face polycarbonate shield combined with chemical splash goggles, Butyl or Viton chemical gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Acid-resistant chemical boots (PVC/Neoprene), Continuous personal HF gas monitor badge
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse with high-flow eyewash/safety shower for 2-5 minutes; apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel continuously to affected skin using clean gloved hands until medical personnel arrive. For ocular contact: Flush with sterile saline/water and instill 1% calcium gluconate eye drops under medical direction. For HCl/H2O2 contact: Flush thoroughly with copious UPW for >= 15 minutes. Seek emergency medical attention immediately for all exposures.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench dedicated acid scrubbed exhaust; continuous exhaust velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) at bench lip; continuous differential pressure monitoring with interlocked audio-visual alarm triggering automatic bath cover closure upon exhaust flow drop below 80%.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated waste drain lines: DHF effluent routed to Fluoride Waste Neutralization (FWN) system for calcium fluoride precipitation via Ca(OH)2/CaCl2 slurry; SC-2 acid effluent routed to Central Acid-Base Neutralization (AWN) system utilizing 10% NaOH dosing to neutralize pH to 6.5 - 8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 | `49% wt in aqueous solution (diluted to 1.0% in 50:1 bath)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Grade 5 | `37% wt aqueous solution` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 | `30% wt unstabilized electronic grade` |
| **Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2 | `Resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm-cm at 25°C, TOC < 1 ppb` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, particulate-free Si surface post-SC-1 organic and particle clean with ~1.0-1.5 nm chemical oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Ultra-clean, halogen-passivated chemical oxide surface (SC-2 re-oxidized, ~0.6-0.8 nm oxide thickness) with alkali/transition metals < 5.0e9 atoms/cm2, perfectly prepared for high-k gate dielectric or gate thermal oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth, airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption, and atmospheric moisture chemisorption creating gate dielectric interface state trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2) and severe gate oxide breakdown voltage degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful formulation, chemical qualification, and bath validation of 50:1 DHF and SC-2 wet processing tanks yielding reproducible thermal oxide strip rates and sub-5e9 atoms/cm2 residual transition metal contamination prior to 180nm DRAM gate oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DHF_SC2_Formulation_Batch_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `DHF_Oxide_Etch_Rate_Map_49pts.csv`
- [ ] `SC2_Post_Clean_TXRF_Metals_Scan.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **50:1 DHF etch rate of thermal SiO2 at 21.0°C** | `0.90 nm/min` | +/- 0.08 nm/min | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 49-point pre/post etch measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **SC-2 post-immersion transition metallic surface concentration (Fe, Cu, Ni)** | `3.0e9 atoms/cm2` | < 5.0e9 atoms/cm2 max | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometry |
| `ASSERT-03` | **SC-2 Bath Process Temperature Stability** | `75.0°C` | +/- 1.5°C | In-situ calibrated dual Teflon-sheathed Pt100 RTD sensors |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Sequential Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch and SC-2 Metallic Decontamination

**Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication]  
**Sub-Process:** RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Gen 2 (µm) / Action Type: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Dilute HF Dip 1:50   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dump Rinse 18.2     │
│        MOhm-cm         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   SC-2 Clean 70-80C    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Final Rinse & N2 Dry  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Readiness:**
   - Verify active bench exhaust and ensure calcium gluconate gel is stocked and immediately accessible at the wet station.
2. **Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip:**
   - Prepare a **1:50 HF:H₂O** dilute bath.
   - Immerse wafer lot for **15 to 30 seconds** at ambient temperature to strip native oxide until the silicon surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic (complete de-wetting / water beading).
3. **Intermediate Deionized Water Rinse:**
   - Transfer wafers immediately into an automated dump rinser.
   - Rinse with high-purity **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized water for **3 minutes** to halt chemical action and purge trace fluoride.
4. **SC-2 (RCA-2) Metallic Ionic Cleansing:**
   - Prepare the SC-2 bath with volumetric ratio **6 parts DI H₂O : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H₂O₂**.
   - Heat and stabilize the bath at **70°C – 80°C**.
   - Submerge wafer cassette for **10 minutes** to eliminate alkali contaminants ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and dissolve heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).
5. **Final Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) & Drying:**
   - Cascade rinse in **18.2 MΩ·cm** DI water until overflow resistivity recovers.
   - Perform spin-rinse dry / dry wafer surfaces completely using high-purity filtered **Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry**.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Bath Concentration** | `1:50` ($\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) | Volumetric ratio | Refractometer / Automated Chemical Dosing Controller |
| **HF Strip Immersion Duration** | `15 – 30` | Seconds ($\text{s}$) | Wet Bench Recipe Timer Controller |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line Resistivity Sensor |
| **SC-2 Bath Temperature** | `70 – 80` | Degrees Celsius ($^\circ\text{C}$) | Calibrated Immersion Thermocouple / PID Controller |
| **SC-2 Process Duration** | `10` | Minutes ($\text{min}$) | Automated Station Recipe Timer |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:** Chemical ratios (1:50 HF:H₂O dip; 6:1:1 DI H₂O:37% HCl:30% H₂O₂ SC-2), step durations (15–30 s HF dip, 3 min dump rinse, 10 min SC-2), temperature target (70°C–80°C for SC-2), resistivity specification (18.2 MΩ·cm), target contaminants (alkali ions $\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$, and heavy metals $\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$), and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Safety protocol requiring calcium gluconate gel presence at the wet station due to HF calcium-binding hazard.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Sequencing dilute HF (DHF) directly before SC-2 introduces a critical cross-contamination vulnerability at the wet bench robot transfer station. Residual fluoride dragging into the hot SC-2 bath (75°C, HCl/H2O2) risks generating volatile HF vapors and accelerating quartz bath dissolution. Dump rinse cascade timing between baths must guarantee bath carryover is below 1 ppm F- with minimum resistivity recovery to 18.0 MOhm-cm within 90 seconds.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The native oxide strip endpoint must achieve pure silicon hydrogen passivation (Si-H bond formation) characterized by complete surface dewetting. Transitioning directly into hot acidic SC-2 without sufficient cascade dump rinsing causes micro-roughening and premature uncontrolled chemical regrow of defective Si-O-Cl complexes, which drastically impairs gate oxide breakdown voltage (BV_ox) during subsequent 180nm DRAM thermal oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Hydrofluoric acid (49% electronic grade, SEMI Grade 5) and semiconductor-grade hydrochloric acid (37% UP-S) have stringent supply chains with limited local synthesis in Vietnam. Sourcing certified ultrapure H2O2 with sub-10 ppt transition metal (specifically Fe, Cu) specification is non-trivial; uncertified bulk chemical usage will defeat SC-2 desorption and cause metallic threshold contamination.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Cycle time must be tightly bounded: DHF etch is 15-30s, followed by a 3-minute QDR cycle, and 10 minutes in SC-2 at 75°C. Any delay exceeding the 15-minute inter-bath queue window degrades gate dielectric uniformity across the wafer batch, requiring immediate automated lot hold and rework authorization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete native oxide removal due to bath HF depletion (<0.45% HF), leaving residual SiO2 patches and pinhole defects prior to gate oxidation.
1. Fluoride-induced quartz vessel micro-etching and silicon pitting if rinse cascade fails to remove ionic F- before 75°C SC-2 immersion.
1. Precipitation of transition metal silicides (e.g., Cu-silicide spikes) on bare Si if SC-2 H2O2 concentration degrades below stoichiometric requirement for metal complexation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-2-01` | **Post-DHF Hydrophobic Dewetting and Native Oxide Removal Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (J.A. Woollam M-2000 or equivalent) & Optical Contact Angle Goniometer | 1. Immerse wafer cassette in 1:100 DHF bath for 30 seconds with 10 Hz lateral oscillation. 2. Transfer cassette to Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) bath for 5 complete fill-and-dump cycles with UPW until resistivity > 18.1 MOhm-cm. 3. Spin-rinse dry under heated 0.02 µm filtered N2. 4. Measure residual oxide thickness at 49 points across wafer surface via spectroscopic ellipsometry. 5. Measure DI water droplet contact angle at center and 4 edge points. | `Residual equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.20 nm across 100% of measured sites; DI water static contact angle >= 75.0 degrees confirming complete hydrophobic H-passivated silicon.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-2-02` | **Post-SC-2 Surface Metallic Ionic Cleansing and Trace Contamination Assay** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer / Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS with VPD preconcentration) | 1. Transfer wafer batch into SC-2 chemical bath and maintain immersion for 600 seconds at 75°C. 2. Perform cascade overflow rinse in UPW bath until resistivity reaches 18.2 MOhm-cm for at least 180 seconds. 3. Marangoni dry under high-purity IPA vapor and filtered N2. 4. Perform Vapor Phase Decomposition (VPD) droplet collection using HF/H2O2 micro-droplet scan. 5. Quantify Fe, Cu, Ni, Na, and Al surface concentrations using TXRF / ICP-MS. | `Surface concentrations for Fe, Cu, Ni, and Al <= 1.0 x 10^10 atoms/cm²; Na surface concentration <= 5.0 x 10^9 atoms/cm².` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full face shield (polycarbonate ANSI Z87.1 approved) over splash goggles, Heavyweight butyl rubber chemical apron (minimum 20 mil thickness), Viton or butyl outer safety gloves over dual nitrile inner cleanroom gloves, Chemical-resistant neoprene safety boots with steel toe and non-slip sole
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5% USP grade) must be stocked inside the wet bench emergency caddy within arm's reach. For any HF skin contact: flush continuously with cold water for 2 minutes, then massage Calcium Gluconate Gel continuously into the exposed area until medical personnel arrive. Eye exposure: flush with sterile isotonic saline or water for 15 minutes and instill 1.0% sterile calcium gluconate eye drops. For HCl/H2O2 vapors: immediately remove victim to fresh air, administer high-flow oxygen, and monitor for pulmonary edema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet bench exhaust with face velocity of 100 +/- 10 FPM at hood sash opening; wet bench containment connected to dedicated fluorinated/acidic fume scrubber with differential pressure interlock (< -0.25 inches w.g.).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated dual drain system: DHF drain routes directly to dedicated Calcium Fluoride Precipitation Tank (slaked lime Ca(OH)2 addition to precipitate CaF2 solid cake); SC-2 effluent routes to Acid-Waste Neutralization (AWN) system with automatic 2-stage caustic (NaOH) titration to maintain discharge pH between 6.5 and 8.5.

| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI/ULSI) | `0.5% - 1.0% w/w working bath (diluted from 49%)` |

| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 (Electronic Grade) | `3.5% - 4.0% w/w working bath (diluted from 30%)` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic chemical oxide (~0.6-0.8 nm SiO2) from pre-oxidation SC-1 clean, free of organic hydrocarbons and particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Atomically clean, controlled passivated chemical oxide (~0.4-0.6 nm) with sub-10^10 atoms/cm² metal ions, primed for high-temperature gate oxidation furnace.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne moisture and ambient cleanroom organics (hydrocarbons, volatile siloxanes) re-adsorb onto bare chemical oxide, and uncontrolled native oxide regrowth causes high gate leakage current (I_gate), threshold voltage shift (V_th), and catastrophic time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB) failure.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful sequential native oxide strip via dilute HF (100:1) and metallic ionic desorption via SC-2 clean, delivering an atomically flat, sub-ppt metal contaminated, passivated silicon substrate ready for 180nm gate dielectric thermal growth.

- [ ] `TXRF_ICPMS_surface_metals_report.pdf`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF residual oxide thickness prior to SC-2 immersion** | `0.15 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm | 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-SC-2 critical metallic contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni)** | `5.0e+09 atoms/cm2` | <= 1.0e+10 atoms/cm2 upper specification limit | Vapor Phase Decomposition TXRF spectrometry |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Final QDR overflow rinse water resistivity** | `18.2 MOhm-cm` | -0.2 MOhm-cm | In-line calibrated conductivity/resistivity sensor at wet bench drain manifold |

critics.systems_engineer: Sequencing dilute HF (DHF) directly before SC-2 introduces a critical cross-contamination vulnerability at the wet bench robot transfer station. Residual fluoride dragging into the hot SC-2 bath (75°C, HCl/H2O2) risks generating volatile HF vapors and accelerating quartz bath dissolution. Dump rinse cascade timing between baths must guarantee bath carryover is below 1 ppm F- with minimum resistivity recovery to 18.0 MOhm-cm within 90 seconds.
critics.domain_expert: The native oxide strip endpoint must achieve pure silicon hydrogen passivation (Si-H bond formation) characterized by complete surface dewetting. Transitioning directly into hot acidic SC-2 without sufficient cascade dump rinsing causes micro-roughening and premature uncontrolled chemical regrow of defective Si-O-Cl complexes, which drastically impairs gate oxide breakdown voltage (BV_ox) during subsequent 180nm DRAM thermal oxidation.
critics.supply_chain: Hydrofluoric acid (49% electronic grade, SEMI Grade 5) and semiconductor-grade hydrochloric acid (37% UP-S) have stringent supply chains with limited local synthesis in Vietnam. Sourcing certified ultrapure H2O2 with sub-10 ppt transition metal (specifically Fe, Cu) specification is non-trivial; uncertified bulk chemical usage will defeat SC-2 desorption and cause metallic threshold contamination.
critics.laya_pm: Cycle time must be tightly bounded: DHF etch is 15-30s, followed by a 3-minute QDR cycle, and 10 minutes in SC-2 at 75°C. Any delay exceeding the 15-minute inter-bath queue window degrades gate dielectric uniformity across the wafer batch, requiring immediate automated lot hold and rework authorization.
critical_failure_modes: Incomplete native oxide removal due to bath HF depletion (<0.45% HF), leaving residual SiO2 patches and pinhole defects prior to gate oxidation.
Fluoride-induced quartz vessel micro-etching and silicon pitting if rinse cascade fails to remove ionic F- before 75°C SC-2 immersion.
Precipitation of transition metal silicides (e.g., Cu-silicide spikes) on bare Si if SC-2 H2O2 concentration degrades below stoichiometric requirement for metal complexation.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Post-Clean Hydrophobicity Contact Angle and TXRF Metallic Residue Metrology  
**Module:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line | Metrology  
**Node / Technology:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inline Automated Inspection System)

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the metrology verification protocol following Dilute HF oxide strip and RCA-2 metallic cleansing. It qualifies the bare silicon substrate prior to 850°C–1000°C gate oxidation (3.5–4.0 nm physical thickness target) by quantifying surface hydrogen termination (hydrophobicity via deionized water contact angle goniometry) and residual transition metal ionic contamination (via Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence, TXRF).

---

### 2. Metrology Workflow & Execution Steps

```text
+-----------------------+     +--------------------------+     +------------------------+
| Wafer Transfer & Load | --> | Sessile Drop Contact     | --> | Glancing-Angle TXRF    |
| (FOUP -> Metrology)   |     | Angle Goniometry (DI H2O)|     | Trace Metallic Scan    |
+-----------------------+     +--------------------------+     +------------------------+
                                                                            |
                                                                            v
                                                               +------------------------+
                                                               | Inline Disposition     |
                                                               | (Pass -> Gate Furnace) |
                                                               +------------------------+
```

1. **Automated Wafer Handling & Alignment:**
   - Transfer wafer from pre-clean wet bench cassette/FOUP into class-1 mini-environment metrology station under clean dry air (CDA) or $\text{N}_2$ purge.
   - Perform optical notch alignment.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Contact Angle Goniometry:**
   - Dispense an ultra-pure deionized (DI) water micro-droplet ($1.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$, resistivity $> 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) onto the wafer surface at 5 standard radial test sites (Center, North, South, East, West at 5 mm edge exclusion).
   - Capture droplet profile within 5 seconds using automated high-resolution CCD goniometer camera to prevent ambient evaporation or surface re-oxidation.
   - Fit tangent angle across three-phase boundary to calculate static contact angle $\theta_c$. Hydrophobic H-terminated bare Si confirms successful complete oxide strip without native oxide repassivation.

3. **TXRF Metallic Residue Spectroscopy:**
   - Load wafer onto TXRF high-precision goniometer stage under high vacuum ($< 10^{-4}\ \text{Pa}$).
   - Direct incident monochromatic Mo-$K_\alpha$ or W-$L_\beta$ X-ray beam at grazing incidence angle below the critical angle of total external reflection ($\phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.18^\circ$ for Si).
   - Acquire energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across 3 to 9 site map points covering active channel array areas ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ layout footprint regions).
   - Integrate characteristic fluorescent peaks for iron ($\text{Fe}$), copper ($\text{Cu}$), and nickel ($\text{Ni}$).

4. **Surface Stability & Queue-Time Disposition:**
   - Validate post-clean surface queue time ($Q\text{-time} < 2\ \text{hours}$) to prevent native oxide regrowth before loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation quartz tube furnace.
   - Record metrology telemetry into factory MES; generate lot pass/fail flag.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Tool / Technique | Target Spec / Threshold | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | Automated Optical Goniometer | $> 70^\circ$ (Hydrophobic H-terminated surface) | Degrees ($^\circ$) |
| **Surface Metallic Residues ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni}$)** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) | $< 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ |
| **Sub-surface Residual Native Oxide** | Multi-wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | $< 0.2$ (pre-thermal gate oxide growth) | nm |
| **Max Pre-Furnace Queue Time** | Automated Factory MES Timer | $\le 120$ | Minutes |

*Subsequent process target correlation: Prepares channel for gate oxide target of 3.5 to 4.0 nm with $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ and $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$.*

---

### 4. Literature References & Citations

- **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]:**
  - Confirms gate dielectric physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\ \text{nm}$ grown in dry $\text{O}_2$ at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ to achieve breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$ (which requires strict metallic-free and oxide-free initial interfaces).
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**
  - Defines the access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), emphasizing leakage current constraints ($< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at 85°C) sensitive to transition-metal precipitates and gate interface states.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**
  - Specifies thermal gate oxide processing conditions ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation, $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness) and overall 1T1C retention time limits ($> 64\ \text{ms}$ at 85°C).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-3-01` | **Post-Clean Particle & Metallic Trace Contamination Assay** | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor / Surfscan) & TXRF Spectrometer | 1. Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-1-2-3-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade (< 1 ppb metals) | `49% conc. or 1:50 DHF` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (NH4F)** | `12125-01-8` | Electronic Grade | `40% aq (for BOE 6:1 buffer)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (unstabilized) | `30% aq (for SC-1 & SC-2)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | Electronic Grade | `37% aq (for SC-2 clean)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29% aq (for SC-1 clean)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Post-Clean Hydrophobicity Contact Angle and TXRF Metallic Residue Metrology: Chemical cleaning and surface preparation verified with zero watermark defects, bare hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon, and calibrated oxide etch rate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Surface_particle_laser_scan_Surfscan.pdf`
- [ ] `Sessile_drop_contact_angle_measurement.png`
- [ ] `DHF_BOE_calibrated_etch_rate_sheet.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF bare silicon water contact angle** | `>= 75.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI water droplet) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface particulate defect density (> 0.1 um)** | `< 15 particles/wafer` | Max acceptable particle count on 100mm wafer | Darkfield Laser Surface Inspection (Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `< 1.0e10 atoms/cm²` | Max allowable contamination | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer surface exhibits 100% uniform dewetting / hydrophobicity with zero visible drying marks under bright light; residual native oxide Tox < 0.2 nm confirmed by spectroscopic ellipsometry.
