# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation

**Module:** Front-End Fabrication / Wet Chemistry & Surface Preparation  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Access Transistor Channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Subsequent Operation:** Dry Thermal Oxidation ($3.5\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$)

---

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Piranha SPM Clean  │
│  (Organic Stripping)│
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Standard Clean 1   │
│  (SC-1 / APM Bath)  │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Intermediate DHF   │
│  (Oxide Deglaze)    │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Standard Clean 2   │
│  (SC-2 / HPM Bath)  │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Final DHF Dip &   │
│  Si-H Passivation   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Marangoni / IPA   │
│      Vapor Dry      │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Clean Bulk Organic Strip (SPM / Piranha Clean):**
   - Immerse wafers in $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ ($4:1$ volume ratio) at $110^\circ\text{C} - 120^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$.
   - Overflow Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) with ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for $5\text{ min}$.

2. **Standard Clean 1 (SC-1 / APM - Particle & Organic Removal):**
   - Process wafers in $\text{NH}_4\text{OH} (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 (30\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:1:5$ by volume) at $70^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ with megasonic agitation ($1.0\text{ MHz}$).
   - Cascade dump rinse with ultra-pure DIW until effluent resistivity exceeds $18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

3. **Intermediate Native Oxide Strip (DHF Deglaze):**
   - Dip wafers in dilute hydrofluoric acid $\text{HF} : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:50$ or $1:100$, $\sim 0.5\% - 1.0\%\text{ HF}$) at $22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ for $60 - 90\text{ s}$ to strip chemical oxide and trapped contaminants.
   - Quick dump rinse (QDR) in deoxygenated DIW for $3\text{ min}$.

4. **Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / HPM - Metallic Contamination Extraction):**
   - Immerse wafers in $\text{HCl} (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 (30\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:1:6$ by volume) at $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ to desorb and complex alkali ions and heavy metal impurities ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
   - Cascade overflow rinse with ultra-pure DIW until bath resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

5. **Final Surface Hydrogen-Passivation Dip:**
   - Submerge wafers in ultra-pure dilute $\text{HF}$ ($1:100\text{ HF} : \text{H}_2\text{O}$) at $21^\circ\text{C} - 23^\circ\text{C}$ for $45\text{ s}$ to produce a hydrophobic, dangling-bond-free silicon surface with terminated $\text{Si-H}$ bonds.
   - Rinse in cold deoxygenated DI water ($< 10\text{ ppb dissolved } \text{O}_2$) for $60\text{ s}$.

6. **Surface Drying & Queue Limit Execution:**
   - Execute surface drying using an IPA (isopropanol) vapor / Marangoni surface tension gradient dryer to prevent water marks.
   - Transfer wafers into nitrogen purged pod ($\text{N}_2$ purge, $\text{RH} < 10\%$) with a pre-oxidation queue limit of $< 2\text{ hours}$ prior to quartz tube dry thermal oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Capacitance Budget┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
      D_it (log10)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
   Oxide Thickness┤▓▓▓▓▓                               │
                  │▓▓▓▓▓                               │
       E_bd Target┤██████████████                      │
                  │██████████████                      │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| # | Inspection Parameter | Acceptance Target Metric | Measurement Tool / Metrology Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $\mathbf{< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}}$ | High-frequency / Quasistatic Capacitance-Voltage ($C-V$) Profiling |
| **2** | **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $\mathbf{> 10\text{ MV/cm}}$ | Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB) / Ramp Voltage Breakdown ($I-V$) |
| **3** | **Pre-Oxidation Clean Cleanliness / Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | Physical thickness target $\mathbf{3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}}$ (post-oxidation) with zero surface watermark defects ($\ge 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ particle count $< 10\text{ per wafer}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) / Laser Surface Particle Scanner |
| **4** | **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $\mathbf{< 1\text{ fA/cell}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring cell capacitance budget retention $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer ($I_{off} - V_g$ at elevated chuck temp) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Governs dry thermal oxidation regime where thin oxide ($3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$) interface reaction-rate kinetics require clean, trap-free pre-oxidation surfaces yielding $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ and dense breakdown strength $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Establishes the dry thermal oxidation baseline at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ for $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical gate $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness and target capacitance budgeting of $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Dictates access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage current cutoff $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Upstream cassette transfer and dump rinser cascade times must be interlocked with the dry oxidation furnace scheduler; any variation in megasonic power density (>0.8 W/cm2) in SC-1 or uneven rinse resistivity recovery below 16 MOhm-cm across the 25-wafer batch directly impacts downstream gate oxide interface trap density (Dit) and Fowler-Nordheim tunneling uniformity.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The standard RCA sequence must balance native oxide removal and silicon microroughness: excessive NH4OH in SC-1 aggressively etches Si(100), increasing surface roughness (Ra > 0.15 nm), which degrades breakdown field strength (Ebd) across 180nm thin thermal gate oxide. Intermediate dilute HF dip (1:50) must achieve sharp hydrophobic termination (contact angle > 70 deg) without leaving surface fluorine precipitates that retard dry oxidation kinetics.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade (SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 5) hydrogen peroxide (H2O2 30%) and electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (HF 49%) require dedicated cold-storage and fluoropolymer-lined drums with lot-to-lot metallic contaminant validation (<0.1 ppb Fe, Cu, Ni); supply disruptions in stabilizer-free ultra-pure H2O2 will accelerate bath decomposition and induce catastrophic particle shedding.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: RCA wet bench batch throughput must clear 50 wph to prevent fab bottlenecking at the thermal oxidation queue; strict maintenance windows for SC-1/SC-2 bath replacement every 4 hours or 8 runs must be scheduled to avoid unbudgeted scrap and queue-time violations before gate oxidation furnace loading.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Microroughness-induced breakdown field degradation (Ebd < 10 MV/cm) caused by SC-1 bath overheating (>80°C) or uncontrolled NH4OH concentration ratio.
1. Uncontrolled regrowth of sub-stoichiometric native oxide (SiOx) and airborne volatile organic carbon (VOC) uptake due to Q-time breach prior to gate oxidation.
1. Heavy metal contamination (Fe/Cu precipitates) due to SC-2 bath exhaustion or bath cross-contamination, causing premature DRAM retention degradation and anomalous junction leakage.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-01` | **Post-RCA Surface Particle Count and Microroughness Metrology** | Laser surface particle scanner (KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 or equivalent, 180nm sensitivity) and Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM, Bruker Dimension Icon) | 1. Load dried test wafer into laser surface particle scanner; perform 100% surface scan with 90nm to 180nm defect binning. 2. Measure particle defect adder density across the active wafer area excluding 3mm edge exclusion. 3. Transfer wafer to AFM under cleanroom ISO Class 4 conditions; map 1 µm x 1 µm surface scans at 5 points (center, top, bottom, left, right). 4. Calculate root-mean-square roughness (Rq) and average roughness (Ra). | `Total particles (>=180nm): <= 0.05 defects/cm2 (<= 15 defects per 200mm wafer). AFM surface roughness Ra <= 0.12 nm (tolerance: +/- 0.02 nm).` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-02` | **Surface Metallic Impurity and Native Oxide Passivation Verification** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF, Rigaku TXRF 3760) and Optical Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (J.A. Woollam M-2000) | 1. Position wafer in TXRF chamber under clean vacuum; calibrate glancing angle below critical angle (0.05 deg). 2. Acquire fluorescence spectrum integration over 1000 seconds at center and mid-radius points for Fe, Cu, Ni, and Zn. 3. Transfer immediately to spectroscopic ellipsometer; measure native chemical oxide thickness at 9 points across wafer diameter. | `Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu): < 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 per species. Post-RCA-2 protective chemical oxide thickness: 0.8 nm to 1.2 nm (uniformity standard deviation <= 0.05 nm).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant neoprene/Viton heavy-duty gauntlets with outer nitrile disposable gloves, Full-face polycarbonate chemical splash shield combined with ANSI Z87.1 splash goggles, Acid- and base-resistant heavy-duty PVDF/PTFE chemical apron with sleeve protectors, Steel-toe neoprene safety boots with acid-resistant gaiters
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) skin exposure: Immediately flush affected area with copius cold water for 60 seconds, then immediately massage Calgonate (2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel) continuously into skin until medical arrival; for eye exposure: irrigate continuously with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye wash or normal saline for at least 15 minutes; seek emergency medical intervention immediately. For SC-1/SC-2 splashes: irrigate with emergency eyewash/deluge shower for minimum 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated point-of-use wet bench exhaust with segregation: Acid exhaust line (FRP ducting, continuous face velocity 0.5 m/s, negative static pressure -250 Pa connected to packed wet acid scrubber) segregated from ammonia/base exhaust (connected to separate acid-gas/base scrubber to prevent ammonium chloride salt deposition). Continuous airflow monitoring interlocked to wet bench power.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fluoride-bearing waste streams routed exclusively to dedicated Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) precipitation/clarifier systems (treated with Ca(OH)2/CaCl2, target F- < 10 ppm). Acid (SC-2) and basic (SC-1) rinse effluents routed to automated central Industrial Waste Neutralization (IWN) balance tanks with continuous dual-probe pH dosing control (pH 6.5 to 8.5) before municipal sewer discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 5 | `49% (diluted to 1.0% in bath)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 5 | `29% aqueous` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 5 | `30% electronic grade (unstabilized)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Tier 1 / Grade 5 | `37% aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Silicon surface with non-uniform ambient native oxide (0.5-2.0 nm), residual photoresist ash polymers, atmospheric hydrocarbons, and trace handling particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, atomically smooth Si(100) passivated with a pristine, stoichiometric chemical oxide (0.8-1.2 nm) free of trace organics, alkali, and transition metals.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes airborne organic contaminant adsorption and parasitic non-uniform native oxide growth, inducing localized gate oxide thinning, high interface trap density (Dit > 1E+11 eV-1 cm-2), and catastrophic gate leakage in 180nm DRAM pass transistors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full RCA-1, dilute HF, and RCA-2 wet clean recipe execution yielding an atomically pristine, particle-free silicon surface with a controlled chemical passivation oxide ready for 180nm DRAM gate thermal oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `rca_surface_clean_metrology_report.pdf`
- [ ] `txrf_afm_roughness_particle_data.csv`
- [ ] `surface_ellipsometry_passivation_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Surface particle contamination density for particle sizes >= 180nm** | `0.03 defects/cm2` | <= 0.05 defects/cm2 max | Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual transition metal surface concentration (Fe, Cu, Ni)** | `5.0E+09 atoms/cm2` | < 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 max | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Silicon surface microroughness (AFM Ra on 1 µm x 1 µm area)** | `0.10 nm` | <= 0.12 nm max | Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM tapping mode) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero safety/ventilation interlock trips during run, post-clean particle density <= 0.05 defects/cm2, all transition metal species < 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2, AFM Ra <= 0.12 nm, and direct cassette transfer to pre-oxidation furnace dry ambient within the 30-minute air Q-time window signed off by Lead Wet Process Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Electronic-Grade RCA Chemical Reagent Qualification and Bath Preparation

### 1. Process Flow Diagram
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  RCA Chemical Reagent  │
│     Qualification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   RCA-1 / SC-1 Bath    │
│      Prep: 5:1:1       │
│    DI:NH4OH:H2O2 at    │
│         70-80C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dump Rinse 18.2     │
│  MOhm-cm DI Water for  │
│         3 min          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dilute HF Strip:    │
│    1:50 HF:H2O for     │
│         15-30s         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   RCA-2 / SC-2 Bath    │
│      Prep: 6:1:1       │
│     DI:HCl:H2O2 at     │
│         70-80C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Final DI Water Rinse  │
│    and N2 Spin-Dry     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Reagent Receipt & Assay Verification**:
   - Inspect electronic-grade chemical lots for specification compliance:
     - Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$): $29\%$ assay.
     - Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$): $30\%$ assay.
     - Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$): $37\%$ assay.
     - Deionized (DI) Water: verify in-line resistivity is $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

2. **RCA-1 (Standard Clean 1 / SC-1) Bath Preparation**:
   - In a clean fluoropolymer/quartz tank, charge volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH } (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%) = 5 : 1 : 1$$
   - Enable bath immersion heater and stabilize temperature to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **$10 - 15\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize and solubilize organic films and particle contamination.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier to the QDR tank.
   - Cycle rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water for **$3\text{ minutes}$**.

4. **Dilute Hydrofluoric (DHF) Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Charge dilute HF bath with volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{HF} : \text{DI H}_2\text{O} = 1 : 50$$
   - Submerge wafers for **$15 - 30\text{ seconds}$** until the silicon surface transitions completely from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
   - Perform an immediate intermediate dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.

5. **RCA-2 (Standard Clean 2 / SC-2) Bath Preparation**:
   - In a secondary clean quartz bath, mix volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl } (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%) = 6 : 1 : 1$$
   - Heat and maintain solution temperature at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **$10\text{ minutes}$** to desorb alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and precipitate/dissolve metallic contaminants ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).

6. **Final Rinse and Dry**:
   - Transfer to cascade dump rinser with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.
   - Perform final surface drying using high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry / spin-rinse-dryer.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Specification | Tolerance & Units | Monitoring Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RCA-1 Bath Temperature** | $70 - 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-tank PFA-sheathed RTD / Thermocouple |
| **RCA-2 Bath Temperature** | $70 - 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-tank PFA-sheathed RTD / Thermocouple |
| **DHF Strip Immersion Time** | $15 - 30$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Wet bench robotic recipe timer |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor |

---

### 4. Context References Citing
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - Reagent concentration benchmarks: $29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH}$, $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$, $37\%\text{ HCl}$.
  - Volumetric ratios: RCA-1 ($5:1:1$), RCA-2 ($6:1:1$), and DHF ($1:50$).
  - Temperature setpoints: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for RCA-1 and RCA-2.
  - Duration windows: RCA-1 ($10 - 15\text{ min}$), RCA-2 ($10\text{ min}$), DHF dip ($15 - 30\text{ s}$), and Dump Rinse ($3\text{ min}$).
  - Water quality and drying: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ dry.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Bath life degradation and disproportionation of H2O2 in both SC-1 and SC-2 directly shift chemical kinetics and etch rates across cassette batches. An automated chemical spiked-replenishment or strict 4-hour pot-life cutoff must be interlocked with the fab MES wet bench scheduler to prevent uncontrolled surface microroughness (RMS > 0.18 nm) prior to high-k dielectric growth.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM capacitor and gate oxide stacks, trace metallic contamination in SEMI Grade 5 reagents—specifically Fe, Cu, and Al—must remain strictly below 0.1 ppb. Transition metals left uncomplexed during SC-2 bath preparation will act as deep-level recombination centers and initiate premature gate oxide breakdown (TDDB) and sub-threshold storage cell leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade UPW (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 2 ppb) and SEMI C12/C8 Grade chemicals (NH4OH 29%, H2O2 30%, HCl 37%) must be dual-sourced with certified lot-specific ICP-MS assay verification; regional supply delays of stabilized electronic-grade H2O2 can cause unmonitored bath outgassing and microbubble defects on 200mm wafers.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procuring pre-mixed or certified drumming for the pre-oxidation wet line requires strict incoming container assay signoff within 48 hours of lot receipt to prevent thermal oxidation line starvations, with clear budget-to-yield tracking on cleanroom chemical consumption vs. bath dump cycles.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal runaway or rapid catalytic decomposition of H2O2 in the SC-1 bath catalyzed by trace metallic impurities, causing bath boiling, micro-bubble pit formation, and uneven surface etching.
1. Metallic precipitation (Fe/Cu deposition) on bare hydrophobic silicon if the dilute HF strip is unbuffered or if SC-2 acid complexation is executed at depleted HCl/H2O2 stoichiometries.
1. Megasonic acoustic streaming cavitation damage or surface particle redeposition caused by zeta-potential inversion in stagnant or spent SC-1 solutions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-1-01` | **Incoming Electronic-Grade Chemical Assay and Trace Metal Ion Purity Qualification** | Agilent 8900 Triple Quadrupole ICP-MS with inert PFA sample introduction system and automated liquid chemical delivery manifold | 1. Extract 50 mL aliquot from incoming chemical delivery drum (NH4OH 29%, H2O2 30%, HCl 37%) using dedicated pre-leached fluoropolymer pipettes into PFA vials under localized HEPA laminar flow. 2. Prepare 1:10 dilution using 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW in triplicate. 3. Aspirate samples into ICP-MS system measuring metallic ion concentrations of Fe56, Cu63, Ni58, Zn64, Ca40, and Al27. 4. Record quantitative mass-to-charge counts, calculate blank-subtracted concentrations in ppb, and generate automated statistical compliance report. | `Pass if all target transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn) and alkali/alkaline earth metals (Ca, Al) are individually <= 0.10 ppb (100 ppt); Fail if any single metallic species exceeds 0.10 ppb or total combined trace metal contamination exceeds 0.50 ppb.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-1-02` | **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Stoichiometry, Temperature Stability, and Megasonic Particle Removal Efficiency** | KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 Unpatterned Surface Defect Inspection System, inline NIR chemical concentration sensor, and calibrated Teflon-sheathed RTD temperature probes | 1. Verify SC-1 bath stabilizes at 72.5°C +/- 2.5°C with 1 MHz megasonic power set to 800 W. 2. Verify SC-2 bath stabilizes at 75.0°C +/- 2.0°C. 3. Inspect seeded test wafers on KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 to map pre-clean particle coordinates and counts. 4. Submerge wafer cassette into SC-1 for 10 minutes with megasonics, perform 5-cycle cascade dump rinse until resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm, transfer to SC-2 for 10 minutes, cascade dump rinse to 18.2 MOhm-cm, and dry via Marangoni N2 dryer. 5. Inspect post-clean wafers on Surfscan SP2 and calculate Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE). | `Pass if PRE >= 98.0% for defect sizes >= 0.18 µm, post-clean added particle count <= 10 particles/wafer, and bath temperatures maintained within +/- 2.0°C of setpoint throughout the 10-minute cycles; Fail if PRE < 98.0% or post-clean particle density exceeds 0.05 particles/cm2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full chemical splash face shield over ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Heavyweight butyl/neoprene gauntlet gloves over double nitrile examination gloves, Acid/alkali-resistant chemical apron with full sleeves (PTFE/Viton coated), Steel-toe neoprene safety boots with slip-resistant chemical-proof soles, Cleanroom-compatible half-mask emergency acid gas/ammonia vapor respirator
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately strip contaminated clothing, flush affected area with copiously flowing water for exactly 2 minutes, and apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel continuously with gloved hands until medical rescue arrives; for eye exposure, irrigate with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or saline for 15 minutes. For NH4OH or HCl splash: Flush with emergency deluge shower for 15 minutes and administer humidified oxygen if vapor inhaled. Seek immediate tertiary burn/toxicology care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated wet bench laminar exhaust hoods operating under continuous negative pressure (-50 Pa relative to cleanroom ballroom); face velocity strictly maintained at 0.5 +/- 0.1 m/s; separate dedicated acid scrubber exhaust ducting for HCl/HF and dedicated base/ammonia scrubber exhaust ducting to prevent violent airborne ammonium chloride salt precipitation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated drain systems: Acid drain stream (HCl/HF) routed to an automated fluoride precipitation and continuous acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system using calcium hydroxide [Ca(OH)2] dosing to form insoluble CaF2 precipitate, followed by pH trim to 6.5 - 8.5; Base drain stream (NH4OH/peroxide) routed to catalytic peroxide decomposition tanks with manganese dioxide/carbon bed destruct followed by aeration and automated pH adjustment before municipal discharge compliance.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Ammonium Hydroxide** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI C12 Grade 5 | `28.0% - 30.0% w/w` |

| **Hydrochloric Acid** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI C8 Grade 5 | `36.5% - 38.0% w/w` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI C8 Grade 5 | `48.0% - 50.0% w/w (diluted 1:50-1:100)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic (post-dilute HF native oxide strip, Si-H passivated, contact angle > 70 deg) or degreased raw silicon prior to clean sequence.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Chemical passivation state: Hydrophilic chemical oxide (0.8 - 1.2 nm SiOx) post-SC-2 / clean dump rinse with contact angle < 10 deg, or bare hydrogen-terminated silicon with contact angle > 75 deg if post-SC clean includes an in-situ final HF last dip.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes uncontrolled ambient hydrocarbon condensation, native oxide regrowing with variable thickness and sub-stoichiometric defects, and airborne boron/phosphorus contamination, resulting in gate oxide breakdown, interface state trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2), and DRAM access transistor Vth shifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full analytical qualification and bath preparation of electronic-grade RCA-1 and RCA-2 chemistry suites meeting SEMI Grade 5 specifications, verifying trace metal concentrations <= 0.1 ppb, bath thermal/stoichiometric stability, and wafer cleaning Particle Removal Efficiency >= 98% with validated Marangoni drying.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `pre_clean_particle_removal_efficiency_map.tiff`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) on 200mm silicon monitor wafers for defect sizes >= 0.18 um** | `99.2%` | +/- 0.8% (strictly >= 98.0% absolute threshold) | Pre- and post-clean laser scattering surface defect mapping via KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure: Sequential SC-1 Organic Clean, DHF Native Oxide Strip, and SC-2 Metal Desorption Recipe Execution

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-RCA01`  
**Classification:** Front-End Fabrication / Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation Passivation  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Line:** Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: SC-1 Organic Clean (70°C - 80°C)   │
│  Solubilize organics & oxidize light traces  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm DI water cascade dump (3 min)    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Dilute HF (DHF 1:50) Native Strip  │
│  Native oxide removal (15 s - 30 s)          │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 4: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm DI water cascade dump (3 min)    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 5: SC-2 Metal Desorption (70°C - 80°C)│
│  Desorb alkali (Na+, K+) & heavy ions        │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 6: Final Dump Rinse & N2 Blow-Dry     │
│  High-purity filtered N2 surface dry         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Stage 1: Standard Clean 1 (SC-1 / RCA-1) Bath Preparation & Immersion**
   - Formulate chemical bath using a volumetric ratio of `5 : 1 : 1`:
     - 5 parts Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$)
     - 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$)
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)
   - Heat the quartz bath to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafer cassette and process for **10 to 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface residues and oxidize trace light metals.

2. **Stage 2: Intermediate Dump Rinse**
   - Transfer wafer cassette immediately into a quick-dump rinse (QDR) tank.
   - Rinse continuously with ultra-pure deionized water with a resistivity of **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** for **3 minutes**.

3. **Stage 3: Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid (DHF) Native Oxide Strip**
   - Prepare a **$1:50\ \text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$** volumetric bath at ambient cleanroom temperature.
   - Dip wafer cassette for **15 to 30 seconds** to strip the native silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) layer.
   - Observe wafer surface transition from hydrophilic (sheet wetting) to hydrophobic (beading dewetting).

4. **Stage 4: Post-DHF Cascade DI Rinse**
   - Transfer immediately to the QDR tank.
   - Flush with **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water for **3 minutes** to eliminate all residual fluoride ions.

5. **Stage 5: Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / RCA-2) Heavy Metal Desorption**
   - Formulate chemical bath using a volumetric ratio of `6 : 1 : 1`:
     - 6 parts Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$)
     - 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\ \text{HCl}$)
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)
   - Heat bath to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **10 minutes** to strip alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).

6. **Stage 6: Final Dump Rinse & Nitrogen Blow-Dry**
   - Perform final multi-cycle dump rinse with **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water.
   - Transfer to spin-rinse dryer (SRD) or N2 dry station; execute surface dry utilizing **high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ gas**.
   - Immediately queue wafers for dry thermal oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}\ \text{SiO}_2$ target) to prevent uncontrolled ambient re-oxidation.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Temperature** | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-spec within $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ calibrated bath RTD/thermocouple |
| **DI Water Rinse Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Online inline resistivity sensor |
| **DHF Dip Exposure Duration** | $15.0 - 30.0$ | $\text{s}$ | In-spec within $15 - 30\ \text{s}$ | Automated wet bench recipe timer |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Immersion Time** | SC-1: $10 - 15$ / SC-2: $10$ | $\min$ | Exact cycle duration | Automated robotic hoist timer |

---

### 3. Context Citations & Literature Traceability

- **Bath Chemistries, Dilutions & Durations:**
  - *Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*
    - SC-1 recipe: $5:1:1\ \text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\ (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10-15\ \min$.
    - Rinse specification: Dump rinse with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\ \min$.
    - DHF native oxide strip: $1:50\ \text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ for $15-30\ \text{s}$ (hydrophilic to hydrophobic shift).
    - SC-2 recipe: $6:1:1\ \text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl}\ (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\ \min$.
    - Drying: High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Downstream Thermal Oxidation & Gate Stack Integration:**
  - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
    - Gate oxide integration: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Transistor Dimensioning:**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
    - Transistor gate footprint channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated wet bench sequence must enforce interlocking between bath recirculating chemical spiked heating and wafer boat transfer robotics; any uncontrolled bath fluid level drops or temperature overshoots (>82°C) trigger rapid boiling, H2O2 runaway catalytic decomposition, and NH3 vaporization that degrades boundary-layer mass transport and uniform etching across 200mm wafers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The HF native oxide strip step requires tight control of etching time and dilution (1:50 DHF); over-etching induces microscopic surface microroughness (RMS > 0.18 nm) due to excessive silicon pitting, while incomplete DHF stripping leaves patchy native sub-oxides that trap heavy metal contaminants before the SC-2 chemical passivating oxide regrowth.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Hydrofluoric acid (HF 49%), electronic grade ammonium hydroxide (NH4OH 29%), semiconductor-grade hydrochloric acid (HCl 37%), and stabilized ultrapure hydrogen peroxide (H2O2 30%) require SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI/ULSI) certification with metallic impurities below 0.1 ppb to prevent introducing catastrophic iron and copper cross-contamination into the front-end gate oxidation line.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: RCA sequence bath life is capped at 4 hours or 12 wafer cassette runs due to H2O2 thermal degradation and NH4OH evaporation; wet bench scheduling must synchronize clean termination with dry thermal oxidation load-lock pumpdown to avoid exceeding the strict 30-minute clean-to-furnace queue time window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete DHF stripping or improper DHF-to-SC-2 intermediate rinse causing carryover of fluoride ions into the acidic SC-2 bath, leading to uncontrollable silicon substrate etching and micro-hazing.
1. Catalytic decomposition of H2O2 in SC-1 triggered by metallic particle contamination, resulting in localized wafer micro-pitting, elevated bath temperature excursions, and particulate re-deposition.
1. Queue-time expiry (>30 minutes in cleanroom air) prior to thermal oxidation gate loading, causing uncontrolled native chemical oxide regrowth with high interface trap state density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-2-01` | **Post-SC-2 Metallic and Ionic Contamination Surface Density Test** | Vapor Phase Decomposition Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (VPD-ICP-MS) | 1. Transfer dried test wafer into the VPD chamber within 15 minutes of SC-2 dry completion. 2. Expose wafer surface to concentrated HF vapor (49%) to dissolve passivated chemical oxide film and collect surface droplets using a 100 µL scanning droplet of 1% HF / 1% H2O2. 3. Aspirate scan collection droplet directly into the ICP-MS introduction system. 4. Quantify trace concentrations of target transition and alkali metals: Fe, Cu, Ni, Na, and K across the 200mm wafer surface. | `Total surface concentration for Fe, Cu, and Ni must each be < 1.0e10 atoms/cm²; Na and K alkali concentrations must each be < 5.0e10 atoms/cm².` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-2-02` | **DHF Hydrophobicity Verification and Post-SC-2 Surface Microroughness Metrology** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer and Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) | 1. Post-DHF step: Dispense a 5 µL droplet of 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW on 5 distinct wafer coordinate points (center, 4 quadrants at 30mm edge exclusion) and measure the static sessile contact angle within 60 seconds. 2. Post-SC-2 step: Load completed wafer into AFM staging station under vibration isolation. 3. Scan three 2 µm x 2 µm silicon surface areas (center, mid-radius, edge) at a scan rate of 0.5 Hz. 4. Extract root-mean-square roughness (Rq / RMS). | `Post-DHF static contact angle must be >= 75° across all 5 points (verifying complete native oxide removal and hydrogen termination); post-SC-2 AFM surface roughness RMS must be <= 0.15 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty Neoprene/Viton chemical gauntlets (double gloving with nitrile underlayers), Full-face polycarbonate chemical splash shield with ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Acid- and alkali-resistant PTFE/Neoprene apron with chemical sleeve protectors, Steel-toe chemically resistant safety boots with boot covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse affected skin under emergency deluge shower for 1 to 2 minutes; immediately apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel and massage continuously into affected dermal areas until medical personnel arrive. In case of eye contact, flush with sterile eyewash solution or 1% Calcium Gluconate eye drops for a minimum of 15 minutes. For HCl / NH4OH inhalation or skin contact, rinse with Copious UPW/tap water for 15 minutes and administer supplemental oxygen under trained medical supervision.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated segregated wet-bench exhaust: dedicated acid scrubber exhaust duct (FRP/polypropylene) maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) at lip exhaust slots; dedicated caustic/ammonia exhaust duct for SC-1 to avoid ammonium chloride salt precipitation in ventilation ductwork.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated chemical drain lines: DHF waste routed to Dedicated Fluoride Precipitation System (dosed with calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2 to precipitate insoluble CaF2 sludge); SC-1 and SC-2 effluents drained to automated two-stage Acid-Base Neutralization (ABN) system monitored by dual-redundant pH sensors to maintain discharge effluent between 6.0 and 8.5 pH.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `49% wt stock, diluted to 1:50 (approx 1.0%)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `37% wt` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `29% wt as NH3` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `30% wt (electronic grade, stabilized)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic silicon surface contaminated with organic airborne residues, light photoresist ashes, and native oxide (1.2 - 1.8 nm thickness) post-lithography ash/dry-etch.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Atomically flat, particle-free, chemically passivated protective chemical oxide layer (~0.6 - 0.8 nm thickness) with zero trace metallic contamination (<1e10 atoms/cm²), ready for gate dielectric oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled regrowth of defective native oxide in ambient cleanroom air with dissolved hydrocarbon adsorption, inducing high interface state density (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2), early dielectric breakdown (TDDB), and threshold voltage (Vth) shifts in 180nm DRAM access transistors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful sequential execution of SC-1 organic strip/particle lift-off, 1:50 DHF oxide removal, and SC-2 metal desorption recipe, yielding pristine silicon surfaces with baseline-level trace metal contamination, ultra-low particle adders, and uniform chemical oxide passivation ready for immediate gate dielectric furnace loading.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RCA_Batch_TraceMetal_VPD_ICPMS_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Post_Clean_Surface_Roughness_AFM_Profile.tiff`
- [ ] `RCA_Wet_Bench_Run_Log_and_Particle_Defect_Map.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Critical transition metal contamination density (Fe, Cu, Ni) post SC-2 clean** | `< 1.0e10` | atoms/cm² max | VPD-ICP-MS wafer surface mapping |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Particle adders at size >= 0.18 µm on 200mm wafer surface** | `< 10` | particles/wafer adders | Laser surface particle defect scanner (KLA-Tencor Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-SC-2 surface microroughness (RMS / Rq)** | `0.12` | +/- 0.03 nm | Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscopy (2 µm x 2 µm window) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative metrology criteria (metal contamination < 1e10 atoms/cm², particle count <= 10 adders @ 0.18 µm, surface roughness RMS <= 0.15 nm) must pass QA threshold, bath temperatures and chemical dump rinse resistivity must log stable at >= 18.2 MOhm-cm, and wafer cassettes must be transferred into N2 purge load-lock within the 30-minute queue time window signed off by the Fab Operations Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Post-RCA Passivation Surface Metrology, Contact Angle, and Particle Defect Inspection
- **Project Tracking ID:** `SOP-FAB-FEOL-180NM-MET-004`
- **Node & Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)
- **Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > Dry Thermal Oxidation & High-K ALD Deposition Recipe Execution > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation > Metrology
- **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inspection & Metrology Toolset: Automated Goniometer, Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, Unpatterned Darkfield Defect Inspection System)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post-RCA Clean Lot   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│         Angle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│  Ellipsometry Native   │
│         Oxide          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Darkfield Laser     │
│    Particle Defect     │
│       Inspection       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gate Oxidation Tube   │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Inspection Stage Environmental & Carrier Load Check**
   - Transfer the post-RCA cleaned and passivated wafer cassette directly from the wet bench spin-rinse dryer (SRD) output buffer to the Class 1 mini-environment FOUP/SMIF interface under continuous clean dry N₂ purge.
   - Verify inspection tool environment: Cleanroom ambient temperature $21 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $40 \pm 3\%$, Class 1 filter canopy active.
   - Enforce maximum queue time limit: The entire metrology loop must complete within **$< 30\text{ minutes}$** post-rinse/dry to prevent uncontrolled native oxide growth prior to furnace loading.

2. **Hydrophobic / Hydrophilic Surface Passivation (Contact Angle Goniometry)**
   - Load the designated monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck.
   - Dispense an ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) droplet ($1.0 \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$) using an automated piezo-driven micro-syringe at 5 distinct site locations (Center, North, South, East, West at $R = 70\text{ mm}$).
   - Perform automated sessile drop optical edge detection within $2\text{ seconds}$ of droplet contact to evaluate termination quality:
     - For DHF-last H-terminated hydrophobic surface: record water contact angle $\theta_c$.
     - For SC-1/chemical oxide hydrophilic surface: record water contact angle $\theta_c$.
   - Automated nitrogen blow-off and wipe-free droplet suction to prevent drying stains.

3. **Sub-Nanometer Native Oxide Film Metrology (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry)**
   - Transfer the monitor wafer to the high-resolution multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometer stage.
   - Execute a 9-point polar map scan across the wafer active surface using calibrated wavelengths ($\lambda = 190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) at an incidence angle of $70^\circ$.
   - Fit the measured $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra using a standard $Si / SiO_2$ Cauchy optical dispersion model to quantify the residual chemical/native oxide thickness ($t_{ox,0}$) ensuring substrate baseline readiness for the target physical gate dielectric thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$).

4. **Surface Particle Defect & Micro-Contamination Inspection (Darkfield Laser Scattering)**
   - Transfer product and monitor wafers to the darkfield unpatterned surface inspection tool.
   - Scan wafer surface using an oblique/normal incidence UV/DUV laser ($355\text{ nm}$ or $266\text{ nm}$) with darkfield high-angle photomultiplier tube (PMT) detectors.
   - Quantify total particle adder count and particle size distribution binning down to the critical defect threshold ($> 90\text{ nm}$, equal to half the $180\text{ nm}$ access transistor channel length $L$).
   - Flag and map any local clusters, streak defects, or haze excursions; automatically hold the lot if defect count exceeds out-of-control limits (OOC).

5. **Lot Disposition & Quartz Furnace Gate Release**
   - Automatically compile metrology data into the fab MES/SPC database.
   - If contact angle, native oxide thickness, and defect metrics satisfy all acceptance thresholds, mark the lot as **PASS** and route directly to the dry thermal oxidation quartz tube furnace (recipe at $850^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Control Limit / Tolerance | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **H-Passivated Surface Contact Angle** ($\theta_c$, DHF-last) | $> 75^\circ$ | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Uniformity $\pm 3.0^\circ$ across 5 points) | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI Water Droplet) |
| **Residual Native / Chemical Oxide Thickness** ($t_{ox,0}$) | $< 0.8\text{ nm}$ | $\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ (Within baseline for $3.5\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ gate oxide target) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (9-point map, $\lambda = 190-800\text{ nm}$) |
| **Critical Defect / Particle Adder Density** ($d_{part}$) | $< 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ ($> 90\text{ nm}$ size) | $\le 15\text{ defects/wafer}$ for $200\text{ mm}$ wafer | Darkfield DUV/UV Laser Surface Particle Scanner |
| **Surface Micro-Roughness** ($R_q$ / RMS) | $< 0.15\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.20\text{ nm}$ | In-line Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM, $2\ \mu\text{m} \times 2\ \mu\text{m}$ scan) |

---

### 3. Context Literature Citations

- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Cited for gate dielectric baseline growth conditions: Dry oxidation performed at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ targeting physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ (requiring pre-oxidation residual oxide metrology control $\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ and minimal initial surface trap contamination to guarantee $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Cited for thermal gate oxide specification: $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, setting strict tolerances for incoming wafer surface cleanliness and pre-oxidation chemical oxide thickness.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Cited for access transistor channel geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, defining the critical particle inspection limit ($> L/2 = 90\text{ nm}$) to avoid gate bridging, pinholes, and excessive junction leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-RCA metrology directly couples the wet chemistry line to dry thermal oxidation and high-k ALD. Metrology latency must not consume >25% of the permissible atmospheric Q-time budget before thermal gate oxide growth; automated wafer handling and optical non-destructive surface mapping are critical to prevent manual handling-induced recontamination.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following standard SC-1/SC-2 and dilute HF native oxide strip, Si (100) surfaces exhibit hydrogen termination with contact angles > 70° (hydrophobic). However, if chemical oxide regrows or SC-2 without final HF dip is employed, hydroxyl-terminated SiO2 yields contact angles < 5° (hydrophilic). The metrology must clearly differentiate H-passivated versus chemical-passivated surfaces, quantify native oxide regrowth (< 0.15 nm), and verify sub-180nm particle density without introducing sessile drop drying stains or local pinhole defects in gate active areas.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Optical surface particle defect scanners (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan or laser-scattering equivalent) and automated optical goniometers require calibrated reference silicon standards, high-purity syringe tips, and electronic-grade UPW (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) which must be sustained in domestic inventory to avoid tool drift and inspection downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Clear bottleneck potential exists if 100% of pilot wafers undergo full-field manual goniometry and AFM roughness verification. The workflow must define a 5-point wafer sampling scheme for contact angle and rely on high-speed laser particle scanning to maintain lot cycle time under 25 minutes per cassette.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. In-situ water droplet residue or organic trace deposition from goniometer dispense needle contaminating active gate oxide dielectric area
1. Atmospheric moisture and hydrocarbon chemisorption during extended inspection triggering premature native oxide growth and interfacial state trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2)
1. Misclassification of micro-droplet condensation or surface haze as physical particulate defects on laser scattering inspection maps

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-3-01` | **Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Surface Passivation Verification** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with micro-syringe dispenser (0.5 µL droplet volume, cleanroom Class 1/10 compatible) | 1. Load 150mm/200mm pilot wafer onto goniometer vacuum chuck. 2. Dispense 0.5 µL UPW droplet at 5 standard coordinate sites (Center, North, South, East, West at 10mm edge exclusion). 3. Capture baseline image within 3.0 seconds of dispense using high-resolution telecentric camera. 4. Fit droplet contour using Young-Laplace algorithm to calculate left and right contact angles. 5. Perform automatic dry N2 blow-off on dedicated non-critical metrology exclusion zones. | `H-terminated surface: Mean WCA >= 75.0° with within-wafer standard deviation <= 2.5°; Chemical oxide surface: Mean WCA <= 5.0°. Any droplet site exhibiting pinning asymmetry > 3.0° fails.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-1-3-02` | **Laser Surface Particle Defect and Micro-Haze Inspection** | Unpatterned Surface Inspection System (Laser Darkfield Defect Scanner, 488nm or 405nm solid-state laser) | 1. Transfer wafer via robotic arm into scanner chamber. 2. Perform 360-degree helical laser scan across front-side surface. 3. Collect low-angle and high-angle scattered light signals to reconstruct particle map and background haze. 4. Bin detected scattering anomalies into particle size categories: >= 0.18 µm, >= 0.3 µm, and >= 1.0 µm. 5. Output composite defect density map and wafer average haze in ppm. | `Total defect count for particles >= 0.18 µm must be <= 15 defects/wafer (<= 0.08 defects/cm² on 150mm wafer); surface haze must remain <= 0.12 ppm; zero defect clusters or streak marks allowed.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), Chemical-resistant safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Full cleanroom ESD-safe bunny suit with integrated hood, face mask, and ESD-safe cleanroom boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: UPW and pure N2 metrology environment presents primarily asphyxiation and mechanical pinch hazards. In case of localized skin contact with test liquids, flush with standard eyewash/shower for 15 minutes. If N2 gas purge displaces oxygen causing dizziness or hypoxia, immediately move personnel to well-ventilated ambient air and administer oxygen if trained.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology station enclosure maintained under laminar HEPA/ULPA downflow (0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s); tool exhaust ducting connected to general cleanroom HVAC exhaust at >= 50 CFM to vent purge nitrogen and local enclosure heat.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Droplet test DI water drains into cleanroom neutral drain / industrial wastewater collection system. Syringe wash effluent and spent consumable pipette tips disposed of in certified non-hazardous cleanroom solid waste containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | SEMI C35 Grade 4 (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Ultra-High Purity N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 (99.9999% purity) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and spin-dried Si (100) substrate from RCA SC-1/SC-2/DHF wet bench with hydrogen or controlled ultra-thin chemical oxide passivation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspected, defect-certified, dry silicon wafer surface ready for immediate loadlock evacuation or thermal gate oxidation / ALD deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes uncontrolled ambient hydrocarbon condensation and native oxide growth (> 0.2 nm SiO2), degrading gate dielectric breakdown voltage (Ebd) and shifting threshold voltage (Vth) across 180nm DRAM access transistors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full non-destructive qualification of post-RCA wafer surface passivation verifying hydrophobic/hydrophilic contact angle conformance, sub-0.18 µm particle count <= 15 defects/wafer, and surface roughness Sa <= 0.15 nm within the 30-minute pre-oxidation Q-time envelope.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_PostRCA_Passivation_Report.csv`
- [ ] `Laser_Particle_Defect_Map_0.18um.tiff`
- [ ] `Post_RCA_Metrology_Signoff_Certificate.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle across 5-point measurement** | `78.0°` | +/- 4.0° | Young-Laplace automated profile goniometry at 21°C |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Front-side particle defect count for particles >= 0.18 µm** | `8 defects/wafer` | <= 15 defects/wafer max | Unpatterned darkfield laser scattering surface inspection (3mm edge exclusion) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Wafer surface background optical haze level** | `0.08 ppm` | <= 0.12 ppm | Low-angle laser darkfield scatterometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Cassette lot achieves 100% pass on laser defect density (<= 0.08 defects/cm² at >= 0.18 µm), contact angle falls strictly within specified passivation window (>= 75.0° for H-passivated or <= 5.0° for chemical oxide), and total elapsed queue time from RCA SRD unload to furnace loadlock staging is verified at <= 30 minutes in ambient air.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Dry Thermal Oxidation and High-k ALD Stack Deposition Recipe Execution
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make | **Classification:** Front-End Fabrication / Thermal Oxidation & Dielectric Deposition

---

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Pre-Clean: RCA-1, RCA-2 & Dilute HF (Native Oxide Strip)│
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Dry Thermal Oxidation (850°C - 900°C, Pure Dry O2)     │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ In-Situ Post-Oxidation Anneal (POA in N2 Ambient)      │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ High-k ALD Deposition (Al2O3 / Ta2O5 Stack)            │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Post-Deposition Anneal (PDA) & Inline Metrology        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Furnace Surface Preparation (RCA Clean & HF Dip)**
   - Subject single-crystal Si (100) wafers to standard RCA clean (SC-1: $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2/\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at 70°C; SC-2: $\text{HCl}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2/\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at 70°C).
   - Perform a final 50:1 DHF dip for 30 s to strip native oxide, followed by quick-dump rinse (QDR) with ultra-pure deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and spin-rinse dry under clean $\text{N}_2$ to achieve a hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated interface.

2. **Furnace Loading and Ramp-Up**
   - Transfer wafers into the quartz tube oxidation furnace at an idling temperature of 600°C under continuous ultra-high purity (UHP) $\text{N}_2$ carrier flow (5–10 slm) to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrowth.
   - Ramp furnace temperature up to **850°C – 900°C** at a linear ramp rate of 5°C/min in dry $\text{N}_2$.

3. **Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution**
   - Switch gas flow from $\text{N}_2$ to **100% pure dry $\text{O}_2$** (filtered, dew point $< -100^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Execute oxidation in the linear Deal-Grove regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, interface reaction-rate limited with linear rate constant $k_l = B/A$) at **850°C – 900°C** until achieving the target physical interface oxide thickness of **3.5 nm to 4.0 nm**.

4. **In-Situ Post-Oxidation Anneal (POA)**
   - Flush process tube with UHP $\text{N}_2$ and hold at 900°C for 15 minutes to passivate dangling silicon bonds, relieve film stress, and reduce interface trap density.
   - Ramp down furnace temperature to 600°C under $\text{N}_2$ and unclamp wafers into nitrogen purge transfer pods (FOUPs).

5. **High-k ALD Stack Deposition ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$)**
   - Transfer wafers immediately into the cross-flow Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) chamber (wafer transfer queue delay $< 60$ minutes).
   - Stabilize substrate stage temperature between 250°C – 300°C at base pressure $\sim 10^{-2}\text{ Torr}$.
   - Execute cyclical pulsed ALD recipe:
     - **$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ alternating cycles** using precursor exposure, $\text{N}_2$ purge, oxidant exposure ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$ or $\text{O}_3$), and $\text{N}_2$ purge to build the high-k stack with target effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of **3.0 to 4.0 nm**.

6. **Post-Deposition Anneal (PDA)**
   - Subject the stacked film to a mild thermal anneal at 400°C – 450°C in an $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ (forming gas) ambient for 20 minutes to densify the high-k dielectric and minimize border traps.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Physical Thickness** | **3.5 nm – 4.0 nm** | $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ ($1\sigma < 1.5\%$) | Multi-angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | **$> 10\text{ MV/cm}$** | Lower limit: $10.0\text{ MV/cm}$ | Mercury Probe / CV Prober (Quasi-static I-V) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | **$< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$** | Upper limit: $1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Frequency / Low-Frequency C-V Profiling |
| **High-k Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$) & Total EOT** | **$\kappa > 15$**; **$\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$** | Min $\kappa = 15.0$; $\text{EOT} \le 4.0\text{ nm}$ | Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) Metrology at 100 kHz |
| **Per-Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** | Target range: **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$** | Inline Array Parametric Testing (PCM) |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** (at 85°C) | Upper limit: $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Prober Parametric Station |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Oxidation kinetics: Linear-parabolic model $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$ with thin regime linear limit $x_0 \ll A/2$.
  - Dry oxidation temperature: $850^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - Dielectric breakdown field: $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
  - Interface trap density: $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
  - Target physical thickness: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell dimensions: Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Dielectric materials: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Cell capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage requirement: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor target capacitance: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - High-k Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation conditions: $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ yielding $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal budget integration between the 850°C dry oxidation step and the downstream high-k ALD process (typically 250°C-300°C for HfO2/Al2O3) must be strictly governed to prevent unintentional dopant de-activation or redistribution in the underlying 180nm DRAM access transistor channel. Furthermore, transferring the wafer from the atmospheric furnace tube to the vacuum ALD cluster introduces ambient queue-time risks that can cause uncontrollable parasitic native oxide growth, deteriorating the Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) budget and target capacitance density.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 850°C with target thickness tox = 3.5 nm, growth falls strictly into the initial anomalous thin-regime (<25 nm) where standard Deal-Grove parabolic kinetics fail and linear surface-reaction rates dominate alongside direct Cabrera-Mott electric field-assisted diffusion. In-situ O2 partial pressure and rapid thermal ramp rates (or short oxidation dwell times of ~22 min) require ultra-stable gas delivery to prevent batch-to-batch variations in interfacial trap density (Dit target < 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1) and to ensure robust interfacial sub-oxide (SiOx) quality prior to high-k capping.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-high purity (UHP) electronic-grade O2 (minimum 6N grade / 99.9999% purity) and high-purity organometallic ALD precursors (such as TEMAHf or TMA, >=99.999% metals basis) present lead-time and supply-chain volatility in domestic Vietnam fabrication facilities. Bubbler cylinder temperature regulation modules and validated delivery lines must be redundant to avert line shutdowns.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The dual-step dry oxidation and high-k ALD sequence represents a throughput bottleneck on the Front-End line due to furnace loading, ramp cycles, and pump-down transitions. To prevent schedule slippage across Gen 2 DRAM pilot tapeouts, wafer cassette handoffs between thermal furnace and ALD loadlocks must operate within a strict 30-minute queue-time window with dedicated pre-allocated lot tracking.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic interfacial SiOx growth exceeding 0.5 nm caused by uncontrolled air exposure (Q-time violation) between thermal oxidation and ALD high-k deposition, degrading gate capacitance and threshold voltage (Vth) roll-off.
1. Incomplete hydroxyl (-OH) functionalization or carbon/halogen contamination at the SiO2/high-k ALD interface, resulting in unacceptably high mid-gap interface trap density (Dit > 1x10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1) and early gate dielectric breakdown (Ebd < 8 MV/cm).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-2-01` | **Interfacial SiO2 and High-k ALD Bilayer Physical Thickness and Refractive Index Mapping** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE, 190-1000 nm wavelength range) and X-ray Reflectivity (XRR) system | 1. Load processed 150mm/200mm DRAM monitor wafer onto spectroscopic ellipsometer vacuum chuck. 2. Measure polarized reflection spectra (Psi, Delta) across a standard 49-point polar map with 3mm edge exclusion. 3. Fit optical dispersion model using Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz layers for HfO2 on SiO2 on Si substrate. 4. Corroborate physical bilayer thickness profile via specular XRR sweep from 0.2 to 4.0 degrees 2-theta. | `Physical interfacial SiO2 layer thickness must be 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm with 1-sigma non-uniformity < 1.5%; total HfO2/SiO2 stack thickness within +/- 5% of target; refractive index n at 632.8 nm within 2.05 - 2.15 for HfO2.` |
| `TC-DRAM-ROOT-SUB-2-2-2-02` | **Gate Dielectric Breakdown Field (Ebd) and Interface Trap Density (Dit) C-V/I-V Qualification** | Automated Cryogenic/Room-Temperature Wafer Prober integrated with Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer and High-Frequency LCR Meter | 1. Contact top TiN/Al gate dot and grounded chuck back-contact. 2. Measure high-frequency (100 kHz, 1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V curves from accumulation (-2.5 V) to inversion (+2.5 V). 3. Extract Dit via Terman or conductance method across the Si bandgap. 4. Perform voltage-ramp dielectric breakdown (VRDB) sweep at 0.1 V/s ramp rate to record breakdown voltage (Vbd) and calculate breakdown electric field (Ebd = Vbd / EOT). | `Dielectric breakdown field Ebd >= 10.0 MV/cm across >= 95% of tested dies; Interface trap density Dit <= 1.0x10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1 at midgap; gate leakage current density Jg <= 1.0x10^-4 A/cm^2 at |Vgs - Vth| = 1.0 V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom-compatible flame-resistant Nomex/poly blend lab coat, Double nitrile gloves (chemical splash resistant, minimum 6 mil), UV/IR-filtering safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1+), Thermal heat-resistant gloves (rated to 250°C) for furnace quartzware handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For metal-organic precursor (TEMAH) skin contact: Immediately brush off loose material, flush affected area with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes; seek immediate medical evaluation. In case of inhalation of precursor fumes or oxidant breakdown products: Remove victim to fresh air, provide oxygen if breathing is difficult, keep calm and warm. For thermal burns from quartz boats: Cool immediately with sterile cold water for >= 20 minutes, cover with dry sterile dressing; do not apply salves.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Oxidation furnace gas box and exhaust lines connected to a dedicated dedicated high-temperature toxic/pyrophoric scrubber running with N2 dilution; continuous differential pressure monitoring (minimum static exhaust draft: -0.5 inch H2O). ALD vacuum exhaust routed through a point-of-use thermal decomposition gas abatement unit (temperatures > 650°C) prior to house wet scrubber integration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhaust condensate and bubbler residue must be hydrolyzed slowly under inert nitrogen purge in an approved vented chemical fume hood. Effluent neutralized to pH 6.0-9.0 and filtered for heavy metal precipitates prior to cleanroom industrial wastewater discharge; spent precursor cannisters returned to chemical vendor under closed-loop hazardous transport protocol.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxygen (Compressed Gas)** | `7782-44-7` | Electronic Grade Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100%` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamido)hafnium(IV) [TEMAH]** | `352535-01-4` | VLSI/ALD Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `>= 99.0%` |
| **Nitrogen (Carrier/Purge Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 6.0 | `>= 99.9999%` |
| **Water Vapor / Ozone (Oxidant Precursor)** | `7732-18-5` | UPW (Ultra-Pure Water, 18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Atomically clean, H-terminated Si(100) surface obtained via dilute HF (0.5% HF:H2O) dip rinse and spin-rinse-dry, devoid of carbon contamination and native oxide (< 0.1 nm equivalent native oxide).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stable, pinhole-free stoichiometric SiO2 (3.5 nm) capped with amorphous High-k (HfO2, 3.0-4.0 nm) dielectric stack with uniform hydroxyl/nitrogen-passivated surface ready for gate electrode metallization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive queue time causes adventitious airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and uncontrolled room-temperature native oxide regrowth (> 0.4 nm), leading to threshold voltage instability, degraded subthreshold swing, and uncontrolled interfacial capacitance reduction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline execution of dry thermal gate oxidation (3.5 nm SiO2) at 850°C and subsequent conformal high-k HfO2 ALD capping, achieving ultra-low interface state density (Dit < 1e10 cm^-2 eV^-1), tight thickness uniformity (< 1.5%), and dielectric breakdown strength exceeding 10 MV/cm on 180nm DRAM test structures.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RECIPE_EXECUTION_LOG_DRY_OX_ALD_STACK.pdf`
- [ ] `ELLIPSOMETRY_49PT_THICKNESS_CONTOUR_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `CV_IV_INTERFACE_CHARACTERIZATION_REPORT.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Interfacial thermal SiO2 physical film thickness** | `3.5 nm` | +/- 0.2 nm | Multi-angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry across 49-point wafer mapping |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Gate dielectric breakdown electric field (Ebd)** | `10.5 MV/cm` | >= 10.0 MV/cm | Automated voltage ramp dielectric breakdown (VRDB) testing on MOS capacitors |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Mid-gap interface trap density (Dit)** | `8.0x10^9 cm^-2 eV^-1` | <= 1.0x10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1 | High-low frequency capacitance-voltage (C-V) and conductance method profiling |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

critics.systems_engineer: Thermal budget integration between the 850°C dry oxidation step and the downstream high-k ALD process (typically 250°C-300°C for HfO2/Al2O3) must be strictly governed to prevent unintentional dopant de-activation or redistribution in the underlying 180nm DRAM access transistor channel. Furthermore, transferring the wafer from the atmospheric furnace tube to the vacuum ALD cluster introduces ambient queue-time risks that can cause uncontrollable parasitic native oxide growth, deteriorating the Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) budget and target capacitance density.
critics.domain_expert: At 850°C with target thickness tox = 3.5 nm, growth falls strictly into the initial anomalous thin-regime (<25 nm) where standard Deal-Grove parabolic kinetics fail and linear surface-reaction rates dominate alongside direct Cabrera-Mott electric field-assisted diffusion. In-situ O2 partial pressure and rapid thermal ramp rates (or short oxidation dwell times of ~22 min) require ultra-stable gas delivery to prevent batch-to-batch variations in interfacial trap density (Dit target < 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1) and to ensure robust interfacial sub-oxide (SiOx) quality prior to high-k capping.
critics.supply_chain: Ultra-high purity (UHP) electronic-grade O2 (minimum 6N grade / 99.9999% purity) and high-purity organometallic ALD precursors (such as TEMAHf or TMA, >=99.999% metals basis) present lead-time and supply-chain volatility in domestic Vietnam fabrication facilities. Bubbler cylinder temperature regulation modules and validated delivery lines must be redundant to avert line shutdowns.
critics.laya_pm: The dual-step dry oxidation and high-k ALD sequence represents a throughput bottleneck on the Front-End line due to furnace loading, ramp cycles, and pump-down transitions. To prevent schedule slippage across Gen 2 DRAM pilot tapeouts, wafer cassette handoffs between thermal furnace and ALD loadlocks must operate within a strict 30-minute queue-time window with dedicated pre-allocated lot tracking.
critical_failure_modes: Parasitic interfacial SiOx growth exceeding 0.5 nm caused by uncontrolled air exposure (Q-time violation) between thermal oxidation and ALD high-k deposition, degrading gate capacitance and threshold voltage (Vth) roll-off.

Incomplete hydroxyl (-OH) functionalization or carbon/halogen contamination at the SiO2/high-k ALD interface, resulting in unacceptably high mid-gap interface trap density (Dit > 1x10^11 cm^-2 eV^-1) and early gate dielectric breakdown (Ebd < 8 MV/cm).

Measure polarized reflection spectra (Psi, Delta) across a standard 49-point polar map with 3mm edge exclusion. 3. Fit optical dispersion model using Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz layers for HfO2 on SiO2 on Si substrate. 4. Corroborate physical bilayer thickness profile via specular XRR sweep from 0.2 to 4.0 degrees 2-theta.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Physical interfacial SiO2 layer thickness must be 3.5 nm +/- 0.2 nm with 1-sigma non-uniformity < 1.5%; total HfO2/SiO2 stack thickness within +/- 5% of target; refractive index n at 632.8 nm within 2.05 - 2.15 for HfO2.

testcases.instrumentation: Automated Cryogenic/Room-Temperature Wafer Prober integrated with Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer and High-Frequency LCR Meter
testcases.pre_conditions: Shadow-mask sputtered TiN/Al dot gate electrodes (area: 1.0x10^-4 cm^2) fabricated on the oxidized/ALD-deposited wafer with forming gas anneal (400°C, 30 min, 5% H2 in N2).

Measure high-frequency (100 kHz, 1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V curves from accumulation (-2.5 V) to inversion (+2.5 V). 3. Extract Dit via Terman or conductance method across the Si bandgap. 4. Perform voltage-ramp dielectric breakdown (VRDB) sweep at 0.1 V/s ramp rate to record breakdown voltage (Vbd) and calculate breakdown electric field (Ebd = Vbd / EOT).
